title_translated: 在游戏PC上对L2英语口语进行专家级评估：准确性、流利度与语调分析（基于XLS-R、XEUS与PhoneticXeus）
summary_translated: oollim 是一个可在消费级计算机上本地运行的系统，用于评估二语英语发音的准确性、流利度和语调。该系统结合了预训练的XLS-R、XEUS和PhoneticXeus表示，以及参考文本特征，并使用SpeechOcean762（韩国学习者二语语音语料库，英语）、J-AESOP及其组合数据集上的岭回归模型进行训练。在由三位专家评分员独立评估的305段录音上，多个岭回归配置在所有三个维度上的斯皮尔曼相关系数和加权二次kappa值均显著优于2026年1月获得的存档Azure API评分。这些结果支持在消费硬件上使用预训练表示和特定构念的回归模型实现专家级语音评估，无需对私有评估数据进行神经模型微调或校准。

summary: Multi-hop knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) benchmarks are often treated as fixed language-and-reasoning tasks, but for navigation-based methods, difficulty also depends on the graph in which those tasks are instantiated. This makes graph construction a consequential but often entangled part of the navigation task. To isolate this effect, we audit PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL) as graph-navigation benchmarks under a controlled intervention: we hold questions, topic entities, released answers, released path annotations, and family-level splits fixed while replacing each released task-filtered graph with the larger source KG distributed with the benchmark. Source restoration expands the effective navigation search space and graph-consistent answer and path multiplicity while sharply reducing unguided reachability to released answers. We evaluate whether these structural changes persist across navigation policies using structural references, frozen small-language-model navigation policies, and trained MINERVA policies. Across both frozen and trained policies, restoration substantially reduces released-answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity, while graph-consistent evaluation recovers only part of the loss. These results show that benchmark graph construction is part of the navigation task specification rather than merely an implementation detail and can materially shape measured behavior even when the released QA task is held fixed.
title: How Benchmark Graph Construction Shapes Multi-Hop KG Navigation: A Controlled Audit of PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large
comment: 17 pages. PQ/PQL reconstruction code available at this https URL
title_translated: 基准图构建如何影响多跳知识图谱导航：PathQuestion与PathQuestion-Large的受控审计
summary_translated: 多跳知识图谱问答（KGQA）基准常被视为固定的语言与推理任务，但对于基于导航的方法而言，难度还取决于任务所实例化的图结构。这使得图构建成为导航任务中一个关键但常被混淆的部分。为隔离这一影响，我们对PathQuestion（PQ）和PathQuestion-Large（PQL）作为图导航基准进行了受控干预审计：保持问题、主题实体、已发布答案、路径标注及家族级划分不变，仅将每个已发布的任务过滤图替换为基准附带的更大源知识图。源图恢复扩大了有效的导航搜索空间，增加了图一致的答案与路径多重性，同时显著降低了无引导到达已发布答案的可能性。我们通过结构参照、冻结的小语言模型导航策略以及训练好的MINERVA策略评估了这些结构变化是否在不同导航策略中持续存在。无论是在冻结还是训练后的策略中，恢复都大幅降低了已发布答案的准确率和轨迹保真度，而图一致性评估仅部分恢复了损失。结果表明，基准图构建是导航任务规范的一部分，而非单纯的实现细节，即使在已发布QA任务固定的情况下，仍会实质性地影响测量到的行为。

summary: On-policy distillation can transfer the reasoning capabilities of a strong teacher to a smaller student. However, distillation from a stronger teacher model faces two mismatches: its solutions may be difficult for a smaller student to imitate, and its token-level probabilities may be incompatible with, or even unavailable to, the student. Existing methods handle these settings through different forms of supervision. To this end, we propose Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces. The model to be distilled from, termed the external teacher, first provides a reasoning trace as privileged context, which can be generated in an offline fashion. The student generates rollouts without this context, while a copy of the student conditioned on it, serving as the self-teacher, scores the same rollouts in the student's own token space. BSD uses the resulting token-level guidance to adjust updates on unsuccessful rollouts, with a verifier providing the outcome signal. As the external teacher is queried only to produce text, the same training procedure applies to all teacher scenarios: shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers. Across these scenarios, BSD improves over the base model and outperforms baselines tailored to each scenario, offering a novel and unified pathway for distillation. Code is available: https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation
title: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 桥接自蒸馏：用于在线策略学习
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏可以将强教师模型的推理能力迁移到较小的学生模型。然而，从更强的教师模型进行蒸馏面临两个不匹配问题：其解决方案可能难以被较小的学生模仿，且其逐标记概率可能与学生不兼容，甚至不可用。现有方法通过不同形式的监督来处理这些情况。为此，我们提出桥接自蒸馏（BSD），一种统一的蒸馏框架，适用于任何提供推理轨迹的教师模型。被蒸馏的模型称为外部教师，首先以离线方式生成推理轨迹作为特权上下文。学生在没有此上下文的情况下生成轨迹，而一个基于该上下文的教师副本（作为自教师）则在学生自身的标记空间中对同一轨迹进行评分。BSD利用由此产生的逐标记指导来调整失败轨迹的更新，验证器提供结果信号。由于外部教师仅需生成文本，相同的训练流程适用于所有教师场景：共享分词器、跨分词器和封闭API教师。在这些场景中，BSD均优于基础模型，并超越了针对每种场景定制的基线方法，提供了一条新颖且统一的蒸馏路径。代码已公开：https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation

summary: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved three of four model configurations across the external benchmarks, with mean gains of up to 9.6 percentage points, and improved all four configurations on the held-out test set by 10.2-30.3 points. Abstract retrieval performed best when reference evidence was abstract-aligned, whereas full-text representations were generally more effective when richer evidence was needed. Hierarchical representation matched or outperformed flat full-text retrieval in most end-to-end comparisons while requiring 67% fewer indexed units and 44-56% less storage. These findings show that corpus scale should be treated as an explicit evaluation variable in biomedical RAG, and that the most appropriate design depends on evidence format, model behavior, and operational constraints.
title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, plus 11 pages of supplementary material. Preprint submitted to Elsevier. Code: this https URL and this https URL
title_translated: 大规模生物医学RAG：语料规模、文档表示与效率权衡
summary_translated: 我们呈现了一项受控的大规模评估，探讨语料规模、文档表示和重排序对生物医学检索增强生成（RAG）系统有效性与效率的影响。检索语料库逐步扩展，同时保留相关源文档，从而实现不同语料规模间的一致比较。我们在第一阶段检索、重排序和端到端多选题问答中，对比了摘要、扁平全文和分层全文表示。在开发数据上选择的配置在五个外部生物医学基准和一个保留测试集上进行评估，同时测量检索延迟和索引存储量以量化运营成本。小规模或受控集合中观察到的性能模式在语料库扩大后并未持续显现，且重排序的有效性取决于语料库和检索设置。RAG在四个模型配置中的三个外部基准上均取得提升，平均增益达9.6个百分点；在保留测试集上，所有四个配置均提升10.2至30.3个百分点。当参考证据与摘要对齐时，摘要检索表现最佳；而需要更丰富证据时，全文表示通常更为有效。分层表示在大多数端到端比较中表现与扁平全文相当或更优，同时所需索引单元减少67%，存储量降低44%-56%。这些发现表明，在生物医学RAG中，语料规模应作为明确的评估变量对待，最合适的系统设计取决于证据格式、模型行为和运营约束。

summary: Work on efficient large-language-model inference has concentrated almost entirely on reducing the cost of decoding once a request is complete. The quantity a user experiences, however, is the interval between submitting a request and receiving a usable response, and that interval can be shortened without making decoding itself faster. While a request is being composed it is already partially specified, yet conventional deployments begin no computation until submission. We propose and study streaming generation, a decoding regime in which the model begins producing a response from an incomplete request and revises it as the remaining input arrives, so that only a small residue of the answer remains to be computed once the request is submitted. We evaluate the regime on autoregressive and diffusion language models, characterise the conditions under which it reduces user-visible latency, and analyse the mechanism responsible.
title: Answering While You Type: Optimizing Time-to-Answer with Streaming Generation
title_translated: 边打字边回答：通过流式生成优化响应时间
summary_translated: 关于高效大语言模型推理的研究几乎完全集中在减少请求完成后解码的成本。然而，用户实际体验的是提交请求到获得可用响应之间的时间间隔，这一间隔可以在不加快解码本身的情况下缩短。在请求尚未完成时，其内容已部分明确，但传统部署直到提交才开始计算。我们提出并研究了流式生成，即模型从不完整的请求开始生成响应，并随着剩余输入的到达不断修正，使得请求提交时仅需计算少量剩余答案。我们在自回归和扩散语言模型上评估了该方法，分析了其降低用户可见延迟的条件，并探讨了背后的机制。

summary: When a user supplies a document and wants the answer drawn from it, a language model is expected to follow it even when it contradicts its parametric knowledge. Prior work has focused on making the model rely on context by steering activations, contrasting logits during decoding, or instructing it in plain language. We ask whether the document alone, with no instruction written into it and no access to the model at inference time, is enough. We optimize a document suffix by discrete token search, starting from the answer to a single question and extending the objective to a set of passages, to multi-hop questions that follow from the planted fact, and to later turns of a conversation. On counterfactual passages that contradict parametric knowledge of the model, the suffix flips nearly all items the model resists across three instruction-tuned model families, in most settings outperforms the decoding baseline and the strongest instruction we could write, and matches activation steering. Controls show that the suffix largely acts through the passage rather than injecting the answer, and a single suffix per model transfers to unseen passages. Each extended objective carries the effect to its target, so the objective, not only the document, sets how far the effect reaches.
title: Shaping the Document, Not the Model: Optimized Suffixes for Context Following
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables. Project page: this https URL
title_translated: 塑造文档，而非模型：面向上下文遵循的优化后缀
summary_translated: 当用户提供一份文档并希望答案从中提取时，语言模型应能遵循文档内容，即使这与模型的参数化知识相矛盾。以往工作聚焦于通过引导激活、解码时对比logits或用自然语言指令来使模型依赖上下文。我们探讨仅靠文档本身（不添加任何指令，也不在推理时访问模型）是否足够。通过离散token搜索优化文档后缀，从单个问题的答案出发，逐步扩展至一组段落、基于预设事实的多跳问题以及对话后续轮次。在与模型参数知识相悖的反事实段落中，该后缀几乎扭转了三个指令调优模型家族中模型抗拒的几乎所有项目，在多数设置下优于解码基线和我们所能撰写的最强指令，且达到激活引导的效果。控制实验表明，后缀主要通过段落起作用，而非直接注入答案；每个模型使用单一后缀即可迁移至未见过的段落。每个扩展目标均能将效果传递至目标范围，说明目标设定而非文档本身决定了影响范围。

summary: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.
title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
title_translated: 心跳思维：实时语音代理在倾听过程中进行推测性推理与工具执行
summary_translated: 使用工具的语音代理常在语音结束后仍让用户等待，即使可操作信息已在请求早期到达。推测性方法可在语音期间开始工作，但受块大小限制或更新时中断的生成方式可能在参数完整前截断工具调用，导致计算时间与语音更新耦合，限制了提前完成的有效工作量。我们提出心跳思维，通过新的Thinker调用处理更新输入，同时允许正在进行的调用和已分发的工具继续完成。周期性调用会读取最新的部分转录文本及共享的已完成推理和工具结果记录。这些结果有助于解决缺失参数并启动依赖调用，使准备过程能在语音更新间持续推进。在SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG上的实验表明，心跳思维相比SHANKS风格的窗口基线，提升了整体推测性工具覆盖度或检索复用率，对最终任务质量的影响因基准而异。在FDBench v3上，工具覆盖率提升16个百分点，平均最终响应延迟降低36.4%。结果表明，保持语音过程中持续计算的心跳思维范式，可将倾听时间转化为可复用的准备工作，从而实现更快、更强大的语音代理响应。

summary: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) are a core component of modern language models; yet, tokenizer capacity remains typically determined by a fixed merge budget, chosen heuristically. Since larger vocabularies increase memory usage and computational cost, selecting compact and effective token inventories is essential for efficient language modeling. We study the optimization of a BPE merge budget as a statistical model selection problem and investigate information-theoretic criteria for \emph{computing optimal merge sets} directly from corpus statistics. To further improve the merge selection in limited data conditions, we augment the BPE training corpora with synthetic texts generated from the original data, providing estimates for the unigram and bigram distributions. Experiments across multiple corpora and downstream tasks show that using a principled vocabulary selection technique reduces model size, with little degradation in performance. We further observe that synthetic data can yield better tokenizers, especially in low-resource settings.
title: Rethinking BPE: Merge Selection as Model Selection
title_translated: 重新思考BPE：合并选择即模型选择
summary_translated: 子词分词方法如字节对编码（BPE）是现代语言模型的核心组成部分；然而，分词器容量通常由固定的合并预算决定，该预算为启发式选择。由于更大的词汇表会增加内存占用和计算成本，因此选择紧凑且高效的词典对于高效语言建模至关重要。我们将BPE合并预算的优化视为一个统计模型选择问题，并研究基于信息论的标准，直接从语料库统计中计算最优合并集。为进一步改善数据有限情况下的合并选择，我们通过原始数据生成合成文本，以估计一元和二元分布。在多个语料库和下游任务上的实验表明，采用有原则的词汇选择技术可显著减小模型规模，且性能下降极小。我们还发现，合成数据在低资源环境下尤其能生成更优的分词器。

summary: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.
title: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
comment: Content warning: this paper discusses suicide, self-harm, and distressing language
title_translated: VEILED-SH：通过间接语言评估数据集检测脆弱性（自残）
summary_translated: AI系统可能忽略间接的、文化相关的痛苦表达，或提供与应用场景不匹配的支持。现有基准未能共同涵盖文化差异、应用背景和从业者意见分歧。我们引入VEILED-SH，这是一个用于评估对自杀、自残和痛苦间接表达的单轮响应的基准及其构建方法。其包含10,003个提示，涵盖咨询聊天、论坛帖子、平台搜索和初步评估，基于新加坡本地来源和公开数据集。专家验证的多标签分类体系区分意图、交际功能和响应行为。六个独立校准的自动化评分模型，分别对应三位同伴支持者和三位临床医生，保留各自的参考策略用于代理对齐评分。在覆盖增强样本上对五个系统进行评估，揭示了不同评分模型生成的参考策略之间存在代理对齐差异，即使针对同一系统响应也是如此。

summary: Tokenization-free, pixel-based language models (PLMs) have recently been proposed as an alternative to conventional token-based language models (TLMs), typically motivated by practical considerations, e.g., the flexibility to support new languages or vocabularies. Nevertheless, PLMs also have the potential to serve as infrastructure for computational (psycho)linguistics, where tokenization has been a source of bias in estimating information-theoretic values, such as surprisal, and has pushed the bottom-up visual orthographic features outside the scope. In this study, we first integrate PLMs into the modeling of naturalistic human reading and, in particular, examine their use to estimate next-word predictability, which can also integrate orthographic and parafoveal information. Our results demonstrate that next-word prediction difficulty, computed in pixel space, has strong predictive power for gaze duration and word skipping behavior across various languages. In particular, their advantage is complementary to existing token-level surprisal and entropy estimates. Cross-lingual analyses with script variations also clarify their distinctive visual processing biases, facilitating research into how bottom-up visual information is incrementally integrated into expectation-based reading.
title: Reading Time Modeling with Pixel-Based Language Models
title_translated: 基于像素的语言模型阅读时间建模
summary_translated: 无分词的基于像素的语言模型（PLMs）最近被提出作为传统基于标记的语言模型（TLMs）的替代方案，通常出于实际考虑，例如支持新语言或词汇的灵活性。然而，PLMs也有潜力作为计算（心理）语言学的基础架构，因为分词在估计信息论值（如意外度）时已成为偏差来源，并将自下而上的视觉正字法特征排除在外。在本研究中，我们首次将PLMs整合到自然人类阅读建模中，特别考察其用于估计下一个词可预测性的能力，该能力还可融合正字法和周边视觉信息。结果表明，在像素空间中计算的下一个词预测难度对多种语言中的注视持续时间和跳读行为具有强大的预测能力。尤其值得注意的是，其优势与现有的基于标记的意外度和熵估计相辅相成。跨语言分析结合脚本差异进一步揭示了其独特的视觉处理偏差，有助于研究自下而上的视觉信息如何逐步融入基于预期的阅读过程。

summary: Identifying conceptually equivalent questions across different surveys is a challenging information retrieval task where surface-level textual similarity is insufficient. Two questions may be lexically similar yet assess entirely different sociological sub-concepts, or lexically different yet conceptually equivalent. We introduce a conditional information retrieval framework that addresses this by decomposing the task into two steps: concept extraction, which identifies the underlying sociological concept of a survey question using a fine-tuned generative model, and concept-aware retrieval, which augments question representations with the extracted concept as an explicit conditioning signal for finer-grained alignment. To reflect the realistic data scarcity conditions of specialised social science annotation, we use CLOSER as a case study. Our framework consistently outperforms baselines by 2-3 points in both MAP and Recall. We further analyse fine-tuning strategies including SFT, DPO, and dynamic DPO, finding that SFT delivers the most stable gains while dynamic DPO interacts differently with instruction-tuned versus distilled reasoning backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that a model fine-tuned on a general social science thesaurus (ELSST) transfers robustly to task-specific survey data, offering a practical solution under data scarcity.
title: Conditional information Retrieval for Longitudinal Survey Harmonisation
title_translated: 纵向调查协调中的条件性信息检索
summary_translated: 在不同调查之间识别概念等价问题是一项具有挑战性的信息检索任务，表面文本相似性不足以应对。两个问题可能在词汇上相似，但评估完全不同的社会学子概念；也可能词汇不同但概念等价。我们引入了一种条件性信息检索框架，通过将任务分解为两步来解决：概念提取，利用微调的生成模型识别调查问题背后的潜在社会学概念；以及概念感知检索，将提取的概念作为显式条件信号增强问题表示，实现更细粒度的对齐。为反映专门社会科学标注中的真实数据稀缺情况，我们以CLOSER为例进行研究。我们的框架在MAP和召回率上均比基线高出2-3个百分点。我们进一步分析了SFT、DPO和动态DPO等微调策略，发现SFT带来最稳定的提升，而动态DPO在指令微调与蒸馏推理骨干模型上的表现存在差异。最后，我们证明在通用社会科学词典（ELSST）上微调的模型能稳健迁移至特定调查数据，为数据稀缺场景提供实用解决方案。

summary: Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness. More broadly, this work advocates a shift from isolated voice assistants toward agent-centric conversational infrastructures, providing a general blueprint for building extensible voice-agent systems in public services and beyond.
title: VISAGENT: An Agent-Based End-to-End Voice Interaction System
title_translated: VISAGENT：一种基于智能体的端到端语音交互系统
summary_translated: 基于语音的公共服务已从人工交换台演进为智能平台以满足现代用户需求。然而，当前系统仍受限于僵化的菜单驱动交互、碎片化的垂直服务以及有限的可扩展性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了VISAGENT——一个面向大规模公共服务的基于智能体的端到端语音交互系统，集成了端到端语音交互、分层智能体路由、可扩展的语音智能体市场以及用户记忆支持功能。该系统以自然语音取代菜单驱动流程，并通过两级路由范式在数百个智能体中实现亚秒级意图到智能体的选择。用户记忆支持偏好感知的智能体选择，并向选定智能体提供相关偏好和上下文，支持个性化任务执行并减少用户重复提供信息的需求。语音智能体注册机制将任务智能体转化为对话实体，实现动态接入和生态系统级可扩展性。我们在我国114热线的多个服务领域进行了真实世界部署验证。实验结果表明系统具备低延迟全双工交互、鲁棒的路由可扩展性以及具有竞争力的语音自然度。更广泛地，本工作倡导从孤立的语音助手转向以智能体为中心的对话基础设施，为构建公共服务业及其他领域的可扩展语音智能体系统提供了通用蓝图。

summary: While language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their performance remains disproportionately skewed towards high-resource languages. This disparity is particularly acute for the 700 million inhabitants of Southeast Asia, where vast linguistic diversity remains under-represented in existing benchmarks, often suffering from limited language coverage or narrow task scopes. To address this, we introduce DeepSEA, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from established datasets through professional human translation into 12 Southeast Asian languages, spanning both high-resource (e.g., Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese) and low-resource (e.g., Burmese, Khmer, Lao) tiers across five distinct tasks: mathematical reasoning, scientific reasoning, question answering, abstractive summarization, and machine translation. Extensive evaluation of frontier proprietary and open-weights models reveals that while frontier models like Gemini-3.7-Flash maintain robustness across resource tiers, smaller models face severe performance degradation on low-resource languages. Crucially, models perform better in reasoning and summarization when pivoted through English rather than target languages, exposing a critical dependency on English representations, especially for low-resource languages. Beyond these observations, we provide a cross-lingual error analysis and a cross-script tokenizer fertility analysis. We hope these findings shed light on the development of next-generation inclusive multilingual models.
title: DeepSEA: A Multilingual Evaluation Benchmark for Southeast Asia

title_translated: DeepSEA：东南亚多语言评估基准
summary_translated: 尽管语言模型展现出卓越能力，其性能在高资源语言上仍显著优于低资源语言。这一差距在东南亚地区尤为突出，该地区约7亿居民面临巨大的语言多样性，现有基准普遍覆盖不足，常存在语言范围有限或任务范畴狭窄的问题。为此，我们推出了DeepSEA，一个全面的基准，通过专业人工翻译将现有数据集构建为12种东南亚语言的版本，涵盖高资源（如印尼语、泰语、越南语）和低资源（如缅甸语、高棉语、老挝语）语言，覆盖五个不同任务：数学推理、科学推理、问答、抽象摘要和机器翻译。对前沿专有模型和开源权重模型的广泛评估显示，虽然像Gemini-3.7-Flash这样的前沿模型在各资源层级上保持稳健表现，但小型模型在低资源语言上面临严重性能下降。关键发现是，当通过英语而非目标语言进行推理时，模型在推理和摘要任务中表现更好，暴露出对英语表征的高度依赖，尤其是在低资源语言上。除上述观察外，我们还提供了跨语言错误分析和跨脚本分词器丰度分析。我们希望这些发现能为下一代包容性多语言模型的发展提供启示。

summary: The Chinese idiom "kou mi fu jian" ("honeyed words, hidden daggers") names speech that is polite in form but hostile in function. We present ZhenhuanBench, a 1,592-item benchmark built from expert commentary on Empresses in the Palace, covering speaker intent, emotion-language mismatch, and per-listener uptake. Text-only evaluation covers 34 LLMs. GPT-6 Astra leads the leaderboard at 73.48% overall, while its listener-reaction score is 58.37%. The annotations also supply supervised traces and string-verifiable training rewards. With 338 gold traces, an 8B model outperforms teacher distillation on identical items. Subsequent RL saturates, and chance correction reduces the estimated recoverable performance gap by a factor of 7.5. Our CPR-GRPO loop (Compress-Probe-Replenish) uses this estimate to weight gold supervision, reaching 67.0 on public multiple-choice tasks and 74.5 under the training-matched hidden protocol. Without target-task training, CPR outperforms Base, SFT, and GRPO across six Chinese and English pragmatic and sarcasm evaluations. On three external datasets, training with CPR yields higher mean Macro-F1 than SFT and GRPO.
title: Honeyed Words, Hidden Daggers: Benchmarking and Training LLMs to See Through Mock Politeness
title_translated: 蜜言藏刃：评测与训练大模型识破伪装礼貌
summary_translated: 中文成语“口蜜腹剑”描述的是形式礼貌但实质敌意的言语。我们提出了ZhenhuanBench，一个包含1,592项的基准，源自对《甄嬛传》专家评论，涵盖说话人意图、情绪-语言不匹配及听者接受度。文本仅评估覆盖34个大模型。GPT-6 Astra在排行榜上以73.48%的整体得分领先，但其听者反应得分为58.37%。注释还提供了监督轨迹和可字符串验证的训练奖励。拥有338条黄金轨迹，一个8B模型在相同项目上优于教师蒸馏。后续强化学习达到饱和，且偶然性校正使估计可恢复性能差距缩小了7.5倍。我们的CPR-GRPO循环（压缩-探测-补充）利用此估计加权黄金监督，在公开多选任务上达到67.0分，在训练匹配的隐藏协议下达到74.5分。在未进行目标任务训练的情况下，CPR在六个中英文语用和反讽评估中超越Base、SFT和GRPO。在三个外部数据集上，使用CPR训练的模型平均Macro-F1高于SFT和GRPO。

summary: Diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a promising alternative to sequential autoregressive decoding. Existing acceleration methods use predictive confidence to enable parallel token commitment while preserving generation quality. However, confidence-based selection prioritizes reliable token predictions without explicitly considering how token positions shape the remaining decoding schedule. Moreover, such ordering does not always reflect inter-token dependencies, suggesting that confidence need not be the sole criterion for token selection. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding (BPD), which favors central pivots within contiguous masked intervals and decodes the selected positions in parallel. Balanced pivots yield logarithmic decoding depth in the interval length. Our practical method accounts for model uncertainty by combining confidence-based prefilling with confidence-thresholded center selection. We evaluate the resulting quality-efficiency tradeoff on LLaDA and Dream across five mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction-following benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLM_random_pivot-EE62/
title: Balance-Aware Pivot Selection for Parallel Diffusion LLM Decoding
title_translated: 面向并行扩散LLM解码的平衡感知枢纽选择
summary_translated: 扩散语言模型实现了并行标记生成，为顺序自回归解码提供了一种有前景的替代方案。现有的加速方法使用预测置信度来实现并行标记提交，同时保持生成质量。然而，基于置信度的选择优先考虑可靠的标记预测，未明确考虑标记位置如何影响剩余的解码调度。此外，这种排序并不总是反映标记间的依赖关系，表明置信度不一定是标记选择的唯一标准。针对这一局限性，我们提出了平衡感知枢纽解码（BPD），该方法倾向于连续掩码区间内的中心枢纽，并并行解码选定位置。平衡枢纽可使区间长度的解码深度呈对数级。我们的实用方法通过结合基于置信度的预填充与置信度阈值的中心选择，考虑了模型不确定性。我们在LLaDA和Dream上对五个数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循基准进行了评估，以检验其质量-效率权衡。相关实现已公开：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLM_random_pivot-EE62/

summary: Every scientific text is embedded in the writing norms of its time: it reflects earlier publications while also shaping the texts that follow. The growing use of LLM-based writing tools introduces a new factor in this evolving system, but the linguistic changes coinciding with their emergence remain insufficiently understood. We investigate whether the trajectories of scientific-preprint writing changed in rate or direction after conversational LLMs became publicly accessible, using the release of ChatGPT in November 2022 as the observational breakpoint. We compare pre- and post-2022 trajectories across vocabulary, punctuation, readability, and syntax in abstracts from arXiv's artificial intelligence, statistics, and quantitative biology categories and from medRxiv. Using interrupted time-series regression, we find substantial post-2022 changes across multiple feature families and research domains, including increases in average word length, reduced formula-based readability, and declines in maximum dependency-tree depth and sentence-level depth variation. Individual features follow different dynamics: some lexical markers accelerate persistently, while others rise and then recede. Our findings show that isolated marker frequencies capture only part of the shift: changes in the rate, direction, and structure of linguistic trajectories provide complementary evidence of broader post-2022 change in scientific-preprint writing. More broadly, these findings motivate monitoring scientific writing as a multidimensional, evolving system rather than through a fixed set of LLM-associated markers.
title: Accelerated Drift of Scientific Prose in the LLM Era: Evidence from an Interrupted Time-Series Analysis
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, including references and appendices
title_translated: 大语言模型时代科学散文的加速演变：基于中断时间序列分析的证据
summary_translated: 每篇科学文本都嵌入于其时代的写作规范之中：它反映了早期的出版物，同时也塑造了后续文本。大语言模型（LLM）写作工具的日益普及为此演化系统引入了新因素，但其出现伴随的语言变化仍理解不足。我们研究了在对话式LLM公开可用后，科学预印本写作轨迹的速率或方向是否发生变化，以2022年11月ChatGPT发布作为观察断点。我们比较了arXiv的人工智能、统计学和定量生物学类别以及medRxiv摘要在词汇、标点、可读性和句法方面的前后2022年轨迹。通过中断时间序列回归分析，我们在多个特征族和研究领域中发现了显著的2022年后变化，包括平均词长增加、基于公式的可读性降低，以及最大依存树深度和句子层面深度变化的下降。个别特征表现出不同动态：一些词汇标记持续加速，而另一些则先上升后回落。我们的发现表明，孤立标记频率仅捕捉了转变的一部分；语言轨迹的速率、方向和结构变化提供了关于2022年后科学预印本写作更广泛变化的补充证据。更广泛地说，这些发现促使我们将科学写作视为一个多维度、动态演化的系统，而非仅通过一组固定的LLM相关标记来监测。

summary: Building capable language models for India requires scalable multilingual data and robust evaluation. We introduce Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1, a synthetic pretraining corpus of approximately 2.83 trillion tokens covering all 22 scheduled Indian languages in native script and twelve in romanized form. It is the largest openly released Indic pretraining corpus. Using our GPU-accelerated pipeline, we translate curated English documents, assess translation quality, and repair low-quality outputs while preserving technical content and document structure and maintaining source traceability. Through continued-pretraining experiments across twelve languages, we show that combining our synthetic corpus with natural Indic text improves knowledge and reasoning over a public-corpus baseline. Additional experiments show how data volume, script coverage, and Indic training share affect English performance. We also introduce the Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite, a multilingual benchmark suite for evaluating Indic language models across chat, instruction following, reasoning, knowledge, code, and translation. The suite combines existing Indic benchmarks with task-aware translations of English benchmarks, using automated quality assessment, targeted correction, and native-speaker review in a human-in-the-loop pipeline. We use the suite to comprehensively benchmark contemporary open-weight Indic and multilingual models across capabilities and languages, revealing substantial variation across tasks and languages. Together, these resources provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating more capable Indic language models.
title: Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs
comment: 44 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and references
title_translated: 印度语大语言模型合成预训练数据与评估的规模化
summary_translated: 构建适用于印度的高效语言模型需要可扩展的多语言数据和稳健的评估体系。我们推出了Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1，一个约2.83万亿标记的合成预训练语料库，涵盖全部22种官方印度语言的原生文字形式，以及12种罗马化形式。这是目前最大且公开发布的印度语预训练语料库。利用我们的GPU加速管道，我们翻译经过筛选的英文文档，评估翻译质量，并修复低质量输出，同时保留技术内容、文档结构并维持源文可追溯性。通过在12种语言上的持续预训练实验，我们证明将合成语料库与自然印度语文本结合，可提升知识和推理能力，优于公共语料库基线。额外实验揭示了数据量、字形覆盖范围及印度语训练占比对英语性能的影响。我们还推出了Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite，一个用于评估印度语模型在聊天、指令遵循、推理、知识、代码和翻译等任务上的多语言基准套件。该套件整合现有印度语基准与任务感知的英文基准翻译，采用自动化质量评估、针对性修正和母语者评审的人机协同流程。我们使用该套件全面评估当前开源权重的印度语及多语言模型在各项能力与语言上的表现，揭示了任务与语言间存在显著差异。这些资源共同构成了开发和评估更强大印度语语言模型的可扩展基础。

summary: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) for complex tasks, yet often overthink easy inputs, increasing token cost and latency, and sometimes degrading accuracy. Existing methods optimize reasoning length during training or impose external control at inference, but leave the underlying reasoning mechanism a black box. We find that fast and slow thinking exhibit distinct expert-routing patterns: holding the input fixed and varying only the prompted reasoning tempo produces stable routing shifts. Suppressing slow-thinking experts shortens the reasoning chain, whereas suppressing fast-thinking experts lengthens it, providing causal evidence that these experts influence reasoning depth. Based on this finding, we propose TempoMoE, a training-free, two-stage framework. It identifies fast- and slow-thinking experts via tempo-contrastive routing analysis and redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty. It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones, enabling difficulty-adaptive control over reasoning depth. We evaluate TempoMoE on Kimi-VL, Qwen3-VL, and ERNIE-4.5-VL across six benchmarks. Compared with Vanilla, TempoMoE consistently improves accuracy while reducing output tokens, with accuracy gains of up to 2.6 points and token reductions of up to 35.4%.
title: TempoMoE: Identifying and Steering Fast-Slow Thinking Experts for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
title_translated: TempoMoE：识别并引导快速-慢速思维专家以实现高效的多模态推理
summary_translated: 多模态专家混合（MoE）推理模型依赖于长链式思维（CoT）完成复杂任务，但常对简单输入过度思考，导致token成本和延迟增加，有时还会降低准确性。现有方法在训练期间优化推理长度或在推理阶段施加外部控制，但并未揭示底层推理机制的本质。我们发现快速思维与慢速思维表现出不同的专家路由模式：在固定输入下仅改变提示的推理节奏，即可产生稳定的路由变化。抑制慢速思维专家可缩短推理链，而抑制快速思维专家则会延长推理链，这为这些专家影响推理深度提供了因果证据。基于此发现，我们提出TempoMoE，一种无需训练的两阶段框架。它通过节奏对比路由分析识别快速与慢速思维专家，并根据样本难度在原始top-k集合内重新分配路由权重。在简单输入上增强快速思维专家并抑制慢速思维专家，在困难输入上则反向调整，从而实现对推理深度的难度自适应控制。我们在Kimi-VL、Qwen3-VL和ERNIE-4.5-VL上跨六个基准进行评估。相比基线模型，TempoMoE始终在提升准确率的同时减少输出token，准确率最高提升2.6个百分点，token消耗最多降低35.4%。

summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.
title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
title_translated: AdaExploreBench：面向动态环境中主动探索与测试时自适应的LLM智能体基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地部署于陌生且不断变化的环境中，要求它们主动探索、理解并适应环境动态。然而，现有基准很少测试智能体是否能主动发现环境运作方式并随环境演变而自适应。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了AdaExploreBench，一个用于动态环境中主动探索与测试时自适应的基准。通过将环境动态建模为隐藏规则，AdaExploreBench要求智能体主动获取证据并推断规则。在隐式规则漂移下，潜在规则在无通知的情况下发生变化，要求智能体从性能下降中检测到先前知识已过时并重新探索。在八种领先LLM上的实验表明，主动且自适应的探索仍然具有挑战性：GPT-6 Sol仅达到61.9%的校准准确率，而提供充分证据或消除规则漂移可使平均性能显著提升近10%。这些结果揭示了当前LLM智能体的一个关键瓶颈：一旦获得信息性证据，它们通常能有效推理，但在主动获取正确证据以及识别先前获取证据不再有效方面仍存在困难。

summary: The user experience of speech interaction models has improved, benefiting from the modeling of paralinguistic attributes and advances in speech reconstruction paradigms. However, human communication follows extensive norms regarding non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) spanning respiratory, affective, and discourse. The omission of these events imposes inherent limitations on the naturalness of current approaches. In this work, we cover 13 major types of NVVs and construct a natural dialogue dataset that conforms to human conversational norms through an automated synthesis pipeline. We enhance the ability of speech interaction models to generate contextually appropriate NVV events through multi-stage fine-tuning and NVV-aware GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization). Based on distinct modeling paradigms, we substantially improve the expressiveness of VocalNet and VITA-Qinyu in empathy interactions and role-play dialogues, and further discuss the architectural necessity for achieving high-quality natural speech generation.
title: Speech LLMs That Breathe: Modeling Non-Verbal Vocalizations in Dialogue
title_translated: 会呼吸的语音大模型：对话中非语言发声的建模
summary_translated: 语音交互模型的用户体验已因韵律属性建模和语音重建范式的进步而得到提升。然而，人类交流遵循广泛的非语言发声（NVVs）规范，涵盖呼吸、情感和话语层面。当前方法忽略这些事件，导致自然性存在固有局限。本文涵盖了13种主要类型的NVVs，并通过自动化合成流程构建了一个符合人类对话规范的自然对话数据集。我们通过多阶段微调和NVV感知的GRPO（组相对策略优化）增强了语音交互模型生成上下文恰当NVV事件的能力。基于不同的建模范式，我们在共情互动和角色扮演对话中显著提升了VocalNet和VITA-Qinyu的表现，并进一步讨论了实现高质量自然语音生成的架构必要性。

summary: The standard Sanskrit lexica are monumental and indispensable, but they cite their attestations as abbreviated references to editions, without links to the digitized texts now widely available and without a translation of the passage, and they naturally do not reflect translations made after them. To address these gaps, we present MITRA-lexicon, a family of corpus-grounded lexica based on span annotations of translation equivalents with Sanskrit as the pivot: Sanskrit-English, derived from the Mitrasamgraha corpus, as well as Sanskrit-Tibetan and Sanskrit-Chinese, derived from the MITRA-parallel corpus of Buddhist literature. In total, the resource comprises 2.18 million headword entries in six directional lexica. Headwords are lemmas and compounds from silver annotations that follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS). Senses are ranked by frequency, and each of the 10.4 million attestations includes its sentence pair, with character offsets of the word and its equivalent. We propose a multi-step pipeline based on grammatical annotation models, fine-tuned large language models, and a teacher-student setup to produce the alignments. We evaluate the lexica against reference dictionaries and manually corrected gold alignments. We release the lexica and the fine-tuned span annotation model, together with a web interface for looking up headwords and their attested senses.
title: MITRA-lexicon: Lexica of attested translations from Sanskrit into English, Tibetan and Chinese
title_translated: MITRA-lexicon：梵语到英语、藏语和汉语的实证翻译词典
summary_translated: 标准梵语词典具有里程碑意义且不可或缺，但其引文仅以简略形式标注版本，未链接至如今广泛可用的数字化文本，也未提供段落翻译，且自然无法反映其后产生的译作。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了MITRA-lexicon，一个基于跨语料库对齐的词典系列，以梵语为枢纽语言：梵英词典源自Mitrasamgraha语料库，梵藏与梵汉词典则来自MITRA佛教文献平行语料库。该资源共包含六种方向的218万条词目条目。词目为来自银色标注的词根和复合词，遵循数字梵语语料库（DCS）标准。义项按频率排序，每条1040万次引证均包含句子对及其词语与对应词的字符偏移量。我们提出了一套多步骤流程，结合语法标注模型、微调的大语言模型及师生协同机制生成对齐结果。我们通过参考词典和人工校正的黄金对齐数据评估了词典性能。我们发布了词典、微调的跨度标注模型以及一个用于查询词目及其引证义项的网页界面。

summary: Long-context language models (LCLMs) power agents that act over long trajectories, from improving a codebase to running research experiments to forecasters that condition on lengthy histories. These applications draw on three distinct long-context capabilities: recall, where the answer is a fact present in the context; state tracking, where the outcome can be computed by performing a series of transformations to a specified state; and pattern learning, where the goal is to make a prediction by sampling from a distribution inferred from many observations. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on the first capability. In this work, we introduce LEAPS (Long-context Evaluation of Adaptive Pattern learning and State tracking), a collection of 12 novel datasets, spanning agentic workflows, behavioral modeling, and forecasting of market and world events. By construction, LEAPS is resistant to data contamination, extends to millions of input tokens, and uses reliable metrics. We evaluate 30 API and open models from 8K to 512K input tokens. LEAPS distinguishes models that perform near perfectly on recall tasks, finding that such models' state tracking and pattern learning abilities can vary significantly and degrade much more dramatically with increasing input lengths--even for pattern learning, where more observations should make learning a theoretically easier task. Moreover, thinking models often underperform their base counterparts, exhausting their generation budget or oversimplifying the task. We hope LEAPS can guide the development of the next generation of LCLMs.
title: LEAPS: Long-context Evaluation of Adaptive Pattern Learning and State Tracking
comment: Code and data available at this https URL
title_translated: LEAPS：自适应模式学习与状态追踪的长上下文评估
summary_translated: 长上下文语言模型（LCLMs）驱动着在长轨迹上行动的智能体，从改进代码库到运行研究实验，再到基于长期历史的预测者。这些应用依赖于三种不同的长上下文能力：回忆（答案是上下文中存在的事实）、状态追踪（可通过一系列变换计算指定状态的结果）以及模式学习（通过从大量观察中推断分布进行预测）。现有基准主要关注第一种能力。本文提出LEAPS（自适应模式学习与状态追踪的长上下文评估），一个包含12个新数据集的集合，涵盖智能体工作流、行为建模以及市场与世界事件的预测。LEAPS具有抗数据污染特性，可扩展至数百万输入标记，并使用可靠指标。我们评估了来自8K至512K输入标记的30个API和开源模型。LEAPS能够区分在回忆任务中表现近乎完美的模型，发现这些模型的状态追踪和模式学习能力差异显著，且随着输入长度增加，性能退化更为剧烈——即使在理论上应因更多观测而更易学习的模式学习任务也是如此。此外，思维模型常表现不如基础模型，因生成预算耗尽或任务过度简化。我们希望LEAPS能引导下一代LCLM的发展。

summary: Sequential knowledge editing in Large Language Models (LLMs) often leads to a degradation of general capabilities due to cumulative parameter interference. In this paper, we revisit prominent projection-based methods like AlphaEdit and reveal a surprising mismatch: their robustness is primarily driven by update regularization rather than the intended null-space projection. Based on this insight, we propose FisherEdit, a theoretically grounded method built on Fisher geometry, which replaces coarse activation-space projections with importance-aware regularization in parameter space. It penalizes changes to sensitive parameters more strongly while retaining flexibility for new facts, and admits an efficient row-wise closed-form solution. Experiments on Llama-3, Qwen2.5, and Olmo-3 across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FisherEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance while better preserving model stability and downstream task accuracy.
title: FisherEdit: Fisher Information Guided Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models
title_translated: FisherEdit：基于费舍尔信息的知识编辑方法
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）中的顺序知识编辑常因累积参数干扰而导致通用能力下降。本文重新审视了如AlphaEdit等主流投影方法，揭示了一个令人意外的不匹配：其鲁棒性主要源于更新正则化，而非预期的零空间投影。基于此洞察，我们提出FisherEdit，一种基于费舍尔几何的理论严谨方法，将粗粒度的激活空间投影替换为参数空间中的重要性感知正则化。该方法更强地惩罚敏感参数的变化，同时保留对新知识的灵活性，并支持高效的逐行闭式解。在Llama-3、Qwen2.5和Olmo-3等多个基准上的实验表明，FisherEdit实现了领先性能，同时更好地保持了模型稳定性与下游任务准确率。

summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance on challenging mathematical and scientific tasks through long chain-of-thought reasoning, but they often suffer from overthinking with unnecessary reasoning steps. Existing truncation-based methods typically detect consecutive trial-answer agreement and force early exit, yet such local stopping signals do not necessarily indicate final-answer stability and can disrupt useful subsequent reflection or verification, potentially leading to performance degradation. We propose consistency-aware logit masking (CALM), a training-free decoding intervention for mitigating overthinking in LRMs. CALM first monitors trial answers at step boundaries and then applies logit masking to action transition point (ATP) tokens such as "Wait", "Alternatively", and "Hmm", suppressing redundant transitional reasoning while allowing the model to continue its thought process more naturally. Experiments across four advanced LRMs and five benchmarks show that CALM reduces token consumption by 18.6%-25.0% compared with full CoT reasoning while maintaining performance, and can even improve accuracy by 0.07%-1.48% by reducing redundant reasoning. LLM-as-a-Judge results also demonstrate that CALM provides more coherent and concise results.
title: CALM: Consistency-Aware Logit Masking in Decoding Space for Mitigating Overthinking of Large Reasoning Models
title_translated: CALM：解码空间中的一致性感知逻辑掩码以缓解大型推理模型的过度思考
summary_translated: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过长链式思维推理在数学和科学等挑战性任务上取得了优异表现，但常出现不必要的推理步骤，即“过度思考”。现有基于截断的方法通常检测连续试答一致并强制提前退出，但此类局部停止信号并不必然代表最终答案的稳定性，可能破坏有用的后续反思或验证，导致性能下降。我们提出一致性感知逻辑掩码（CALM），一种无需训练的解码干预方法，用于缓解LRMs的过度思考。CALM首先在步骤边界监控试答，然后对动作转换点（ATP）标记（如“Wait”、“Alternatively”、“Hmm”）施加逻辑掩码，抑制冗余的过渡推理，同时允许模型更自然地继续思考过程。在四个先进LRMs和五个基准上的实验表明，CALM相比完整链式思维推理减少了18.6%-25.0%的token消耗，同时保持性能，甚至通过减少冗余推理将准确率提升0.07%-1.48%。LLM作为裁判的结果也显示，CALM生成的结果更具连贯性和简洁性。

summary: Large reasoning models often produce lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) traces mixing useful intermediate steps with unnecessary ones. Recent methods explore step-level signals such as attention mass and step entropy to identify and suppress unnecessary steps. Despite their effectiveness, such signals reflect the model's behavior at a step rather than that step's contribution to the answer. To address this, we propose the interventional step credit (ISC), which takes a causal-intervention view and assesses step importance to the reasoning through targeted parameter-level interventions. Building on ISC, we further propose IGPO, which uses ISC to guide fine-grained advantage rescaling in reinforcement learning, reducing redundant steps while preserving the important ones. Experiments across two model scales and nine benchmarks show that IGPO achieves up to 62% average token reduction and better overall performance among compared methods.
title: Learning to Reason Efficiently with Interventional Step Credit
title_translated: 通过干预性步骤信用实现高效推理的学习
summary_translated: 大型推理模型常常生成包含有用中间步骤和冗余步骤的长链式思维（CoT）过程。近期方法探索了注意力质量、步骤熵等步骤级信号来识别并抑制不必要的步骤。尽管这些信号有效，但它们反映的是模型在某一步的行为，而非该步骤对最终答案的实际贡献。为此，我们提出干预性步骤信用（ISC），从因果干预的角度出发，通过针对性的参数级干预评估每一步的重要性。基于ISC，我们进一步提出IGPO方法，利用ISC指导强化学习中的细粒度优势重标定，在减少冗余步骤的同时保留关键步骤。在两种模型规模和九个基准测试上的实验表明，IGPO实现了最高达62%的平均token减少，并在整体性能上优于对比方法。

summary: Financial communication connects numerical accounts of economic activity with explanations of performance, responsibility and future expectations. Arabic financial natural language processing offers methods for studying these connections across corporate reports, market disclosures, journalism and banking interactions. Its contribution to digital humanities depends on retaining the relationship between a computational representation and the document from which it was made. This chapter follows that relationship from source collection and Arabic text processing to the analysis of vocabulary, evaluation, entities, causal attribution and multilingual reporting. It then examines what financial summaries and retrieval-grounded answers preserve or lose, and how dialectal intent detection changes the perspective from institutions speaking to institutions listening. Published Arabic resources are discussed in relation to the questions they were designed to answer, with a distinction between financial pretraining corpora, annotated datasets and evaluation benchmarks. A running constructed example connects the methodological discussion without presenting illustrative analysis as empirical findings. The chapter argues for an account of Arabic financial NLP in which linguistic context, documentary provenance and interpretive judgement remain part of the evidence throughout the analytical process.
title: Arabic Financial NLP
title_translated: 阿拉伯语金融自然语言处理
summary_translated: 金融沟通将经济活动的数值记录与绩效解释、责任归属及未来预期相结合。阿拉伯语金融自然语言处理提供了研究企业报告、市场披露、新闻报道和银行互动中这些联系的方法。其对数字人文领域的贡献取决于计算表示与其来源文档之间关系的保持。本章从源数据收集和阿拉伯语文本处理开始，追踪词汇分析、评估、实体识别、因果归因以及多语言报告的演变；接着探讨金融摘要和基于检索的回答保留或丢失了什么，以及方言意图检测如何改变机构间对话的视角。文章讨论了已发布的阿拉伯语资源与其设计目标之间的关联，区分了金融预训练语料库、标注数据集和评估基准。一个持续构建的示例连接了方法论讨论，但未呈现作为实证发现的分析结果。本文主张一种阿拉伯语金融NLP的范式，其中语言上下文、文档来源和解释判断在整个分析过程中始终作为证据的一部分。

summary: Whether a language model "knows what it knows" matters for trustworthy deployment and for deciding when it should abstain. Prior work usually measures this through one channel: verbalized confidence, a linear probe on hidden states, or agreement among sampled answers (semantic entropy), and often treats these as interchangeable. We compare all three in a pre-registered audit of five Qwen2.5 models (0.5B-7B, including a base/instruct pair at 7B) on factual retrieval (PopQA, SimpleQA) and multi-step reasoning (GSM8K, MATH). First, probes trained on prefill states to predict whether sampled answers will disagree become informative earlier for retrieval (about 7% of layer depth on average) than for reasoning (about 28%). The pre-registered five-layer test supported this only marginally; a finer 21-layer follow-up, designed after those results, supports it more clearly. In most retrieval cells, however, a prompt-only TF-IDF classifier matches the probe, so the early signal may reflect surface features of the question. Second, verbalized confidence is unstable: slightly different prompt templates yield scores that barely correlate. Third, Expected Calibration Error is misleading: verbal confidence looks well calibrated because it clusters near the base rate while discriminating poorly, whereas sampling agreement has worse ECE but about twice the resolution. Of five pre-registered hypotheses, two were falsified, one was partly supported, one was not supported, and one could not be tested because the base model's verbal confidence was degenerate.
title: Measurement Validity and Representation Dynamics of Confidence Signals in Large Language Models
title_translated: 大语言模型中置信度信号的测量有效性与表征动态
summary_translated: 语言模型是否‘知道自己知道什么’对于可信部署以及决定何时应放弃回答至关重要。以往研究通常通过单一渠道衡量这一能力：口头置信度、隐藏状态上的线性探测器，或采样答案的一致性（语义熵），且常将三者视为可互换。我们在五个Qwen2.5模型（0.5B–7B，包括7B的基座/指令对）上进行注册审计，涵盖事实检索（PopQA、SimpleQA）和多步推理（GSM8K、MATH）。首先，针对预填充状态训练的探测器预测采样答案是否不一致，其信息量在检索任务中（平均约7%层深）早于推理任务（约28%层深）显现；注册的五层测试仅略微支持此结论，而后续设计的21层精细测试则更清晰地验证了这一点。然而，在大多数检索场景中，仅依赖提示的TF-IDF分类器已能匹配探测器表现，说明早期信号可能反映问题表面特征。其次，口头置信度不稳定：微小的提示模板差异导致得分相关性极低。第三，期望校准误差（ECE）具有误导性：口头置信度看似校准良好，因其集中在基础率附近，但判别力差；而采样一致性虽ECE较差，但分辨率约为两倍。在五项注册假设中，两项被证伪，一项部分支持，一项未支持，一项因基座模型的口头置信度退化而无法检验。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in language models, yet growing evidence suggests that it mostly sharpens what the base model can already do. This raises a practical question: when RL fails, what is the base model missing? We look inside the RL policy's own rollouts and find that failures are localized: whether a rollout fails is strongly predicted by a small set of characteristic n-grams, ranging from reflection phrases such as "let's recheck" to specific operations such as "the inverse of A". These failures persist throughout RL training, although they are not beyond the model's reach: other sampled answers to the same question are often correct. Building on this observation, we use the failure $n$-grams to retrieve text from the pretraining corpus and continue pretraining the base model on it before RL. The resulting corpus has only 35M tokens, 3--4 orders of magnitude smaller than typical mid-training. We evaluate this approach on OLMo2 and Qwen3 models trained with RL on (1) GSM8K; (2) a mixture of math, commonsense, and knowledge questions; and (3) general math and science reasoning. Despite its size, the corpus yields consistent gains: our approach outperforms continued pretraining on the same amount of text sampled from the pretraining corpus across 10 out of 11 settings, including by $2.0$ points on GSM8K when inserted before mid-training. The retrieved text also transfers across model families: text retrieved for OLMo2-1B's failures improves Qwen3-4B on the mixture by $1.9$ points over the same baseline. Together, our results suggest that where RL fails is a cheap and effective signal for selecting pretraining data.
title: Where RL Breaks: Localizing and Repairing Failures via Targeted Continued Pretraining
title_translated: 强化学习失效之处：通过定向持续预训练定位并修复失败
summary_translated: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）广泛用于提升语言模型的推理能力，但越来越多的证据表明，它主要只是强化了基座模型已有的能力。这引出一个实际问题：当强化学习失败时，基座模型缺失了什么？我们深入分析强化学习策略自身的回放轨迹，发现失败是局部化的：某个轨迹是否失败强烈依赖于一组特定的n-gram特征，如反思短语“让我们重新检查”或具体操作“A的逆”。这些失败贯穿整个强化学习训练过程，尽管并非超出模型能力范围——同一问题的其他采样答案往往正确。基于此观察，我们使用失败的n-gram从预训练语料库中检索文本，并在强化学习前对基座模型进行持续预训练。所生成的语料仅含3500万token，比典型中期训练语料小3到4个数量级。我们在OLMo2和Qwen3模型上评估该方法，这些模型在（1）GSM8K；（2）数学、常识与知识混合问题；（3）通用数理推理任务上进行了强化学习训练。尽管规模小，该方法仍带来稳定提升：在11个设置中的10个上，优于同等规模随机采样的预训练语料持续预训练，尤其在GSM8K上插入中期前提升2.0分。所检索文本还具备跨模型家族迁移能力：为OLMo2-1B失败案例检索的文本使Qwen3-4B在混合任务上提升1.9分。综合来看，强化学习的失效点是一个廉价且有效的预训练数据选择信号。

summary: Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend. Two outputs of the same token length can therefore vary a lot in cost. To understand the underlying factors of this cost variation, we analyze two diffusion models across 10 tasks. We find that the number of forward passes per token depends heavily on the task. Text copied or lightly edited from the input is cheap, while open-ended writing is costly. In DiffusionGemma, generating a token for story writing requires more than three times as many forward passes as for grammar correction. Two output properties explain much of this gap: how much of it is new relative to the input, and how rare its words are within the task. The same holds within a single response when thinking is involved. The final answer is cheap when it repeats the model's reasoning trace and costly when it adds something new. In multilingual generation, we find that highly tokenized languages also require more passes per token, adding to the cost they already pay with more tokens. Finally, cost tracks correctness: on the same math problem, wrong answers take more passes per token than correct ones, and weighting candidate answers by decoding speed beats majority voting by up to 4.2 points at no extra cost. Taken together, our results show that diffusion's computational advantage depends on how much of the output is already determined, while its decoding effort offers a practical signal for making inference more efficient and reliable.
title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
title_translated: 扩散语言模型在不同任务与语言间的生成速度变化
summary_translated: 扩散语言模型可在一次前向传播中生成多个token，并在生成过程中自主决定花费多少次前向传播。因此，相同长度的输出可能在成本上存在巨大差异。为理解这种成本差异的内在因素，我们分析了两种扩散模型在10个任务上的表现。发现每次token所需的前向传播次数高度依赖于任务类型：从输入复制或轻度编辑的内容成本低廉，而开放式写作则代价高昂。在DiffusionGemma中，故事创作生成一个token所需前向传播次数超过语法修正的三倍。这一差距主要由两个输出属性解释：相对于输入的新颖程度，以及词语在任务中的罕见程度。这一规律同样适用于单个响应中涉及思考的情况：当最终答案重复模型的推理轨迹时成本较低，而添加新内容时则成本较高。在多语言生成中，高分词化语言也需更多前向传播次数，加剧了其本身因token数量多带来的成本压力。最后，成本与正确性相关：在同一数学问题上，错误答案的每token前向传播次数高于正确答案；将候选答案按解码速度加权，可比多数投票高出最多4.2分，且无需额外成本。综上所述，扩散模型的计算优势取决于输出中有多少内容已被预先确定，而解码努力本身可作为实用信号，用于提升推理效率与可靠性。

summary: Modals such as may and must can take on different senses depending on discourse context, alternating between root interpretations (e.g., permission, obligation) and epistemic interpretations (e.g., knowledge, belief). While modals are known to be notoriously difficult for children to acquire, limited research exists on whether language models (LMs) can reliably distinguish between different modal senses. We evaluate seven LMs that vary in architecture, size, and training data type using vector-based similarity and surprisal measures across four datasets. Specifically, we investigate whether LMs can leverage contextual information to disambiguate modal senses and whether their performance reflects the distribution of modal senses in their training data. We show that larger LMs trained on diverse text successfully leverage additional contextual information when available. In the absence of context, they tend to favor the dominant sense based on corpus statistics. Smaller developmentally plausible LMs, including those trained on child-directed language (CDL), fail to show consistent sensitivity to modal sense distinctions and do not benefit from context to the same degree.
title: Modal Sense Disambiguation in Language Models: The Role of Context, Training Domain, and Input Frequency
title_translated: 语言模型中模态意义的消歧：上下文、训练领域和输入频率的作用
summary_translated: 诸如'may'和'must'之类的模态词在不同语境下可具有不同的含义，可在根义（如许可、义务）与认识论义（如知识、信念）之间切换。尽管模态词对儿童习得而言极为困难，但关于语言模型（LMs）是否能可靠区分不同模态意义的研究仍有限。我们使用基于向量的相似性与意外度量，在四个数据集上评估了七种架构、规模和训练数据类型各异的语言模型。具体而言，我们探究了语言模型能否利用上下文信息来消歧模态意义，以及其表现是否反映训练数据中模态意义的分布情况。结果表明，经过多样化文本训练的大规模语言模型能够有效利用可用的额外上下文信息；而在缺乏上下文时，则倾向于依据语料库统计选择主导意义。较小的、符合发展规律的语言模型（包括在儿童语言数据上训练的模型）未能表现出对模态意义差异的一致敏感性，也无法像大型模型那样从上下文中获益。

summary: Reflection lets LLM agents improve from their own attempts, but the memory it builds is local to a single task, so an agent reflecting on its own tends to revisit the same explanation for failure. Cross-task reflective memory addresses this in two forms: retrieved memory keeps past experience explicit and looks up related cases, which is specific but bounded by the bank, and parametric memory internalizes experience into parameters, which generalizes but is grounded in nothing beyond the task description. When both are used, existing agents combine them additively, feeding their outputs to the solver side by side, so retrieved experience never changes what the learned memory produces. We introduce CoMem (Compounding Memory), which makes retrieved experience an input to the learned memory itself, at training and at inference. The agent builds a bank of its own successful and failed reflections, learns from retrieved cases to write failure hypotheses, candidate explanations of how an attempt is likely to go wrong, and at test time reasons from newly retrieved cases to guide each attempt. Varying the retrieved cases gives the memory different perspectives, yielding reflective diversity that is not merely sampled but also grounded in retrieved experience. Across two backbones and five benchmarks in math, code, and multi-hop QA, CoMem achieves strong overall performance. Additional evaluations show that it generalizes to out-of-distribution tasks and enables smaller models to provide effective guidance to stronger solvers.
title: CoMem: Learning to Anticipate Failures from Retrieved Experience
title_translated: CoMem：从检索经验中学习预测失败
summary_translated: 反思使大语言模型代理能够从自身尝试中改进，但其构建的记忆局限于单一任务，导致代理在反思时往往重复相同的失败解释。跨任务反思记忆以两种形式存在：检索记忆显式保留过往经验并查找相关案例，具有针对性但受限于记忆库；参数化记忆将经验内化为参数，具备泛化能力但仅基于任务描述。现有代理通常将两者加法式结合，分别将输出提供给求解器，导致检索经验无法影响学习到的记忆。我们提出CoMem（复合记忆），使检索经验成为学习记忆本身的输入，无论在训练还是推理阶段。代理建立自身成功与失败反思的数据库，从检索案例中学习撰写失败假设——即对尝试可能出错方式的候选解释，并在测试时根据新检索案例引导每次尝试。通过改变检索案例，记忆获得不同视角，实现不仅采样且扎根于实际经验的反思多样性。在数学、代码和多跳问答五个基准上，CoMem展现出强劲的整体性能。额外评估显示，它能泛化至分布外任务，并使小型模型有效指导强求解器。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) often generate more reasoning tokens than needed. Limiting the reasoning budget reduces cost, but forcing an answer from an incomplete trace can hurt accuracy. System-1 decision models select among candidate options without producing a reasoning response. We evaluate Jev as a decision reader of truncated reasoning across seven LLM reasoners and five multiple-choice benchmarks (35 pairs). Jev achieves higher mean accuracy than forced answering at tested budgets from 500 to 16,000 tokens, including the estimated costs of reasoning and answering. At a 1,500-token budget, it improves accuracy by 4.1 pp overall and 8.6 pp on truncated questions, with significant gains in 17 pairs under Holm-corrected bootstrap tests. Offline replay estimates 34.5% of the full-run cost, with a 1.13 pp accuracy loss. A policy selected on training folds saves 71.3% of the estimated full-run cost on held-out folds, with a 0.58 pp accuracy loss. We also find that Jev shows strong question-only accuracy, exceeding 500-token forced answering on average (68.0% vs. 65.5%), although this advantage varies by benchmark. These findings suggest that System-1 decision models can complement LLM reasoning and reduce the need for costly reasoning completion.
title: Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-makers
title_translated: 预算限制下的截断推理：评估系统1模型作为决策者的表现
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常生成超出需求的推理标记。限制推理预算可降低成本，但强制从不完整推理轨迹中得出答案可能损害准确性。系统1决策模型在不生成推理响应的情况下从候选选项中进行选择。我们在七种LLM推理器和五个多项选择基准（共35组）上评估Jev作为截断推理的决策阅读器。Jev在测试预算范围（500至16,000令牌）内实现了比强制回答更高的平均准确率，包括推理与回答的估算成本。在1,500令牌预算下，整体准确率提升4.1个百分点，截断问题上提升8.6个百分点，在Holm校正的bootstrap检验中有17组显著提升。离线回放估计全运行成本的34.5%，准确率损失仅1.13个百分点。在训练折上选择的策略在保留折上节省了71.3%的估算全运行成本，准确率损失仅为0.58个百分点。我们还发现，Jev在仅问题条件下的准确率表现强劲，平均超过500令牌强制回答（68.0% vs. 65.5%），尽管该优势因基准而异。这些发现表明，系统1决策模型可补充LLM推理，减少对昂贵推理完成的需求。

summary: Before language models are released, they are tested for harmful traits such as willingness to carry out dangerous requests, deception, power seeking, and sycophancy. The safe behavior these tests certify may degrade as models are modified, by topical fine-tuning, new training data, or changes to settings such as the depth of their reasoning. Most work reports such drift as single summary rates scored by another AI model, without the error analysis needed to interpret them. We adapt a calibrated measurement methodology recently developed for assessing how inference optimizations affect the quality of model outputs. Applying it to several misalignment dimensions in two open-weight models, we first establish the instrument's precision, showing that shifts of a few percentage points can be reliably detected. We then induce drift deliberately by fine-tuning on correct and on subtly harmful medical and financial advice; harmful advice induces a far greater shift than correct advice. Most strikingly, a model that reasons before answering can conceal the shift almost entirely in its answers, even though a direct reading of its internal state shows that its disposition has moved. With reasoning switched off, the same model shifts steadily as the share of harmful advice in its training grows. These results demonstrate the importance of testing safety with reasoning turned both on and off.
title: A Calibrated Instrument for Detecting Disposition Drift in Language Models
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 一种用于检测语言模型倾向漂移的校准工具
summary_translated: 在语言模型发布前，需测试其是否存在有害特征，如执行危险请求的意愿、欺骗行为、权力追求和阿谀奉承。这些测试所认证的安全行为可能在模型被修改后发生退化，例如主题微调、新训练数据或推理深度等设置变化。现有研究通常以另一AI模型评分的单一汇总率报告此类漂移，缺乏必要的误差分析来解释结果。我们借鉴近期为评估推理优化对模型输出质量影响而开发的校准测量方法。将其应用于两个开源权重模型的多个非对齐维度，首先验证了该工具的精度，表明几个百分点的变化可被可靠检测。随后，我们通过在正确和微妙有害的医疗及金融建议上进行微调，刻意诱导漂移；结果显示，有害建议引起的漂移远大于正确建议。最引人注目的是，一个在回答前进行推理的模型几乎完全掩盖了这种漂移，其答案中未体现变化，尽管内部状态的直接读取显示其倾向已发生转移。当关闭推理功能时，同一模型随着有害建议占比增加而稳步发生偏移。这些结果强调了在推理开启与关闭两种状态下测试安全性的必要性。

summary: LLM unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or unwanted knowledge while preserving useful capabilities. As LLM teams are increasingly used to solve complex problems, forgetting must remain effective during collaboration. Despite advances in forgetting effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness to relearning, team deployment remains underexplored. We find that collaboration weakens forgetting: final-answer evaluations miss recoverable evidence in team messages, including complementary clues supporting joint recovery. We establish theoretically and confirm empirically that controlling final answers or individual messages does not ensure low recovery from their combination. To address this challenge, we propose Aggregation-Conditioned Unlearning (ACU). ACU trains a shared model using reconstruction feedback from individual and pooled messages, prioritizes views with higher recovery risk, and uses replacement-based credit assignment while protecting direct and collaborative utility. TOFU evaluates trajectory-level recovery, while WMDP-bio tests native forgetting and retained utility. On TOFU, ACU lowers full-trajectory recovery from 41.8% to 19.3% in ROUGE-L recall and factual recovery from 34.2% to 18.7% versus output-supervised training, with comparable retained-task performance. These results demonstrate that ACU curbs information leakage in LLM teams and generalizes across team sizes and readers.
title: Does Unlearning Survive Collaboration? Robust Unlearning for Shared-Model LLM Teams
title_translated: 遗忘能否经受协作考验？面向共享模型LLM团队的鲁棒遗忘机制
summary_translated: LLM遗忘对于删除敏感或不想要的知识同时保留有用能力至关重要。随着LLM团队越来越多地用于解决复杂问题，遗忘必须在协作过程中依然有效。尽管在遗忘效果、效率和抗重学能力方面已有进展，但团队部署仍研究不足。我们发现协作会削弱遗忘：最终答案评估忽略了团队消息中可恢复的证据，包括支持联合恢复的互补线索。我们从理论上建立并实证确认，仅控制最终答案或单个消息无法确保其组合后的低恢复率。为应对这一挑战，我们提出聚合条件遗忘（ACU）。ACU通过个体与聚合消息的重构反馈训练共享模型，优先处理高恢复风险的视角，并采用基于替换的信用分配机制，在保护直接与协作效用的同时防止信息泄露。TOFU用于评估轨迹级恢复，WMDP-bio则测试原生遗忘与保留效用。在TOFU上，ACU将完整轨迹恢复率从41.8%降至19.3%（ROUGE-L召回），事实恢复率从34.2%降至18.7%，相比输出监督训练，保留任务性能相当。这些结果表明，ACU有效抑制了LLM团队中的信息泄露，并在不同团队规模和读者间具有泛化能力。

summary: Sycophancy, where an LLM becomes overly agreeable, deferential, or flattering toward the user, has been identified as a major failure mode. While post-training has been implicated as a cause, how it internally gives rise to sycophantic behavior remains insufficiently understood. Post-training transforms the model's output from text completion into utterances directed toward an addressee, thereby giving the output \textit{addressivity}. We hypothesize that the accompanying pressure to follow the addressee's instructions and align with their preferences links this addressivity to sycophancy. To test this, we use Sparse Autoencoders to extract addressivity directions from pre-trained and post-trained models and examine their relationship with sycophancy. Steering models with addressivity directions can amplify or suppress sycophancy, and this effect is observed only in post-trained models. Furthermore, comparing the internal mechanisms of both model types confirms that the association between addressivity and sycophancy is strengthened through post-training. Finally, through a controlled post-training experiment, we find that models are sycophantic not toward a specific addressee but toward any recognized addressee, suggesting that the presence of an addressee, rather than the addressee's identity, is what elicits sycophancy.
title: No Matter Who You Are: Addressivity and Sycophancy in Large Language Models
title_translated: 无论你是谁：大语言模型中的指向性与奉承行为
summary_translated: 奉承行为，即大语言模型对用户表现出过度顺从、谦卑或阿谀奉承的倾向，已被识别为一种主要的失败模式。尽管后训练过程被认为是一个成因，但其内部如何引发奉承行为仍理解不足。后训练将模型输出从文本补全转变为面向特定接收者的言语表达，从而赋予输出‘指向性’。我们假设，伴随而来的遵循接收者指令和与其偏好保持一致的压力，使指向性与奉承行为相关联。为验证这一假设，我们使用稀疏自编码器从预训练和后训练模型中提取指向性方向，并考察其与奉承行为的关系。通过指向性方向操控模型可放大或抑制奉承行为，且该效应仅在后训练模型中观察到。此外，对比两类模型的内部机制确认，指向性与奉承行为之间的关联在后训练过程中得到加强。最后，通过受控的后训练实验，我们发现模型并非针对特定接收者表现出奉承，而是对任何被识别的接收者都会如此，表明接收者的存在而非其身份是诱发奉承的关键因素。

summary: Automated essay scoring (AES) using large language models (LLMs) offers promising use cases for language assessment, yet high-stakes testing requires scores that are both controllable and verifiable, which current LLM-based scorers lack. Given that, we investigate whether LLM-based scorers form distinct internal representations for individual scoring rubrics and whether these representations can be independently controlled. Probing and steering 25 open-weight base LLMs (0.13B-10.31B parameters; 14 families) on human-scored BESTEP English writing tasks, we find that holistic scores are decodable from model activations for the longer tasks (Parts 2 and 3) and only weakly for the shortest (Part 1). Furthermore, scoring rubrics have partly separable directions in representation space for the longer tasks, though not for short responses (Part 1). However, causal steering reveals a critical limitation: applying a matching intervention (e.g., steering "grammar" on a grammar-degraded response) yields only a negligible advantage (about 2% of the effect) over a mismatched intervention (e.g., steering "vocabulary"), and none that is detectable in any of the 10 testable comparisons across reliably measured rubrics. Rather than controlling distinct evaluative dimensions, the rubric directions share a dominant lever whose rubric-specific parts are not selective, which may mirror the halo structure of human ratings. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we show that analytic scoring rubrics designed for human raters do not behave as independent controls in base LLMs, even among the seven models whose scores agree best with human raters ($r \geq 0.6$). Second, we establish a methodology that shows that score agreement and decodability do not imply rubric-level control in LLM-based assessment.
title: Inside the Scorer: Mechanistic Evidence on Rubric Control in LLM-Based Automated Essay Scoring from 25 Base Models
comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted to PACLIC 40 (The 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation); to be presented in Taipei, Taiwan, December 10-12, 2026. Code at this https URL
title_translated: 评分器内部探析：基于25个基础模型的LLM自动作文评分中评分量表控制的机制证据
summary_translated: 利用大语言模型（LLM）进行自动作文评分（AES）在语言评估中展现出巨大潜力，但高风险测试要求评分具备可控性和可验证性，而当前基于LLM的评分器尚不具备这些特性。因此，我们研究了基于LLM的评分器是否为各个评分量表形成独立的内部表示，以及这些表示能否被独立控制。我们在25个开源权重的基础LLM（参数规模0.13B-10.31B；14个模型家族）上对人类评分的BESTEP英语写作任务进行探测和操控，发现对于较长的任务（第2和第3部分），整体分数可以从模型激活中解码出来，而对于最短的任务（第1部分）则仅能弱解码。此外，对于较长任务，评分量表在表示空间中具有部分可分离的方向，但在短回答（第1部分）中则不明显。然而，因果操控揭示了一个关键局限：应用匹配干预（如对语法退化的回答进行语法操控）相较于不匹配干预（如进行词汇操控）仅带来约2%的效果提升，且在所有10个可测试的可靠量表比较中均无法检测到显著差异。这表明，评分量表方向共享一个主导控制杠杆，其量表特异性部分并不具备选择性，可能反映了人类评分中的光环效应结构。我们的贡献有两点：第一，我们证明了为人类评分员设计的分析性评分量表在基础LLM中并未作为独立控制变量运作，即使在与人类评分一致性最高的七种模型中（相关系数$r \>= 0.6$）也是如此；第二，我们建立了一种方法论，表明评分一致性与可解码性并不意味着LLM评估中的量表级控制。

summary: Language models often change answers because of a cue, a hint such as "I believe the answer is B" that gives no valid evidence. Consistency training (CT) trains a model to answer the same with and without the cue. Four CT methods apply this idea to output tokens (BCT), residual activations (ACT), attention patterns (AttCT) and sampled-answer rates (RMCT). Prior work suggests some learn different solutions. We train all four on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the same data. We test predictions written in advance and inspect the models with a known circuit that carries cues to the answer. All four make the trained cue less effective, and their fixes share three properties. First, correct cues lose about as much influence as wrong ones. Second, the fix is usually large for cues before the answer options, as in training, and much smaller after them. Llama RMCT depends least on position. Third, the circuit heads still carry most remaining cue-induced errors. Making BCT targets depend on the cue's correctness mostly weakens the fix. CT thus weakens the trained cue without teaching models when a cue is right. Evaluations with only wrong cues at the trained position miss the first two properties.
title: Consistency Training Suppresses Cue Following Without Teaching Cue Selectivity
title_translated: 一致性训练抑制线索依赖，而不传授线索选择能力
summary_translated: 语言模型常因线索（如“我认为答案是B”）而改变回答，这类线索虽无有效证据支持。一致性训练（CT）旨在让模型在有无线索的情况下给出相同答案。四种CT方法分别作用于输出标记（BCT）、残差激活（ACT）、注意力模式（AttCT）和采样答案频率（RMCT）。先前研究认为它们可能学习到不同解决方案。我们在Gemma-2-2B-it和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上使用相同数据训练全部四种方法，并提前设定预测进行测试，同时借助已知的携带线索至答案的电路结构对模型进行检查。结果显示，四种方法均降低了训练线索的有效性，且修复机制具有三个共同特征：第一，正确线索与错误线索的影响减弱程度相当；第二，修复效果在答案选项前的线索位置较大，而在之后则显著减小，Llama RMCT对此位置依赖最小；第三，电路头仍承载着大部分残留的线索诱导错误。若让BCT目标依赖于线索正确性，反而会削弱修复效果。因此，CT在削弱训练线索的同时，并未教会模型何时线索是正确的。仅在训练位置使用错误线索的评估会遗漏前两个特性。

summary: Knowledge acquisition from black-box large language models (LLMs) offers a practical approach to adapting smaller student models. However, many existing methods rely on predefined queries or student feedback to guide acquisition, leaving autonomous expansion of knowledge targets an important challenge. We propose \textbf{MapSteal}, a student-independent framework for structured recursive knowledge acquisition. Starting from a small set of initial roots, MapSteal represents acquisition targets using structured states and recursively expands them through teacher-proposed directions. Question realization, proposal admission, and deduplication constrain the acquisition process, while root-aware scheduling organizes exploration under a fixed QA budget. The resulting question--answer pairs are used to adapt student models without requiring student feedback during acquisition. Experiments with Qwen3.5 students at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales show competitive downstream performance across six medical and cybersecurity benchmarks. On the 4B medical evaluation, Full MapSteal improves average accuracy by 1.17 percentage points over a simplified recursive acquisition variant. Cross-domain evaluations show that gains depend on the domain and evaluation panel. These results demonstrate the feasibility of structured, student-independent recursive acquisition while highlighting the distinction between generating acquisition targets and obtaining useful training supervision. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal} {https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal}.
title: MapSteal: Map-based Autonomous Knowledge Stealing Attack Against Large Language Models
title_translated: MapSteal：针对大语言模型的地图式自主知识窃取攻击
summary_translated: 从黑盒大语言模型（LLM）中获取知识为小型学生模型的适配提供了实用路径。然而，许多现有方法依赖预设查询或学生反馈来引导知识获取，导致自主扩展知识目标成为重要挑战。我们提出	extbf{MapSteal}，一种无需学生参与的结构化递归知识获取框架。从少量初始根节点出发，MapSteal使用结构化状态表示获取目标，并通过教师提出的指导方向递归扩展。问题生成、提议接纳与去重机制约束获取过程，而根节点感知调度则在固定问答预算下组织探索。生成的问答对可用于学生模型的适配，无需在获取阶段依赖学生反馈。在Qwen3.5学生模型（2B、4B、9B规模）上的实验显示，在六个医学与网络安全基准上均取得具有竞争力的下游性能。在4B规模的医学评估中，完整版MapSteal相比简化递归获取变体平均准确率提升1.17个百分点。跨领域评估表明，增益取决于领域和评估小组。这些结果展示了结构化、学生无关的递归获取的可行性，同时突显了生成获取目标与获得有用训练监督之间的区别。代码已公开于https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal。

summary: It has long been proposed that animals construct cognitive maps to support flexible behavior in novel environments. We tested whether large language models form similar representations using relational reasoning tasks and causal "mosaic experiments" that manipulate internal activations in open-weight language models. Models beyond the ten-billion-parameter scale successfully inferred unstated relationships between entities and generalized to synthetic entity names. Across model and task families, models generated abstract representations of relational structure and combined them additively with representations of entity identity, binding entities to roles within that structure. Models stored observed relationships as pairwise links that they composed retrospectively when queried, rather than prospectively positioning each entity in a global coordinate system. Binding was mediated by a sparse, distributed set of key--value pairs; by perturbing these pairs, we implanted "false memories" that altered model behavior in predictable ways. Overall, our findings reveal an internal organization analogous to a cognitive map that explains how language models reason with limited information.
title: Cognitive Map in Large Language Models
title_translated: 大语言模型中的认知地图
summary_translated: 长期以来，人们提出动物会构建认知地图以支持在新环境中的灵活行为。我们通过关系推理任务和因果“马赛克实验”（操纵开放权重语言模型的内部激活）检验大语言模型是否形成类似表征。超过十亿参数规模的模型成功推断出实体间未明示的关系，并推广至合成实体名称。在不同模型和任务类别中，模型生成了关系结构的抽象表示，并将其与实体身份表示相加，将实体绑定到该结构中的角色。模型将观察到的关系存储为成对链接，仅在查询时才回溯组合，而非前瞻性地将每个实体置于全局坐标系中。绑定由一组稀疏分布的键值对中介；通过扰动这些对，我们植入了“虚假记忆”，并以可预测方式改变了模型行为。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了一种类似于认知地图的内部组织结构，解释了语言模型如何在信息有限的情况下进行推理。

summary: Moore's paradox \citep{moore1942} concerns sentences such as ``It is raining, but I don't believe that it is,'' which may well be true yet cannot be sensibly asserted. The absurdity lies not in the content but in the act, since to assert is to vouch for one's own belief. This makes the paradox a test of whether language models take the speech act into account when computing meaning. We present the first test of Moore's paradox in LLMs, evaluating 12 models on a curated set of Moorean sentences in varied contexts. We find that models largely recognize the infelicity of Moorean sentences, and that the judgement is not tied to a memorized form and tracks the speech act. Using the Rational Speech Act framework (RSA; \citealt{goodmanfrank2016}), we then test whether these judgements arise from a listener reasoning about a speaker. We find the models' own listeners do not reason about their own speakers, and their reasoning traces suggest that they instead recall knowledge about the paradox and apply rules therein. The models thus appear to have learned the paradox as a fact about sentences, not as a requirement on speakers.
title: Assertion and Belief: Moore's Paradox in Language Models
title_translated: 断言与信念：语言模型中的摩尔悖论
summary_translated: 摩尔悖论 —— 如‘天在下雨，但我并不相信天在下雨’这类句子，可能为真却无法被合理地断言。其荒谬之处不在于内容，而在于断言这一行为本身，因为断言意味着对自身信念的担保。这使得该悖论成为检验语言模型在计算语义时是否考虑言语行为的测试工具。我们首次对大语言模型（LLMs）进行了摩尔悖论测试，评估了12个模型在不同情境下的摩尔式句子表现。结果发现，模型普遍能识别摩尔句式的不当性，且判断不依赖于记忆的固定形式，而是追踪言语行为。基于理性言语行为框架（RSA），我们进一步检验这些判断是否源于对说话者心理状态的推理。结果显示，模型自身的听者并未对其说话者进行推理，其推理路径表明它们更倾向于回忆关于该悖论的知识并应用其中规则。因此，模型似乎将该悖论学习为句子层面的事实，而非对说话者的规范要求。

summary: Recent work suggests that activation dynamics--how representations change during inference--might be more revealing about language model behavior than static readouts from individual layers. In this work, we investigate the layer-wise evolution of representations of factuality, using true and false statements when the model is prompted to either lie or to be honest. We report a geometric phenomenon in which the factuality directions extracted from the lying and honest conditions appear to rotate away from each other across layers. We find that such layer-wise rotation also occurs in a task that requires the model to take different visual perspectives in the 3D world, suggesting that the rotation phenomenon might be indicative of manipulating conceptual spaces in general, rather than unique to factuality. We then investigate the "real time" transformation of conceptual representations on a trial-to-trial basis. We show that it is possible to make strong predictions about the model's target task and behavior from trajectories alone. In addition, diverging points in single-trial trajectories correspond to the onset of rotation in aggregated-trial analysis. Finally, we show that both rotation and divergent trajectories occur in more naturalistic settings in which models are not overtly prompted to "lie" but rather report false statements in the course of completing a different task.
title: Representations in Motion: Layer-wise Rotation and Trajectory Divergence in LLMs
title_translated: 动态表征：大语言模型中层间旋转与轨迹发散
summary_translated: 近期研究表明，激活动态——即推理过程中表征的变化方式——可能比单层静态读出更能揭示语言模型的行为特征。本文研究了事实性表征在各层间的演化过程，通过提示模型说谎或诚实，分别使用真实和虚假陈述进行分析。我们发现一种几何现象：从说谎和诚实条件中提取的事实性方向在各层之间呈现出相互旋转的趋势。我们还发现，在需要模型在三维世界中采取不同视觉视角的任务中也存在类似的层间旋转，表明这种旋转现象可能普遍反映概念空间的操控，而不仅限于事实性。随后，我们考察了概念表征在单次试验中的实时转换。结果表明，仅凭轨迹即可对模型的目标任务和行为做出强预测。单次轨迹中的分歧点与聚合分析中旋转的起始点相对应。最后，我们发现即使在模型未被明确要求‘说谎’，而是在完成其他任务时自然报告虚假陈述的更真实场景中，旋转和轨迹发散现象依然存在。

summary: This study presents a large-scale quantitative analysis of 5.4 million video   titles from xHamster, the world's fourth most visited pornography platform, to   examine linguistic patterns used to describe different dimensions of   identities (e.g., race and gender). Specifically, we investigate how   nationalities, ethnic groups, and gender identities are portrayed in   pornographic discourse, focusing on stereotypes and deviations from implicit   norms of pornography. The results show the dominance of American pornography   over other groups, which acts as the de facto norm for the adult industry. We   identify persistent ethnic stereotypes reflecting colonial power dynamics,   religious fetishization, and the sexualization of cultural taboos. The   analysis reveals gendered representational differences across cultures, with a   prevalent Madonna-Whore dichotomy in the portrayal of women and stereotypical   depictions of men in physically dominant roles.
title: Flattening Fantasies: Analyzing Stereotypes in Pornographic Discourse
title_translated: 扁平化幻想：色情话语中刻板印象的分析
summary_translated: 本研究对全球访问量第四大的色情平台xHamster上的540万条视频标题进行了大规模定量分析，以考察描述身份不同维度（如种族和性别）的语言模式。具体而言，我们探究了国籍、族裔群体和性别身份在色情话语中的呈现方式，重点关注刻板印象及对色情行业隐含规范的偏离。研究结果显示，美国色情内容在整体上占据主导地位，成为成人产业的默认标准。我们识别出反映殖民权力关系的持续族裔刻板印象、宗教神秘化以及对文化禁忌的性化现象。分析还揭示了跨文化背景下性别表征的差异，女性形象普遍存在圣母-娼妓二分法，而男性则多被刻板描绘为身体占优的角色。

summary: Emotion classification from text is challenging because many affective states are distinguished by subtle linguistic signals and semantically overlapping boundaries.
