We investigate whether compact quantum modules can serve as targeted residual specialists that assist traditional classifiers on difficult emotion decisions. We introduce EmotiQ, a residual specialist framework for text emotion classification using a frozen transformer classifier as the primary decision maker, identifies challenging emotion boundaries from validation behavior, and trains boundary specialists, including quantum encodings, data re-uploading specialists, prototype and fidelity specialists, and kernel-based specialists. Specialists are permitted to intervene only when they satisfy validation-based admission criteria. We evaluate the framework across six text emotion classification datasets and establish traditional model baselines. Experimental results show that the admitted EmotiQ policy improves mean macro-F1 metrics over the baseline, and achieves positive gains on five of six datasets. Among the quantum components, ZZ interaction feature maps are the most consistently effective, yielding a mean macro-F1 improvement of +0.0030 and positive gains on four datasets. These findings suggest that current quantum NLP methods can be deployed as residual specialists that provide localized improvements under strong classical supervision.
title: EmotiQ: A Quantum Residual Specialist Framework for Text Emotion Classification
title_translated: EmotiQ：面向文本情感分类的量子残差专家框架
summary_translated: 从文本中进行情感分类极具挑战性，因为许多情感状态由细微的语言信号区分，且语义边界高度重叠。我们探讨了紧凑型量子模块能否作为针对性的残差专家，辅助传统分类器处理复杂情感决策。为此，我们提出了EmotiQ，一种基于冻结Transformer分类器作为主决策者、从验证行为中识别困难情感边界，并训练多种边界专家（包括量子编码、数据重上传专家、原型与保真度专家、核方法专家）的残差专家框架。专家仅在满足基于验证的准入标准时才可介入。我们在六个文本情感分类数据集上评估该框架，并建立传统模型基线。实验结果表明，经采纳的EmotiQ策略在平均宏F1指标上优于基线，并在六组数据中的五组取得正向提升。在量子组件中，ZZ相互作用特征映射最为稳定有效，平均宏F1提升达+0.0030，并在四组数据中实现正向增益。这些发现表明，当前的量子NLP方法可作为残差专家，在强经典监督下提供局部优化。

summary: Previous work has argued that multilingual LLMs encode language-specific features most strongly in their initial and final layers, implying that intermediate layers support language-agnostic representations. This paper reconsiders this finding by performing four different experiments: three that undertake a fine-grained analysis of representations of Portuguese and Spanish, two closely related languages, and one large-scale language identification experiment that covers over 200 languages. The results of these experiments challenge the strict separation between language-specific and language-agnostic layers in multilingual LLMs, using Llama 3.2 1B as a test case. By analyzing and manipulating contextual sentence embeddings, we demonstrate that language identity remains strongly recoverable throughout the model rather than being restricted to initial and final layers. Moreover, we find that the model tends to classify ambiguous strings as closer to Spanish than to Portuguese, revealing a skew in model behavior that differs from human judgments.
title: Where Are Language-Specific Features Represented in Multilingual LLMs? Everywhere
title_translated: 语言特定特征在多语言大模型中如何表征？无处不在
summary_translated: 先前研究认为，多语言大模型主要在初始层和最终层编码语言特定特征，而中间层支持语言无关的表征。本文通过四项不同实验重新审视这一观点：三项针对葡萄牙语和西班牙语（两种密切相关的语言）的细粒度表征分析，一项覆盖200多种语言的大规模语言识别实验。以Llama 3.2 1B为测试案例，实验结果挑战了语言特定与语言无关层之间的严格划分。通过对上下文句子嵌入的分析与操作，我们证明语言身份在整个模型中仍具有高度可恢复性，而非局限于初始和最终层。此外，我们发现模型倾向于将模糊字符串归类为更接近西班牙语而非葡萄牙语，揭示出模型行为存在偏差，与人类判断不同。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning treats the expert demonstration or gold response as a one-hot target, suppressing valid alternative continuations that the model would otherwise assign probability to. We propose Gold-Conditioned Distillation (GCD), a method that turns expert demonstrations into model-native supervision. GCD uses one model as both teacher and student: the teacher conditions on a prompt containing the gold response in context, the student conditions on the original prompt as at inference, and the student is trained to minimize the forward KL divergence to the teacher's next-token distribution at each gold response token. This lets the model use its prior knowledge to teach itself the new task: correctness is anchored by the gold response, while the soft target preserves plausible alternatives. Across various training tasks on Qwen and Llama models, GCD improves new-task accuracy over SFT and generally reduces degradation on general benchmarks.
title: Self-Distillation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 监督微调中的自蒸馏
summary_translated: 监督微调将专家示范或黄金响应视为独热目标，抑制了模型本应赋予概率的其他有效延续。我们提出黄金条件蒸馏（GCD），一种将专家示范转化为模型原生监督的方法。GCD使用同一模型作为教师和学生：教师基于包含黄金响应上下文的提示进行条件化，学生基于原始提示进行条件化，与推理时一致，学生通过最小化前向KL散度来匹配教师在每个黄金响应标记处的下一个词分布。这使模型能够利用其先验知识自我教学新任务：正确性由黄金响应锚定，而软目标则保留了合理的替代方案。在Qwen和Llama模型上的多种训练任务中，GCD相较于SFT提升了新任务准确率，并普遍降低了通用基准上的性能退化。

summary: How well can transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) retain and recall memories in long contexts of dialogue? LLMs are known to forget long-range factual information in their context, yet the field lacks a comprehensive benchmark to quantitatively assess these shortcomings. We present DiaLong, a long-context dialogue dataset and accompanying memory task that standardizes evaluation in this space. It consists of 100 unique conversations created by humans and then augmented with LLMs, extending beyond lengths found in existing datasets. Our selected memory task is fact recall: classify 40 candidate facts about a dialogue as true or false. This task directly probes the model's ability to actively retain and retrieve information, serving as a critical measure of memory within extended conversational contexts. In testing both the latest LLMs and proposed memory enhancements on DiaLong, we demonstrate that more work needs to be done to enable LLMs with better memory performance. By enhancing memory capabilities, LLMs can improve in maintaining coherence, relevance, and human-like interaction over extended conversation. Improving these capabilities will help LLMs fulfill diverse user needs and expectations in various conversational scenarios.
title: DiaLong: Benchmarking Reminiscence in Long-Context Dialogues
comment: 17 pages. Work conducted in 2023 at Johns Hopkins University
title_translated: DiaLong：长上下文对话中的回忆能力基准测试
summary_translated: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（LLMs）在长对话上下文中保留和回忆记忆的能力如何？众所周知，LLMs会遗忘上下文中的长程事实信息，但该领域缺乏一个全面的基准来定量评估这些缺陷。我们提出了DiaLong，一个长上下文对话数据集及配套的记忆任务，标准化了这一领域的评估。该数据集由100个由人类创建并经LLM扩展的唯一对话组成，长度超过现有数据集。我们选定的记忆任务是事实召回：判断关于对话的40个候选事实是否为真。该任务直接探测模型主动保留和检索信息的能力，是衡量长对话上下文中记忆表现的关键指标。在对最新LLMs及提出的记忆增强方法进行测试后，我们表明仍需更多工作以提升LLMs的记忆性能。通过增强记忆能力，LLMs可在长时间对话中更好地保持连贯性、相关性和类人交互。提升这些能力将有助于LLMs满足各种对话场景下的用户需求与期望。

summary: Small language models have improved to the point where a phone can plausibly screen its own calls, answering on an absent owner's behalf without sending call content off the device, a privacy-respecting alternative to cloud call handling. Realizing that promise takes a model that can do two things well: reply within the owner's authority during the call, and afterward tell the owner what happened and what needs attention. Released small models do neither reliably - they raise unwarranted alarms about ordinary callers and write summaries that drop material conditions or report a caller's claims as fact - and real calls supply no reference replies or summaries to learn from. We construct supervision for both tasks from synthetic calls under an information-boundary constraint: a caller writer works from a private scenario brief, a reply writer sees only the conversation up to the current turn, and a summary writer sees the completed transcript. Separate model-based reviews of the full dialogue and the summary decide which calls enter training, yielding a corpus of 3,395 calls with 15,102 targets (11,707 reply, 3,395 summary). Training a single shared LoRA adapter on both tasks, we evaluate six models (0.6-4B parameters) before and after adaptation on 192 held-out calls. Reply qualification rises from 21-54% to 94-97% and summary qualification from 0-6% to 43-72%; all twelve paired gains (six models x two tasks) have bootstrap intervals above zero, and the summary gains hold in every source family. Because one model both screened the training data and scored the outputs, these rates measure agreement with that evaluator's standard rather than human acceptance, which a planned human study will test. After adaptation, coherence and naturalness failures nearly vanish, leaving grounding and usefulness - faithfully tracking who said what, under which conditions - as the remaining challenge.
title: Quality-Controlled Reply and Summary Data for Post-Training Small Language Models in AI Call-Screening Agents
title_translated: 用于AI电话筛选智能体后训练小语言模型的质量控制回复与摘要数据
summary_translated: 小型语言模型已发展到足以让手机自主筛选来电的程度，能够在不将通话内容发送至云端的情况下代表缺席主人应答，这是一种尊重隐私的替代云处理方式。实现这一承诺需要一个能良好完成两项任务的模型：在通话期间以主人权限作出回应，以及事后向主人说明发生了什么及需要关注的内容。现有的小型模型无法可靠地完成这两项任务——它们会对普通来电产生不必要的警报，并撰写遗漏关键条件或把来电者陈述当作事实的摘要。真实通话无法提供可参考的回复或摘要用于学习。我们构建了受信息边界约束的合成通话数据来生成两任务的监督信号：呼叫编写者基于私密情景简报，回复编写者仅能看到当前回合之前的对话，摘要编写者则能看到完整的对话记录。通过独立模型对完整对话和摘要的评审决定哪些通话进入训练，最终形成包含3,395通通话、共15,102个目标（11,707个回复，3,395个摘要）的数据集。我们在六个模型（0.6-4B参数）上训练单一共享LoRA适配器，并在192通保留通话上评估适配前后表现。回复合格率从21-54%提升至94-97%，摘要合格率从0-6%提升至43-72%；所有十二项成对增益（六模型×两任务）的Bootstrap置信区间均高于零，且摘要增益在每个模型家族中均成立。由于同一模型既负责筛选训练数据又评分输出，这些指标衡量的是与该评估者标准的一致性，而非人类接受度，后者将在计划的人类研究中验证。适配后，连贯性和自然性问题几乎消失，剩余挑战在于真实性与有用性——忠实追踪谁说了什么、在何种条件下。

summary: Building and expanding access to digital archives supports language reclamation and creates lasting resources for community revitalization. Designing effective tools to support these efforts requires taking into account the community-, language-, and document-specific context. We investigate how small ($\leq$3B) vision-language models (VLMs) can be adapted as optical character recognition (OCR) tools for Lakota, a North American Indigenous language. In addition to benchmarking modeling approaches, we inspect four practical facets of low-resource archival OCR that arise in previous work and conversations with community members: constrained training budgets, segmentation noise, scan degradation, and orthographic variance. We demonstrate that fine-tuning VLMs for OCR post-correction on 35 pages of transcribed data decreases character error rate (CER) from 17.1 to 3.9\% on a bilingual corpus, and find that training only with nine pages increases CER by only 1.1\% over this. However, evaluating under realistic automatic segmentation nearly doubles the CER of the best-performing models, stressing the importance of taking realistic use cases into account. We hope this work encourages future research on developing language technologies grounded in the workflows and constraints of ongoing revitalization efforts.
title: Design Considerations in Low-Resource Archival OCR: A Case Study in Lakota
title_translated: 低资源档案OCR的设计考量：以拉科塔语为例的案例研究
summary_translated: 构建和扩大数字档案的访问支持语言复兴，并为社区振兴创造持久资源。设计有效的工具以支持这些努力，需要考虑社区、语言和文档特定的背景。我们研究小型（≤3B）视觉-语言模型（VLMs）如何被适配为拉科塔语（北美原住民语言）的光学字符识别（OCR）工具。除了基准测试建模方法外，我们还考察了先前研究和与社区成员交流中出现的低资源档案OCR的四个实际方面：受限的训练预算、分割噪声、扫描质量退化和正字法差异。我们证明，在35页转录数据上对VLM进行OCR后校正的微调，可使双语语料库的字符错误率（CER）从17.1%降至3.9%；仅用九页数据训练时，CER仅增加1.1%。然而，在现实自动分割条件下评估时，最佳模型的CER几乎翻倍，凸显了考虑真实使用场景的重要性。我们希望这项工作能激励未来研究，开发扎根于持续复兴努力工作流程和约束的语言技术。

summary: Verifiable rewards have advanced reinforcement learning in mathematics and code. However, many valuable open-ended tasks share three properties: no automatic verifier of overall quality, multiple requirements to satisfy jointly, and multiple valid responses to each query. Training therefore needs feedback on requirement satisfaction across different valid responses. Rubric-based reinforcement learning provides this feedback by aggregating scores from explicit criteria. As learning progresses unevenly, some criteria become fully satisfied and lose discrimination while others remain informative. Dynamic methods revise shared rubrics or select evolving criteria to restore discrimination, but may also change useful criteria. To address this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Rubric Evolution (RARE). The core idea is to use current policy feedback to guide both which criteria change and what their replacements assess. Sample-level updates replace criteria fully satisfied across current outputs with checks of remaining quality differences, retaining all other criteria and scores. Within this rule, we compare rewarding desirable qualities with penalizing observed flaws. Video script generation exemplifies these properties and supports content production. Its demands for coherent, executable narratives under constraints make it a challenging testbed. Targeting flaws performs best across three video types with a mean gain of 3.82 points over matched static rubrics. Model and human preferences support these gains. Improvements also extend to writing and general generation benchmarks.
title: RARE: Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Rubric Evolution for Open-Ended Generation
title_translated: RARE：基于自适应评分体系演化的强化学习用于开放式生成
summary_translated: 可验证奖励已推动数学和代码领域的强化学习进展。然而，许多有价值的开放式任务具有三个特性：缺乏整体质量的自动验证器、需同时满足多个要求，以及每条查询存在多种有效响应。因此，训练需要对不同有效响应中各项要求的满足情况进行反馈。基于评分体系的强化学习通过聚合显式标准得分提供此类反馈。随着学习进程不均衡，部分标准可能完全满足而失去区分度，而其他标准仍具信息量。动态方法会修改共享评分体系或选择演化标准以恢复区分度，但也可能改变原本有用的准则。为解决此问题，我们提出强化学习中的自适应评分体系演化（RARE）。核心思想是利用当前策略的反馈来指导哪些标准需要变更以及其替代标准应评估的内容。样本级更新将当前输出中完全满足的标准替换为检查剩余质量差异的检测项，保留其余所有标准和得分。在此规则下，我们比较奖励理想特质与惩罚已观察缺陷的效果。视频脚本生成体现了这些特性，并支持内容生产。其在约束条件下对连贯、可执行叙事的需求使其成为极具挑战性的测试平台。针对缺陷的优化在三种视频类型中表现最佳，平均得分比静态评分体系高出3.82分。模型和人类偏好均支持这些改进。提升效果也延伸至写作和通用生成基准。

summary: Large language models store substantial factual knowledge in their parameters, yet this knowledge is difficult to control, update, and reliably elicit at inference time. Existing memory-augmented approaches typically rely on a single auxiliary mechanism, such as retrieval, parameter updates, or neural memory, and therefore apply the same form of correction to tokens with very different knowledge demands. We propose Mixture-of-Memories (MoM), a memory-augmented language modeling framework that separates routed neural memory from writable factual memory. MoM combines a frozen base LM with two neural memory experts: a latent memory that provides low-latency hidden-state corrections and a lexical memory that provides a token-space knowledge pathway. A lightweight Budget Router sets per-token mixture weights from uncertainty and disagreement features, replacing the fixed interpolation of prior memory modules. For post-hoc updates, an external explicit memory stays outside the router, because a router trained before facts are written learns to down-weight it; new facts are appended without retraining any component and used only when an answer-level gate accepts the retrieved fact. Experiments across language modeling, factual QA, update analysis, and efficiency show that MoM improves both predictive accuracy and updateability while retaining low inference overhead.
title: Mixture-of-Memories: Low-Overhead Language Modeling with Modular Knowledge Injection
title_translated: 混合记忆：通过模块化知识注入实现低开销语言建模
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在其参数中存储了大量事实知识，但这些知识难以控制、更新，并在推理时可靠地提取。现有的记忆增强方法通常依赖单一的辅助机制，如检索、参数更新或神经记忆，因此对具有完全不同知识需求的词元应用相同的修正方式。我们提出混合记忆（MoM），一种将路由神经记忆与可写事实记忆分离的记忆增强语言建模框架。MoM结合了一个冻结的基础语言模型和两个神经记忆专家：一个提供低延迟隐状态修正的潜在记忆，以及一个提供词空间知识路径的词汇记忆。一个轻量级预算路由器根据不确定性和分歧特征为每个词元设置混合权重，取代了先前记忆模块中的固定插值。对于事后更新，外部显式记忆保持在路由器之外，因为训练前就已知事实的路由器会降低其权重；新事实可直接追加而无需重新训练任何组件，仅在答案级门控接受所检索事实时才使用。在语言建模、事实问答、更新分析和效率方面的实验表明，MoM在提升预测准确性和可更新性的同时，仍保持低推理开销。

summary: Figurative language remains a major challenge for Machine Translation (MT) systems, as the intended meaning of such expressions often goes beyond literal translation. Although recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) improved the translation of Arabic dialects, benchmark resources for evaluating figurative language translation in Moroccan Darija remain scarce. To this end, we introduce the Moroccan Darija Figurative Language Corpus (MDFC), a benchmark dataset for MT and multiple-choice question (MCQ) selection covering idioms, metaphors, and proverbs. Using MDFC, we evaluate 19 open- and closed-weight language models and MT systems at both the expression and contextual levels under zero-shot and six-shot settings. We also conduct layer-wise similarity-based probing to determine how model representations distinguish figurative from literal meanings. Our findings reveal that closed-weight models achieve the strongest translation performance, while the benefits of contextual information vary across models and tasks. Differences between translation performance and MCQ accuracy highlight the distinction between generating an appropriate figurative translation and recognizing the intended meaning among candidate translations.
title: Towards Figurative Language Understanding in Moroccan Darija: An Evaluation of Large Language Models
title_translated: 迈向摩洛哥方言中的比喻语言理解：大型语言模型的评估
summary_translated: 比喻语言仍是机器翻译（MT）系统的主要挑战，因为这类表达的意图含义往往超出字面翻译。尽管近年来大型语言模型（LLMs）在阿拉伯语方言翻译方面取得了进展，但用于评估摩洛哥方言中比喻语言翻译的基准资源仍然稀缺。为此，我们引入了摩洛哥方言比喻语言语料库（MDFC），这是一个涵盖习语、隐喻和谚语的MT和选择题（MCQ）选择任务的基准数据集。利用MDFC，我们在零样本和六样本设置下，对19个开源和闭源语言模型及MT系统在表达层面和上下文层面进行了评估。我们还进行了逐层相似性探针分析，以确定模型表示如何区分比喻义与字面义。研究发现，闭源模型在翻译性能上表现最强，而上下文信息的益处因模型和任务而异。翻译性能与MCQ准确率之间的差异凸显了生成恰当的比喻翻译与从候选翻译中识别出正确意图之间的区别。

summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) can improve reasoning in large language models, but specialized non-English domains expose a data mismatch. Raw English domain text is often available, while target-language RLVR tasks with verifiable rewards are scarce. We introduce code-switched task synthesis for cross-lingual RLVR, a data-centric approach that derives target-language and code-switched RLVR task variants from otherwise unverifiable English domain text. Using fill-in-the-middle multiple-choice QA as a seed task format, we synthesize automatically verifiable tasks from domain passages and reshape them into cross-lingual variants. These variants preserve the same evidence-answer relation but change how English and target-language evidence are presented during RLVR. On Korean medical benchmarks and cybersecurity benchmarks across four target languages, code-switched training outperforms matched monolingual and bilingual-mixture baselines on average target-language performance while maintaining comparable English performance. Additional analyses provide evidence of better target-language input understanding and stronger cross-lingual alignment in both model outputs and internal representations. These results suggest that code-switched training helps target-language inputs access domain reasoning learned more strongly in English.
title: From Unverifiable Domain Text to Cross-Lingual RLVR via Code-Switched Task Synthesis
title_translated: 从不可验证领域文本到跨语言RLVR的代码切换任务合成
summary_translated: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）可以提升大语言模型的推理能力，但非英语专业领域的特殊性带来了数据不匹配问题。原始英文领域文本通常可用，而具备可验证奖励的目标语言RLVR任务却十分稀少。我们提出了跨语言RLVR的代码切换任务合成，这是一种以数据为中心的方法，从原本不可验证的英文领域文本中衍生出目标语言和代码切换的RLVR任务变体。以填空式多选问答作为种子任务格式，我们从领域段落中自动生成可验证的任务，并将其重构为跨语言变体。这些变体保留相同的证据-答案关系，但改变了在RLVR过程中英语与目标语言证据的呈现方式。在韩语医学基准和四种目标语言的网络安全基准上，代码切换训练在平均目标语言性能上优于匹配的单语和双语混合基线，同时保持了相当的英文性能。额外分析表明，目标语言输入理解更好，且模型输出和内部表示中的跨语言对齐更强。这些结果表明，代码切换训练有助于目标语言输入获取在英语中学习得更牢固的领域推理能力。

summary: Arabic LLMs have improved rapidly, but aligning them with country-specific cultural behavioral preferences remains underexplored. Previous work has focused primarily on instruction-tuning for factual knowledge, overlooking nuanced cultural behaviors. We propose ArabPref, which to our knowledge is the first large-scale pan-Arab preference data set for the alignment of cultural behavior conditioned on the country. Our contribution includes two resources in English and Modern Standard Arabic: a culturally grounded preference dataset for training and evaluation, and a multiple-choice benchmark designed to assess culturally aligned behavior across nations. All test data are validated by native speakers to ensure authenticity. To optimize cultural alignment, we experiment with post-training methods across multilingual and Arabic-centric language models, evaluating performance on both generation tasks and our cultural multiple-choice benchmark. By releasing an evaluation benchmark, we provide a foundation for systematically studying and improving culturally aligned behavior in language models.
title: Aligning Cultural Behaviors in Arabic Language Models via Preferences
title_translated: 通过偏好对齐阿拉伯语言模型中的文化行为
summary_translated: 阿拉伯语大型语言模型发展迅速，但将其与特定国家的文化行为偏好对齐仍处于探索阶段。以往工作主要集中在指令微调以获取事实知识，忽视了文化行为的细微差别。我们提出了ArabPref，据我们所知，这是首个大规模泛阿拉伯地区、基于国家条件的文化行为对齐偏好数据集。我们的贡献包括两种语言资源：一份用于训练和评估的文化基础偏好数据集，以及一个设计用于评估跨国文化对齐行为的多项选择基准。所有测试数据均由母语者验证，以确保真实性。为优化文化对齐，我们在多语言和以阿拉伯语为中心的语言模型上实验了多种后训练方法，并在生成任务和我们的文化多项选择基准上评估性能。通过发布评估基准，我们为系统性研究和改进语言模型中的文化对齐行为提供了基础。

summary: As the world changes, new information is published while older records remain online. This complicates reasoning for large language models (LLMs), which must retrieve evidence and resolve conflicts to determine which information remains valid. Existing evaluations treat information seeking as a black box, revealing little about where and why LLMs fail. To address this gap, we introduce TREK, a suite of three components: TREKTRACE is a plug-and-play framework that attributes failures to specific stages of retrieval and reasoning. We apply it to TREKBENCH-WILD, a meta-benchmark of real-world questions that require complex reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge. Surprisingly, the main bottleneck is post-retrieval reasoning rather than retrieval: frontier models are often misled by conflicting evidence even after retrieving all the information needed to answer. To study this bottleneck, we build TREKBENCH-CTRL, a controlled benchmark with distractors spanning temporality, relevance, and trustworthiness, and show that benchmarks dominated by outdated distractors substantially underestimate task difficulty. Together, TREK provides a testbed for diagnosing and improving reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge.
title: Where and Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail When Reasoning over Rapidly Evolving Knowledge
title_translated: 搜索增强型大语言模型在快速演变知识推理中的失败原因与位置
summary_translated: 随着世界变化，新信息不断发布，旧记录仍在线存在。这使得大语言模型（LLMs）在推理时面临复杂挑战，必须检索证据并解决冲突以判断哪些信息仍有效。现有评估将信息获取视为黑箱，难以揭示LLMs失败的具体位置和原因。为填补这一空白，我们引入TREK，一套包含三个组件的工具：TREKTRACE是一个即插即用的框架，可将失败归因于检索和推理的具体阶段。我们将该框架应用于TREKBENCH-WILD，一个需要对快速演变知识进行复杂推理的真实世界问题元基准。令人惊讶的是，主要瓶颈在于后检索推理而非检索本身：前沿模型即使在获取全部必要信息后，仍常被矛盾证据误导。为研究这一瓶颈，我们构建了TREKBENCH-CTRL，一个受控基准，其中干扰项涵盖时间性、相关性和可信度维度，并证明以过时干扰项主导的基准会显著低估任务难度。TREK共同提供了一个诊断和改进快速演变知识推理能力的测试平台。

summary: Deterministic hash-addressed conditional memory permits local post-hoc knowledge injection. Extending arXiv:2610.21553's bounded-feasibility audit rejecting under-specified generality claims with repaired probes and training-dose/capacity axes, we give, to our knowledge, the first production-scale write-content verdict. We test 124M-7B self-trained/publicly pretrained beds, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 (176.95B; 320,001,536 FP8 rows), and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Write coverage requires a sufficiently trained backbone prior, full-width readout, trainable gates; undertrained-bed intervention confirms a threshold, not a slope. At fixed budget, coverage falls from 98% (50 facts) to 12.7% (1,000); table size is not binding. Two-hop composition does not exceed the independent single-hop baseline (26% observed vs 25% expected; 15% lexical-distortion floor). Synergy remains absent across dose/load in two independent bed families. A 28-percentage-point in-context gap (given vs recalled intermediates) localizes failure to retrieval-for-reasoning, not gate access. Writes are independently retrievable, precisely addressable, reversible atoms, not composable into reasoning. A layered protocol, the first, to our knowledge, to cover compositionality in behavioral memory evaluation, separates baseline, synergy and distortion floor. Any addressed/key-value memory must report coverage, synergy ratio and distortion rate before deployment claims. Composition must be system-orchestrated; multi-constraint queries should explicitly chain written atoms. In-context controls show given intermediate entities are exploited at twice the implicit rate. Production load fits exponential interference ($R^2=0.98$); its mechanism, between budget dilution and write interference, remains open. All numbers are recomputed from archived raw logs/JSON; a fresh 52-target production rerun gives 52/52, exactly matching archived baselines.
title: Atoms, Not Knowledge: What Production-Scale Addressed-Memory Writes Deposit
title_translated: 原子，而非知识：大规模地址化内存写入所留下的内容
summary_translated: 确定性哈希地址条件记忆支持局部事后的知识注入。在扩展arXiv:2610.21553中关于有限可行性审计、通过修复探测和训练剂量/容量轴拒绝表述不清的泛化主张的基础上，我们首次给出了生产规模写入内容的判断。我们测试了124M至7B自训练/公开预训练的内存池，包括Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8（1769.5B；320,001,536行FP8）和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。写入覆盖率需要充分训练的主干网络、全宽读出和可训练门控机制；未充分训练内存池的干预证实存在阈值而非线性趋势。在固定预算下，覆盖率从50条事实时的98%下降到1000条时的12.7%；表大小并非瓶颈。两跳组合并未超过独立单跳基线（观察到26% vs 预期25%；词汇扭曲底限15%）。在两个独立内存家族中，剂量与负载之间均无协同效应。上下文中的差距达28个百分点（给定中间项 vs 回忆中间项），将失败定位在推理中的检索问题，而非门控访问。写入是可独立检索、精确寻址、可逆的原子单元，无法组合用于推理。这是首个已知覆盖行为记忆评估中组合性的分层协议，分离了基线、协同效应和扭曲底限。任何地址化/键值内存系统在部署前必须报告覆盖率、协同比和扭曲率。组合必须由系统协调；多约束查询应显式串联写入的原子。上下文控制显示，给定中间实体的利用效率是隐式方式的两倍。生产负载符合指数干扰模型（R²=0.98）；其机制（预算稀释与写入干扰之间的相互作用）仍待揭示。所有数据均基于归档原始日志/JSON重新计算；一次全新的52目标生产重跑结果为52/52，完全匹配归档基线。

summary: Speech anonymization has focused on the acoustic signal, leaving open how much speaker information the transcribed words themselves retain. In this work, we study pairwise speaker and demographic-attribute verification from transcribed speech. We introduce SPARC (Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus), a benchmark built from two podcast corpora comprising over 12,500 speakers, 1.5M quality-filtered utterances, and speaker-level inferred or source-provided labels for sex, age, and accent, and evaluate five attribution models and three LLMs on identity- and attribute-verification trials with episode- and metadata-based topic proxies. LLM adversaries distinguish same-speaker pairs from text alone. Attribute-label agreement is harder to verify, but LLMs perform sex- and accent-label verification above chance. Finally, releasing only short probe texts (50 words) degrades the strongest adversaries the most, offering a partial reduction in observed linkage.
title: SPARC: Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus
title_translated: SPARC：口语化个人身份识别语料库
summary_translated: 语音匿名化研究主要集中在声学信号上，而忽略了转录文本本身保留了多少说话人信息。本文研究从转录语音中进行成对说话人及人口统计属性验证。我们引入SPARC（Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus），一个基于两个播客语料库构建的基准数据集，包含超过12,500名说话人、150万条质量筛选后的语句，以及在说话人层面推断或来源提供的性别、年龄和口音标签。我们在基于节目和元数据主题代理的身份与属性验证实验中，评估了五种归属模型和三种大语言模型的表现。结果显示，LLM对手仅凭文本即可区分同说话人对。属性标签的一致性验证更具挑战性，但LLM在性别和口音标签验证上表现优于随机水平。最后，仅释放短探针文本（50词）对最强对手的性能影响最大，提供了观测关联性部分降低的有效手段。

summary: Given the high cost of expert annotation and limited fine-tuning resources, effective data selection from large unlabeled pools under strict budgets has become a crucial step in adapting LLMs to specialized domains. Existing label-dependent methods risk distorted selection when using pseudo-labels, while traditional active learning methods do not explicitly characterize instruction-tuning dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose Hidden Cartographer (HC), a two-stage framework that uses hidden states to guide annotation and exact training dynamics to select the final training subset. The first stage is Progressive Candidate Expansion, which utilizes the proxy to iteratively select top unlabeled candidates for expert annotation, merging them to recompute training dynamics and update the proxy until the annotation budget is exhausted; the second stage is Exact Cartography Pruning, which ranks these annotated candidates by their exact dynamics scores to isolate a compact subset under the final training budget. Experiments across the medical, legal, and financial domains demonstrate that HC achieves the highest average accuracy among all budgeted baselines, requiring annotation for only 20--30% of the original pool and fine-tuning on just 10--15%.
title: Hidden Cartographer: Hidden State Guided Data Selection for Dual Budgeted Instruction Tuning
title_translated: 隐秘制图师：基于隐藏状态的双预算指令微调数据选择
summary_translated: 鉴于专家标注成本高昂且微调资源有限，如何在严格预算下从大规模无标签数据池中有效选择数据，已成为将大语言模型适配到特定领域的重要步骤。现有依赖标签的方法在使用伪标签时可能造成选择偏差，而传统主动学习方法未能明确刻画指令微调动态。为此，我们提出Hidden Cartographer（HC），一种两阶段框架：第一阶段为渐进候选扩展，利用代理迭代选择最优无标签候选样本供专家标注，并合并后重新计算训练动态并更新代理，直至标注预算耗尽；第二阶段为精确制图剪枝，根据标注候选样本的精确动态得分进行排序，从而在最终训练预算下提取紧凑子集。在医疗、法律和金融领域的实验表明，HC在所有预算基线中达到最高平均准确率，仅需标注原始数据池的20%-30%，且微调仅需10%-15%的数据。

summary: Reasoning large language models (LLMs) benefit from test-time scaling, motivating adaptive policies that spend tokens when they help and stop early otherwise. Existing rules halt when a confidence or stability signal crosses a threshold, but such thresholds rarely transfer across models and datasets, and validation-calibrated rules lose their guarantee under shifts in test-time horizon or signal dynamics. We reframe adaptive stopping as sequential evidence accumulation along the reasoning trajectory rather than threshold calibration on held-out data. Our framework runs two e-processes on a shared per-chunk signal: a commit stream tracks the signal's position relative to its slow trend, and an abstain stream tracks its signed velocity, making the two anti-correlated by construction. Under signal-level nulls on the per-chunk increments, Ville's inequality yields an anytime-valid signal-level false-alarm bound at user-specified significance levels, with no held-out calibration. Across various model--dataset combinations, the framework matches or exceeds calibration-based stopping on the token--accuracy Pareto front using zero calibration data, and the same significance level transfers unchanged across cells where calibration becomes infeasible.
title: Calibration-Free Early Stopping for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via E-processes
title_translated: 基于e过程的校准无关链式思维推理早期停止
summary_translated: 推理型大语言模型（LLMs）受益于测试时扩展，这促使人们设计自适应策略：当token投入有助于推理时继续，否则提前停止。现有规则通常在置信度或稳定性信号跨越阈值时停止，但此类阈值很少能在不同模型和数据集间迁移，且验证校准规则在测试时范围或信号动态变化时会失去保证。我们重新将自适应停止建模为沿着推理轨迹的序列证据积累，而非基于保留数据的阈值校准。我们的框架在共享每块信号上运行两个e过程：commit流跟踪信号相对于其慢趋势的位置，abstain流跟踪其符号速度，两者构造上呈负相关。在每块增量的信号级零假设下，Ville不等式提供任意时间有效的信号级误报边界，无需保留校准数据。在多种模型-数据集组合中，该框架在无需任何校准数据的情况下，达到或超越基于校准的停止策略在token-准确率帕累托前沿上的表现，且相同显著性水平可在校准不可行的场景中无缝迁移。

summary: People can express the same beliefs and desires yet need different reasons to change their minds. What makes an argument relevant depends on how those views arose: experiences shape what a person finds credible, what matters to them, and what could prompt reconsideration. These personal grounds may also be expressed indirectly, through contextual clues in conversation. Benchmarks that specify beliefs and desires without these connections can reward arguments that match a description while overlooking whether they address the person's reasons. We introduce A Thousand Faces (ATF-Persu), with 1,000 personas across 200 topics and nine domains. Drawing on personality and attitude theories and conversational implicature, we construct five personas per factual context, linking experiences to judgments, expression, and grounds for revision. Evaluations show lower persuasion success than three comparison benchmarks under their respective protocols. Complete backgrounds yield broader use of supplied personal grounds and higher persona faithfulness than simplified specifications; blinded reviewers also rate ATF-Persu above CToMPersu on identifiable personal reasons, their influence on responses, and contextual expression. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Slandes/ATF-Persu.
title: A Thousand Faces: A Persuasion Benchmark with Experience-Grounded Persuadees Informed by Psychology and Pragmatics
title_translated: 千张面孔：基于经验基础说服对象的心理学与语用学驱动的说服基准
summary_translated: 人们可能表达相同的信念和欲望，却需要不同的理由来改变想法。一个论点的相关性取决于这些观点是如何形成的：经历塑造了一个人认为可信的内容、对其重要的事物，以及可能引发重新思考的因素。这些个人依据也可能间接表达，通过对话中的上下文线索体现。仅指定信念和欲望而忽略这些联系的基准，可能奖励那些匹配描述但未触及对方真实理由的论证。我们引入A Thousand Faces（ATF-Persu），包含200个主题下的1000个角色和九个领域。结合人格与态度理论及会话含义，我们在每个事实情境下构建五个角色，将经历与判断、表达及修正依据相连接。评估显示，在各自协议下，其说服成功率低于三个对比基准。完整背景信息带来更广泛地使用所提供个人依据，并提升角色忠实度；盲评者也评价ATF-Persu在可识别个人理由、其对回应的影响及上下文表达方面优于CToMPersu。该数据集已在https://huggingface.co/datasets/Slandes/ATF-Persu公开获取。

summary: Text processing is crucial for low-resource languages as it enables the development of tools and technologies that bridge the digital divide and provide equitable access to information and services. By empowering low-resource languages with robust text processing, we can preserve linguistic diversity, enhance education, improve communi- cation, and foster inclusivity in a rapidly digitizing world. Due to the lack of sufficient annotated datasets and lin- guistic resources, it is challenging to develop accurate and reliable language technologies for these low-resource languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) have attracted sig- nificant attention with their performance and the value they produce. However, with the ever-evolving language, adapting LLMs for a specific task is time-consuming and resource-intensive. Thus, Retrieval-Augmented Genera- tion (RAG) has overcome this limitation by augmenting LLMs with external knowledge, thereby improving their efficiency and extensive task-specific adaptation. Most applications of the RAG technique have been limited to English and has seen limited application in In- dic languages. This paper introduces the RAG-powered AI-Tutor application, Acharya 2.0, designed to produce academic assistance to Hindi-speaking students. The client-server-based web application integrates many fea- tures to support students in accessing and interacting with educational content.
title: Acharya 2.0: An AI Tutor for Self-Learning Subjects in Hindi
title_translated: Acharya 2.0：面向印地语自学习科目的AI导师
summary_translated: 文本处理对于低资源语言至关重要，因为它能够推动工具和技术的发展，弥合数字鸿沟，实现信息与服务的公平获取。通过为低资源语言提供强大的文本处理能力，我们可以保护语言多样性，提升教育水平，改善沟通，并在快速数字化的世界中促进包容性。由于缺乏足够的标注数据集和语言资源，开发这些低资源语言的准确可靠语言技术极具挑战性。大型语言模型（LLMs）因其性能和产出价值而受到广泛关注。然而，随着语言的不断演变，将LLMs适配到特定任务既耗时又耗费资源。因此，检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部知识来增强LLMs，克服了这一局限，提升了其效率和任务特异性适应能力。目前RAG技术的应用主要集中在英语，在印度语言中的应用仍有限。本文介绍了基于RAG的AI导师应用Acharya 2.0，旨在为讲印地语的学生提供学术支持。该基于客户端-服务器架构的Web应用集成了多项功能，以帮助学生访问和互动教育内容。

summary: Answering natural language questions over knowledge graph data is challenging due to the vast number of facts, which can be difficult to process and navigate. One potential solution for this issue is to use mined subgraphs related to the query, although this process still requires extracting these subgraphs. This research presents a solution for extracting subgraphs related to entity candidates from a question-and-answer set, which can be obtained by inferring a large language model by calculating the shortest paths between entities. The proposed approaches detail various features that can be extracted from the subgraphs and reranking models to select the most probable answers from a list of candidates. Experiments were conducted on Wikidata to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches. This involved enumerating all the main feature types that can be extracted from mined subgraphs and a detailed analysis of the proposed features and reranking method combinations. In addition, a public web application that provides a useful web tool for studying the graph space between question and answer entities has been developed to work with subgraphs. This includes visualization of the extracted subgraph and automatic generation of natural language text to describe it.
title: Reranking Answers of Large Language Models with Knowledge Graphs
comment: 37 pages. Accepted for the Semantic Web journal (tracking no. 4075-5289); not published. this https URL
title_translated: 利用知识图谱对大语言模型的回答进行重排序
summary_translated: 在知识图谱数据上回答自然语言问题具有挑战性，因为事实数量庞大，难以处理和导航。一种潜在解决方案是使用与查询相关的挖掘子图，但该过程仍需提取这些子图。本研究提出了一种从问答数据集中提取与实体候选相关子图的方法，通过计算实体间的最短路径来推理大语言模型。所提出的方案详细描述了可从子图中提取的各种特征以及重排序模型，用于从候选答案列表中选择最可能的答案。实验在Wikidata上进行，以评估所提方法的有效性。研究枚举了可从挖掘子图中提取的所有主要特征类型，并对所提特征与重排序方法组合进行了详细分析。此外，开发了一个公开的Web应用程序，提供一个有用的工具，用于研究问题与答案实体之间的图空间关系，包括提取子图的可视化及自动生成描述其内容的自然语言文本。

summary: An increasing number of disciplines recognize the explanatory potential of meaning-bearing mental structures through which individuals interpret the world and guide their behavior. Concept representations constitute a core class of these structures, emerging from individuals' experiences with concept referents and encoding and organizing their understanding of them. Recognizing a private level of meaning, where concepts are not objectively defined by rules in the world but constitute subjective structures in individuals' minds, raises a fundamental question: do different individuals actually mean the same thing when they invoke the same concept? As latent structures, concept representations are difficult to access and model empirically. The present study introduces a measurement framework that makes such representations empirically accessible through textual traces elicited under standardized conditions. Using transformer-based sentence embeddings, the framework maps standardized responses elicited for concepts into a high-dimensional shared vector space, opening concept representations to the systematic analysis of interindividual variation. It develops three analytical avenues: (1) comparing representational sharedness across concepts, (2) identifying variables that correlate with representational variation, and (3) examining how focal actors or subpopulations deviate from a reference population. Each avenue is illustrated through an empirical proof-of-concept drawing on a large-scale free-association dataset. Together, the demonstrations show how researchers from across disciplines can move from a research question and data source to analysis and interpretation. An accompanying GitHub repository provides a ready-to-use implementation of the framework for existing and custom datasets.
title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Toward an Interdisciplinary Study of Meaning Variation
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Companion paper to arXiv:2610.15496 . Code: this https URL
title_translated: 向量空间中的概念表征：迈向意义变异的跨学科研究
summary_translated: 越来越多的学科认识到，承载意义的心理结构在个体解释世界和指导行为方面具有解释潜力。概念表征是这类结构的核心类别，源于个体对概念指称物的经验，并编码和组织他们对这些概念的理解。承认意义存在私人层面——即概念并非由世界中的客观规则定义，而是个体心智中的主观结构——引发了一个根本问题：当不同个体使用同一概念时，他们实际上是否意味着相同的事物？作为潜在结构，概念表征难以被实证访问和建模。本研究提出了一种测量框架，通过在标准化条件下诱发的文本痕迹使这些表征具备实证可及性。该框架利用基于Transformer的句子嵌入，将针对概念的标准响应映射到高维共享向量空间，从而开放概念表征以系统分析个体间差异。研究发展了三个分析路径：(1) 比较不同概念间的表征共性；(2) 识别与表征变异相关的变量；(3) 探讨焦点人物或子群体相对于参照群体的偏离情况。每个路径均通过大规模自由联想数据集的实证概念验证加以说明。整体演示表明，来自不同学科的研究者可从研究问题和数据源出发，完成分析与解读。配套的GitHub仓库提供了该框架在现有和自定义数据集上的即用型实现。

summary: People ask conversational AI models about their legal rights, obligations, procedures, and personal situations that may have legal consequences. To study this behavior, we first need to distinguish requests for legal guidance from other legally themed discussions and unrelated conversations. We contribute a multi-axis taxonomy of legal queries capturing whether legal guidance is sought, how a request is formulated, and which legal domains it concerns; apply it to 2,122 naturally occurring WildChat-1M conversations; and create a human-reviewed gold evaluation set of 200 conversations. All annotations, model checkpoints, and evaluation code are publicly available. In this enriched sample, 71.1% of conversations containing legal content seek personalized or practical guidance. Rights-and-options advice is the most common primary request type among legal-content conversations, and 25.3% of guidance-positive conversations span multiple legal topics. The gold evaluation set supports a two-stage comparison of ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large against a TF-IDF cascade. Our framework supports large-scale studies of legal guidance in conversational AI, and the public release of the annotated data facilitates reproducible research and future model development.
title: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
comment: 12 pages, 6 tables. Accepted for publication at JURIX 2026, Toulouse, France. This is the preprint version. Code and data available at: this https URL
title_translated: 真实世界中的法律建议：用户如何在LLM对话中寻求法律帮助
summary_translated: 人们会向对话式AI模型咨询其法律权利、义务、程序以及可能产生法律后果的个人情况。为了研究这种行为，我们首先需要区分法律建议请求与其他法律主题讨论及无关对话。本文贡献了一个多维度法律查询分类体系，涵盖是否寻求法律建议、请求的表述方式以及涉及的法律领域；将其应用于2,122条自然发生的WildChat-1M对话；并创建了一个由人工审核的200条对话黄金评估集。所有标注数据、模型检查点和评估代码均已公开。在这一丰富样本中，71.1%包含法律内容的对话寻求个性化或实用性的指导。权利与选项建议是法律内容对话中最常见的主要请求类型，且25.3%的积极提供指导的对话跨越多个法律主题。黄金评估集支持对ModernBERT-base与ModernBERT-large与TF-IDF级联模型的两阶段对比。我们的框架支持对对话式AI中法律建议的大规模研究，公开发布的标注数据促进了可复现研究和未来模型开发。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often used to simulate survey respondents, but matching survey averages does not establish accurate demographic differences. We test whether LLM outputs reproduce within-country age gaps in loneliness using the 2022 EU Loneliness Survey, comparing adults aged 18-34 and 65 or older in France, Italy, Poland, and Sweden. We evaluate simulation with and without age information and direct distribution estimation against a probability-based sample, with a non-probability sensitivity reference. Both human samples show higher mean loneliness among younger adults. Under age-specified simulation with standard response-option order, Mistral Small 4 and GPT-5.6 Terra reverse this ordering under all three prompt framings in three and two countries, respectively, mainly by overestimating older-adult means. DeepSeek V4 Flash preserves the ordering everywhere but underestimates both group means, with errors largely cancelling in France and Italy. Against the probability-based reference, direct estimation has lower absolute age-gap error than simulation for Mistral and Terra in every country. For DeepSeek, simulation has lower gap error but direct estimation has lower group-mean error; these comparisons depend on low-validity older-adult simulation cells. Evaluating LLM outputs as proxies for age groups within countries therefore requires checking both group means and their contrast against human survey data.
title: Do LLMs Reproduce the Age Gap in Loneliness? Evaluating Survey Simulation against European Survey Data
title_translated: LLMs是否会再现孤独感的年龄差距？基于欧洲调查数据的模拟评估
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常被用于模拟调查受访者，但仅匹配调查平均值并不能确保准确的人口统计学差异。我们使用2022年欧盟孤独感调查，测试LLM输出是否再现了法国、意大利、波兰和瑞典国内18-34岁成年人与65岁以上成年人之间的孤独感年龄差距。我们比较了有无年龄信息的模拟结果与直接分布估计，以概率抽样样本为基准，并采用非概率敏感性参考。人类样本显示，年轻成年人的孤独感平均水平更高。在指定年龄的模拟中，标准回答选项顺序下，Mistral Small 4和GPT-5.6 Terra在三个和两个国家中分别在所有三种提示框架下反转了这一顺序，主要原因是高估了老年人群的平均值。DeepSeek V4 Flash在所有地区均保持了正确顺序，但低估了两组均值，误差在法国和意大利基本抵消。与基于概率的参考相比，Mistral和Terra在所有国家中，直接估计的绝对年龄差距误差低于模拟；对于DeepSeek，模拟的差距误差更低，但直接估计的组均值误差更低；这些比较依赖于有效性较低的老年群体模拟单元。因此，将LLM输出作为国家内部年龄群体的代理时，必须同时检验组均值及其与人类调查数据的对比关系。

summary: Background and Objective: Clinical free text cannot leave the hospital without de-identification, yet no de-identification system or benchmark exists for Greek clinical text. We evaluated Morpheus, a fully local de-identification pipeline for Greek clinical documents, on 500 synthetic discharge summaries. Methods: The notes (300 cardiac surgery, 100 cardiology, 100 nephrology) were generated by a frontier large language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) constrained to authentic Greek hospital document layouts. Notes were pre-annotated at generation; two clinicians then independently reviewed and corrected every note, blinded to each other, with disagreements arbitrated. Primary outcomes were recall over must-redact identifiers and over-redaction of clinical content, measured over must-survive probes. Secondary outcomes: residual leaks flagged by an independent egress-review layer, processing time and reproducibility. Results: Inter-annotator agreement was F1 = 0.998. The de-identification rate was 96.59% (7,666/7,937 identifier instances; 95% CI 96.16-96.96): 98.49% for direct and 93.42% for quasi-identifiers. No patient's own complete identifier survived in any note; of 271 residual instances, 199 (73.4%) concerned institutional identity, chiefly the hospital letterhead. The over-redaction rate was 2.82% (190/6,747 probes; 95% CI 2.45-3.24). The egress guard flagged 2 of 271 residuals, both complete telephone numbers. Two independent runs gave identical verdicts. Conclusions: A fully local, deterministic pipeline removed 98.5% of direct patient identifiers from Greek clinical text while altering under 3% of protected clinical content; most residuals concerned the institution, not the patient. To our knowledge this is the first benchmark evaluation of clinical-text de-identification for Greek and the first quantified evaluation of an independent egress-guard layer.
title: Morpheus: a fully local, defense-in-depth de-identification engine for Greek clinical text - a benchmark evaluation
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; supplementary material appended. Benchmark corpus: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22824894
title_translated: Morpheus：一种用于希腊语临床文本的全本地、纵深防御去标识化引擎——基准评估
summary_translated: 背景与目标：临床自由文本在离开医院前必须进行去标识化，但目前尚无针对希腊语临床文本的去标识化系统或基准测试。我们对Morpheus——一种针对希腊语临床文档的全本地去标识化流程——在500个合成出院摘要上进行了评估。方法：这些笔记（300例心脏外科、100例心脏病学、100例肾病学）由前沿大语言模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro）生成，且受限于真实的希腊医院文档格式。笔记在生成时已预先标注；随后两名临床医生独立审查并修正每条笔记，彼此盲审，分歧由第三方裁定。主要结果为必须删除标识符的召回率和过度删除临床内容的比例，基于必须保留的探测样本测量。次要结果包括独立外泄审查层标记的残留泄露、处理时间和可复现性。结果：注释者间一致性F1值为0.998。去标识化率为96.59%（7,666/7,937个标识符实例；95%置信区间96.16–96.96），直接标识符为98.49%，准标识符为93.42%。任何患者自身的完整标识符均未在笔记中留存；271个残留实例中，199个（73.4%）涉及机构身份，主要是医院信头。过度删除率为2.82%（190/6,747个探测样本；95%置信区间2.45–3.24）。外泄审查层标记了271个残留中的2个，均为完整电话号码。两次独立运行得出相同结论。结论：一种全本地、确定性的流程从希腊语临床文本中移除了98.5%的直接患者标识符，同时对受保护临床内容的修改不足3%；大多数残留问题涉及机构而非患者。据我们所知，这是首次针对希腊语临床文本去标识化的基准评估，也是首次对独立外泄审查层的量化评估。

summary: Advancing physics reasoning in large language models requires scalable training data that connect physical laws, concrete problem scenarios, and verifiable numerical answers. Expert-designed problems offer top-down control over physical laws, conditions, and scenarios, but require costly human effort. LLM-based synthesis from texts scales efficiently, but model-generated answers and assessments leave supervision vulnerable to hallucinations. We introduce TIRE, a framework for Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution that brings knowledge-driven problem construction to large-scale data generation. Top-down instantiation uses reusable physical formulas and their applicability conditions to control the physical relations and numerical configurations of generated problems. Reliable execution establishes reference answers before problem generation, providing a common numerical foundation for problem construction and teacher distillation. Together, these mechanisms combine control over problem content with execution-grounded supervision for both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Using TIRE, we construct TIRE-19k, spanning nine subfields of physics. Across 3 backbone LLMs and 4 benchmarks, TIRE-19k outperforms 5 representative datasets with equal amounts of SFT data, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.86 percentage points on average. Further GRPO raises Qwen3-8B's average accuracy by 1.52 percentage points over its TIRE-19k SFT checkpoint. These results demonstrate the value of generating physics training data from explicit physical knowledge with reliable execution.
title: TIRE: Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution for Physics Problem Synthesis
title_translated: TIRE：基于可靠执行的自上而下公式实例化用于物理问题合成
summary_translated: 提升大语言模型在物理推理方面的能力需要可扩展的训练数据，这些数据需连接物理定律、具体问题场景和可验证的数值答案。专家设计的问题提供了对物理定律、条件和场景的自上而下控制，但需要高昂的人力成本。基于LLM的文本合成方法效率高，但模型生成的答案和评估使监督容易受到幻觉影响。我们提出TIRE框架——自上而下公式实例化与可靠执行，将知识驱动的问题构建引入大规模数据生成。自上而下的实例化利用可重用的物理公式及其适用条件来控制生成问题的物理关系和数值配置。可靠执行在问题生成前建立参考答案，为问题构建和教师蒸馏提供统一的数值基础。这两项机制结合了对问题内容的控制与基于执行的监督，适用于监督微调和强化学习。使用TIRE，我们构建了涵盖九个物理学子领域的TIRE-19k数据集。在三个主干LLM和四个基准测试中，TIRE-19k在同等SFT数据量下优于五个代表性数据集，平均高出2.86个百分点。进一步采用GRPO方法使Qwen3-8B的平均准确率比其TIRE-19k SFT检查点提高1.52个百分点。这些结果证明了基于显式物理知识和可靠执行生成物理训练数据的价值。

summary: Memory serves as the core component of LLM-based agents, enabling personalized responses via extracting and using user preferences from past interactions. However, its use may reduce response diversity, thereby narrowing the range of information available to users. Existing evaluations rely largely on synthetic interactions and cover few memory systems, leaving the effects of memory on response diversity insufficiently evaluated in real-world scenarios. We introduce MemBubble, a benchmark of 1000 instances built on preferences extracted from real user-assistant conversations. To measure the extent to which memory concentrates response distributions, we construct test queries in scenarios distinct from user preferences while preserving topical relevance through shared preference categories. Across multiple LLMs and memory mechanisms, entropy decreases by 34.7% on average compared with directly providing the full interaction history, highlighting the important role of memory processing in diversity loss. We also explore simple user-side interventions and changes in information availability but find that these do not effectively close the diversity gap. Our findings highlight the need to consider preserving diversity and user access to information alongside improvements in personalization when designing and using agent memory systems.
title: MemBubble: Benchmarking How Agent Memory Shapes LLM Response Diversity
title_translated: MemBubble：基准测试智能体记忆如何影响LLM响应多样性
summary_translated: 记忆是基于LLM智能体的核心组件，通过从过往交互中提取并使用用户偏好实现个性化响应。然而，其使用可能降低响应多样性，从而缩小用户可获取信息的范围。现有评估大多依赖合成交互，覆盖的记忆系统有限，导致在真实场景中记忆对响应多样性的影响尚未充分评估。我们引入MemBubble，一个基于真实用户-助手对话中提取偏好的1000个实例基准测试。为衡量记忆对响应分布集中程度的影响，我们在与用户偏好不同的场景中构建测试查询，同时通过共享偏好类别保持主题相关性。在多个LLM和记忆机制下，熵值相比直接提供完整交互历史平均下降34.7%，凸显了记忆处理在多样性损失中的关键作用。我们还探索了简单的用户侧干预和信息可用性变化，但发现这些方法无法有效弥合多样性差距。我们的研究强调，在设计和使用智能体记忆系统时，应同时考虑保持多样性与用户信息访问权，而不仅仅是个性化改进。

summary: Agents now act on the Web, publishing packages, models and datasets through registry APIs, and remembering past verifications spares them the work. But a verdict rests on premises. When a signing key is revoked, everything built on it stops passing, yet the advisory names only the key, and the old verdicts of its dependents may never share a retrieval window with it. This non-locality of invalidation turns memory into a liability: in long simulated chats, an agent reading a memory of atomic facts publishes 62% of the objects whose failure lies upstream, each backed by a record that was true when written. Yet derivation is local even when invalidation is not. Tether records, at write time, the exact versions each verdict derives from, and at read time withdraws any verdict whose support has failed anywhere in the store; the agent reads the same fields as before. On Fallout, a generator of versioned worlds with hypothesis-blind simulated histories shared by every memory, Tether publishes 0.3% of upstream-failing objects across three domains when relations are stated with their verdicts, with 37% fewer verification calls than checking everything. A-Mem and Graphiti re-verify most candidates (0.83-0.86 checks per candidate), which limits their savings, yet publish 9% of upstream-failing objects; Mem0 relies on memory more and publishes 42%. Flushing every verdict on any failure is as safe as Tether but costs 32% more checks. The gain over fact memory holds with three open-weight backbones and against a whole-store window. These gains depend on capturing dependencies: when relations arrive in sessions apart from their verdicts, Tether's downstream unsafe publication rate rises to 9.4-22.1%, and a weak writer that misses edges loses safety in the same way.
title: Memories That Outlive Their Reasons: Dependency-Tethered Memory for Tool-Using LLM Agents
title_translated: 超越原因的记忆：面向工具使用LLM智能体的依赖绑定记忆
summary_translated: 智能体如今可在网络上行动，通过注册API发布包、模型和数据集，并记住过去的验证结果以避免重复工作。但一个判断依赖于前提。当签名密钥被撤销时，所有基于它的内容都将失效，但警告仅提及密钥，旧的依赖项的判断可能永远无法与之重新关联。这种无效化的非局部性使记忆成为负担：在长时间模拟对话中，一个读取原子事实记忆的智能体发布了62%的上游失败对象，每个都附有写入时为真的记录。然而，推导是局部的，即使无效化是非局部的。Tether记录在写入时精确记录每个判断所依赖的确切版本，并在读取时撤回其支持在存储中任何位置已失效的判断；智能体读取的字段与之前相同。在Fallout（一个生成带版本世界、假设盲模拟历史共享给每个记忆的生成器）上，当关系与其判断一同陈述时，Tether在三个领域中仅发布0.3%的上游失败对象，验证调用次数比全面检查减少37%。A-Mem和Graphiti重新验证大多数候选对象（每个候选0.83–0.86次检查），限制了其节省效果，但仍发布9%的上游失败对象；Mem0更依赖记忆，发布42%。一旦发生故障即清除所有判断，虽与Tether同样安全，但检查次数多出32%。这一优势在三种开源权重主干模型和整个存储窗口下依然成立。这些收益依赖于捕捉依赖关系：当关系与判断分属不同会话到达时，Tether的下游不安全发布率升至9.4–22.1%，弱写入者若遗漏边也会以相同方式丧失安全性。

summary: Semantic map models (SMMs) construct a graph that reflects conceptual similarity by comparing cross-lingual form-meaning mappings. Experts build such models not only by obeying the data constraint, i.e., the connectivity hypothesis, which states that conceptual nodes belonging to the same form must be connected, but also by incorporating their prior semantic knowledge. Current automatic methods ignore this knowledge, which harms both accuracy and efficiency by enlarging the search space of candidate graphs. In this paper, we fuse the distributional semantic knowledge hidden in the internal representations of language models into a top-down, data-driven algorithm. This expert-like behavior re-sorts the candidates in a huge search space, guided by conceptual semantics similarity. Experiments on a self-collected benchmark of 10 datasets and comprehensive metrics show that our method builds SMMs both effectively and efficiently.
title: Behave Like Experts: Fusing Data with Semantic Knowledge for Effective and Efficient Semantic Map Construction
title_translated: 像专家一样行为：融合数据与语义知识以实现高效且有效的语义地图构建
summary_translated: 语义地图模型（SMMs）通过比较跨语言的形式-意义映射来构建反映概念相似性的图结构。专家构建此类模型不仅遵循数据约束，即连通性假设——同一形式所属的概念节点必须相连——还融入其先前的语义知识。当前的自动方法忽略了这种知识，这会因扩大候选图的搜索空间而损害准确性和效率。本文将语言模型内部表示中隐藏的分布语义知识融入一种自上而下、数据驱动的算法中。这种类专家行为对巨大搜索空间中的候选对象进行重新排序，由概念语义相似性引导。在自收集的10个数据集基准和综合指标上的实验表明，我们的方法能够既有效又高效地构建SMMs。

summary: The state of the art techniques in Machine Translation (MT) require large amounts of symmetric resources from source and target languages. This is true regardless of whether the approach is Transfer or Interlingua, Symbolic or Statistical. Symmetry within these approaches is necessary to ensure quality, robustness and retargetability. In reality, such symmetry, whether it is in terms of structural transfer lexicons, interlingual dictionaries or parallel corpora, is a major bottleneck in developing any MT system.   This dissertation presents an approach to MT that addresses the lack of symmetry by exploiting symbolic and statistical target language resources in source-poor/target-rich language pairs. This approach is called Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation (GHMT). Expected source language resources include a syntactic parser and a simple one-to-many translation dictionary. No transfer rules or complex interlingual representations are used. Rich target language symbolic resources are used to overgenerate multiple structural variations from a target-glossed syntactic dependency representation of source language sentences. Statistical target-language resource are then used to select amongst the overgenerated translations. The source-target asymmetry of systems developed in this approach makes them more easily retargetable to new source languages.
title: Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation
comment: Dissertation submitted to the Faculty of the Graduate School of the University of Maryland at College Park in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy 2003
title_translated: 生成主导型混合机器翻译
summary_translated: 当前最先进的机器翻译（MT）技术需要源语言和目标语言之间大量对称的资源支持。无论采用转移法还是中间语方法，符号化或统计方法，这种对称性对于保证质量、鲁棒性和可重定向性都是必要的。然而，在实际中，无论是结构转移词典、跨语言词典还是平行语料库，这种对称性都成为开发任何MT系统的重大瓶颈。本论文提出一种新的MT方法，通过利用源语言贫乏/目标语言丰富的语言对中的符号化和统计目标语言资源来解决对称性不足的问题。该方法称为生成主导型混合机器翻译（GHMT）。预期的源语言资源包括句法解析器和简单的多对一翻译词典，不使用转移规则或复杂的中间语表示。利用丰富的目标语言符号资源，从源语言句子的目标标注句法依存表示中生成多种结构变体，随后使用统计目标语言资源从这些过度生成的翻译中进行选择。该方法所构建的系统具有源-目标不对称性，使其更容易迁移到新的源语言。

summary: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. We introduce Deep Fusion Memory (DFM), a parametric memory architecture that reduces this construction workload and incorporates learned memory into intermediate hidden states. A causal memory predictor learns to generate memory from the preceding context, using retrieved chunk embeddings from the corpus as supervision. The predicted memory is shared across tokens within each chunk and fused into their hidden states through gated cross-attention. Memory prediction and fusion are trained end to end with the backbone frozen, and inference requires no explicit retrieval. Compared with existing parametric memory approaches, which often construct token-level memory targets, DFM requires $32\times$ fewer retrieval queries and $2048\times$ fewer retrieved items to construct its training data. Across six QA tasks, DFM performs better over the strongest baseline by 12.71% on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and 11.19% on Qwen3-8B-Base. Beyond QA, domain adaptation yields average gains of 6.51 and 4.38 points over Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively.
title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
title_translated: 深度融合记忆：面向大语言模型的块级参数化记忆
summary_translated: 大语言模型需要有效的方法来获取和使用预训练之外的外部知识。持续预训练存在灾难性遗忘风险，而推理时的检索则会带来显著开销。外部参数化记忆避免了在线检索，但其训练数据构建需要大量离线搜索，且输出层插值仅提供浅层融合。我们提出深度融合记忆（DFM），一种参数化记忆架构，能够减少数据构建的工作量，并将学习到的记忆融入中间隐藏状态。一个因果记忆预测器学习从先前上下文中生成记忆，以从语料库中检索到的块嵌入作为监督信号。预测的记忆在每个块内共享，并通过门控交叉注意力机制融合到各标记的隐藏状态中。记忆预测与融合与主干模型端到端联合训练，且冻结主干模型，推理过程无需显式检索。相比现有参数化记忆方法（通常构建基于标记级别的记忆目标），DFM在构建训练数据时所需检索查询减少32倍，所需检索项减少2048倍。在六个问答任务中，DFM在Mistral-7B-v0.3上比最强基线提升12.71%，在Qwen3-8B-Base上提升11.19%。在非问答任务中，领域适应分别带来6.51和4.38分的平均增益。

summary: Large Language Models often generate factually correct responses that fail to maintain user-requested perspectives, blending multiple perspectives and forcing users to filter through unwanted information---a perspective control failure that factual accuracy metrics cannot detect. We introduce PerspectiveBench, a benchmark quantifying perspective alignment by constructing scenarios where multiple valid reasoning paths coexist, and propose the Perspective Alignment Score (PAS) to measure adherence to specified perspectives. Experiments reveal that state-of-the-art models successfully include target content but fail to exclude non-requested perspectives. Providing documents through RAG improves factual grounding but does not resolve perspective drift, as models prioritize comprehensive coverage over strict user constraints. Code and data are available at https://github.com/sunghoon014/PerspectiveBench.
title: Beyond Factual Accuracy: A Benchmark for Evaluating Perspective Alignment in LLMs
title_translated: 超越事实准确性：评估大语言模型视角一致性的基准测试
summary_translated: 大语言模型常常生成事实正确的回答，却无法保持用户要求的特定视角，导致多种视角混杂，迫使用户过滤无关信息——这是一种无法被事实准确性指标检测到的视角控制失败。我们引入PerspectiveBench，一个量化视角一致性的基准测试，通过构建多个有效推理路径共存的情境，并提出视角一致性评分（PAS）来衡量模型对指定视角的遵循程度。实验表明，最先进模型虽能包含目标内容，但未能排除非请求的视角。通过RAG提供文档可改善事实基础性，但无法解决视角漂移问题，因为模型更倾向于全面覆盖而非严格遵守用户约束。代码与数据可在https://github.com/sunghoon014/PerspectiveBench 获取。

summary: Looped language models increase computational depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to improve model quality without adding parameters. However, sequential dependencies between loop iterations increase autoregressive decoding latency. We introduce Dual-Slot, an architecture that reorganizes serial looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots. Rather than waiting for the current token's latent computation to finish, the prediction slot combines the previous token's deep latent state with the current representation, while the latent slot produces a state for the next decoding step. This shifts the latent dependency across adjacent tokens, replacing two sequential module invocations with a single paired invocation while preserving standard autoregressive generation. To preserve token-level parallelism during training, we use a small number of Jacobi iterations to refine latent states across the sequence in parallel. Experiments on Qwen-style dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models show consistent improvements in language modeling and average downstream accuracy. On the 1B dense model, Dual-Slot reduces Pile validation perplexity from 7.25 to 7.00 and improves average five-shot accuracy across nine task configurations by 2.26 percentage points. After supervised fine-tuning, it improves zero-shot GSM8K accuracy by 5.83 and 3.49 percentage points for the 1B dense and A0.6B MoE models, respectively. Across the evaluated batch sizes, Dual-Slot retains 93.1-96.5% of vanilla decoding throughput for the dense model and 98.1-99.6% for the MoE model.
title: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models
title_translated: 双槽机制：从串行循环到并行槽位的语言模型设计
summary_translated: 循环语言模型通过反复应用共享层增加计算深度，从而在不增加参数量的情况下提升模型质量。然而，循环迭代之间的序列依赖关系增加了自回归解码延迟。我们提出Dual-Slot架构，将串行循环计算重新组织为并行的潜在槽和预测槽。不再等待当前标记的潜在计算完成，预测槽将前一标记的深层潜在状态与当前表示结合，而潜在槽则生成下一解码步骤的状态。这将潜在依赖关系转移到相邻标记之间，用一次成对调用替代两次串行模块调用，同时保持标准自回归生成。为在训练期间保持标记级并行性，我们使用少量雅可比迭代并行优化序列中的潜在状态。在Qwen风格的密集模型和专家混合（MoE）模型上的实验显示，语言建模和平均下游准确率均有持续提升。在1B参数的密集模型上，Dual-Slot将Pile验证困惑度从7.25降至7.00，并在九个任务配置下的平均五次提示准确率提升2.26个百分点。经过监督微调后，它使1B密集模型和A0.6B MoE模型的零样本GSM8K准确率分别提升5.83和3.49个百分点。在所有评估的批大小下，Dual-Slot在密集模型上保留了93.1%-96.5%的原始解码吞吐量，在MoE模型上保留了98.1%-99.6%。

summary: Mathematical problem solving and autonomous agents are increasingly important applications of language models, demanding stronger reasoning capabilities. Computational depth is a key resource for such reasoning, but adding model layers increases both training and inference costs, while test-time scaling incurs substantial additional inference computation. We introduce P2N (Previous to Next), which reuses the previous token's deep representations, already available during generation, to increase effective computational depth with negligible decoding overhead. Specifically, P2N adds the previous token's deep hidden state to the current token's shallow representation, allowing subsequent layers to build on previously completed deep computation. This recurrence extends effective computational depth across tokens, while introducing only a single vector addition per decoding step. We train the recurrence using parallel Jacobi updates restricted to a middle-layer core. Experiments with Qwen-style models show that, at 1.5B parameters, P2N improves GSM8K accuracy by over 10 percentage points under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting, with nearly unchanged decoding latency. The benefits also extend to language modeling and average performance on general downstream benchmarks. on general downstream benchmarks.
title: P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth
title_translated: P2N：通过复用深层表示实现更大的有效深度
summary_translated: 数学问题求解和自主智能体是语言模型日益重要的应用场景，对更强的推理能力提出了更高要求。计算深度是此类推理的关键资源，但增加模型层数会同时提高训练和推理成本；而测试时扩展则带来显著额外的推理计算开销。我们提出P2N（Previous to Next），通过复用生成过程中已有的前一标记的深层表示，以极小的解码开销增加有效计算深度。具体而言，P2N将前一标记的深层隐藏状态添加到当前标记的浅层表示中，使后续层能够基于已完成的深层计算进行构建。这种递归机制在标记间扩展了有效计算深度，每解码步仅引入一次向量加法。我们使用受限于中间层核心的并行雅可比更新来训练该递归机制。在Qwen风格模型上的实验表明，当参数量为1.5B时，P2N在零样本和少样本提示下均使GSM8K准确率提升超过10个百分点，且解码延迟几乎不变。该优势也延伸至语言建模和一般下游基准的平均性能。

summary: Large language models sometimes reply in an unexpected language, a failure known as language confusion. We ablate individual attention heads in 12 model checkpoints spanning seven model series, using FLORES-200 continuations in five languages and Language Confusion Benchmark (LCB) chat replies. In ten models, zeroing one head causes substantially more departures from the expected language than zeroing any other head in its layer; its LCB pass-rate drop persists, though reduced, under mean ablation. Seven heads move 8.0 to 51.5 percent of all FLORES continuations out of the prompt's language, versus at most 1.4 percent for other same-layer heads; the other three mainly affect explicitly requested languages. These seven heads matter less in base models given plain text. In two models, replacing the values a head reads at the requested-language name with another language's mean makes replies fail and shifts some into that language, unlike a random change of equal size. Replacing a head's output with another language's mean redirects 84 to 99 percent of scored non-English monolingual LCB replies into that language in five models. Yet the requested language's mean improves crosslingual replies beyond every control head only in the two Gemma models, whose baselines are low. Code and results are available in the public repository at https://github.com/christian-hoang-04/anonymous-release.
title: One Head Away from Language Confusion: Single Attention Heads Across Model Families
title_translated: 距离语言混淆仅一步之遥：跨模型系列的单一注意力头研究
summary_translated: 大型语言模型有时会以意外的语言进行回复，这种现象被称为语言混淆。我们对七个模型系列共12个模型检查点中的单个注意力头进行了消融实验，使用FLORES-200在五种语言下的延续任务以及语言混淆基准（LCB）的聊天回复。在十个模型中，将某个头置零导致的语言偏离程度远高于其所在层中其他任何头的置零效果；即使在均值消融下，该头的LCB通过率下降仍持续存在但有所减弱。七个头使8.0%至51.5%的所有FLORES延续文本脱离提示语言，而同一层中其他头的影响最多仅为1.4%；其余三个头主要影响显式请求的语言。在基础模型中，纯文本环境下这些头的作用较小。在两个模型中，将头读取的目标语言名称对应的值替换为另一语言的均值，会导致回复失败并使部分输出转向该语言，而随机同等大小的改变则不会产生类似效果。将头的输出替换为另一语言的均值，可在五个模型中将84%至99%的评分非英语单语LCB回复引导至该语言。然而，只有在Gemma两个模型中，目标语言的均值才能在所有控制头之上提升跨语言回复表现，因为它们的基线较低。代码和结果已公开于GitHub仓库：https://github.com/christian-hoang-04/anonymous-release。

summary: The throughput gains of speculative decoding depend on the trade-off between acceptance length and execution latency. We ask when additional acceptance is worth the cost of obtaining it. We establish a comparison protocol spanning training, inference, and evaluation, remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two target models. Alignment changes the picture: gaps that appear large in published comparisons shrink substantially under shared training and inference conditions. This narrowing motivates two deeper questions: how is acceptance improved at different costs, and when do these gains improve throughput? We find that acceptance can be improved through nearly free objective and context changes or more expensive token-to-token conditioning. DCore illustrates the former route as a strong baseline with little additional measured drafting overhead. The payoff is conditional: task uncertainty and serving conditions affect acceptance returns, execution costs, and the preferred drafter and budget. These findings inform future drafter design and deployment choices.
title: When Does Better Acceptance Pay? A Controlled Study of Speculative Decoding
comment: 24 pages, 11 figures. Project page: this https URL
title_translated: 何时更好的接受率才值得？关于推测解码的受控研究
summary_translated: 推测解码的吞吐量提升取决于接受长度与执行延迟之间的权衡。我们探讨了额外接受是否值得为此付出代价。我们建立了一个涵盖训练、推理和评估的比较协议，重新测量已发布的检查点，并在十个基准和两个目标模型上对六种草稿生成器配方进行再训练，使用共享的目标生成数据。对齐改变了局面：在公开比较中看似巨大的差距，在共享训练和推理条件下显著缩小。这一缩小引出了两个更深层次的问题：不同成本下接受率如何提升，以及这些提升何时能真正提高吞吐量？我们发现，接受率可通过几乎无成本的目标函数和上下文调整，或更昂贵的词元到词元条件化来改进。DCore展示了前一种路径，作为具有极小额外开销的强基线。收益是条件性的：任务不确定性和服务条件会影响接受回报、执行成本以及首选草稿器和预算。这些发现为未来草稿器的设计与部署提供了指导。

summary: State media outlets often project their governments' narratives to target both domestic and foreign audiences. Because this content is plentiful and free to access, it appears widely in the web corpora that large language models (LLMs) are trained on and that retrieval systems draw from. However, the prevalence of state media in these corpora and its potential influence on LLM outputs remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce WorldStateMedia, an open dataset of 118 million state media articles from 136 countries in 114 languages. We extract these articles from existing pretraining corpora and annotate each outlet with level of state control from State Media Monitor. Using WorldStateMedia to audit these corpora, we find that, in English web crawls, the share of state media pages from editorially controlled (vs. independent) outlets rose from 39% in 2013 to 93% in 2025. In several low-resource languages, state media make up a substantial share of all web data, such as 17.8% for Uyghur and 7.8% for Belarusian. To characterize the differing narratives of news outlets, we compare Russian and Ukrainian state media in English and in their native languages, revealing asymmetric topical focus and opposing framings of contested issues such as Crimea. Furthermore, in a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experiment on territorial disputes, retrieving a country's state media shifts model answers toward that country's claims, most strongly for English-language (foreign-targeted) media. We release WorldStateMedia to support multilingual, cross-national insights on state media at https://huggingface.co/collections/manestay/worldstatemedia
title: The World as Viewed by 136 Countries: An Open, Curated, Annotated, and Multilingual Dataset of 118 Million State Media Articles
title_translated: 136个国家眼中的世界：一个开放、精选、标注且多语言的1.18亿篇国家媒体文章数据集
summary_translated: 国家媒体机构经常传播其政府的叙事，面向国内外受众。由于这类内容丰富且免费可获取，广泛出现在大型语言模型（LLM）训练所用的网络语料库以及检索系统所依赖的数据中。然而，国家媒体在这些语料库中的普遍性及其对LLM输出的潜在影响仍缺乏深入探索。本文介绍WorldStateMedia，一个包含来自136个国家、114种语言的1.18亿篇国家媒体文章的开放数据集。我们从现有预训练语料库中提取这些文章，并根据State Media Monitor对每家媒体的国家控制程度进行标注。利用WorldStateMedia对这些语料库进行审计，我们发现，在英文网络爬取中，编辑受控（vs. 独立）媒体页面的比例从2013年的39%上升至2025年的93%。在若干低资源语言中，国家媒体占全部网页数据的相当大比例，例如维吾尔语占17.8%，白俄罗斯语占7.8%。为刻画新闻媒体叙事差异，我们对比了俄语和乌克兰语国家媒体在英语及母语中的报道，揭示出主题关注的不对称性和对克里米亚等争议问题的对立框架。此外，在针对领土争端的检索增强生成（RAG）实验中，检索某国国家媒体会使模型回答倾向于该国立场，尤其在英语（面向外国）媒体中表现最明显。我们已将WorldStateMedia发布，以支持多语言、跨国界对国家媒体的洞察：https://huggingface.co/collections/manestay/worldstatemedia。

summary: Benchmarking large language model (LLM)-generated text detectors commonly relies on aggregate detector-level metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, and AUC. Although useful for summarizing overall performance, these metrics provide limited insight into how benchmark composition shapes detector comparisons or which texts distinguish detectors with different response profiles. We propose a measurement-based benchmarking framework for jointly characterizing benchmark heterogeneity and detector behavior using multidimensional item response theory (IRT). By treating benchmark texts as measurement items and detectors as respondents, the framework estimates text-level discrimination and difficulty-location parameters alongside multidimensional detector abilities. We apply the framework to a benchmark of 32K human-written and machine-generated texts across four domains, evaluated by 14 detectors. The estimated IRT item-parameter space reveals distinct but overlapping human-machine distributions, with substantial variation across domains and text lengths. The human-machine label shows the strongest multivariate association with this space, while domain and text length further contribute to benchmark heterogeneity. Detector ability profiles reveal multidimensional and domain-dependent response patterns that are not fully reflected in aggregate performance rankings. As a practical application, clustering texts in the estimated IRT space yields a compact subset of 2,088 texts (6.5\% of the full 32K benchmark) that largely preserves the comparative detector-performance patterns observed on the full benchmark. Overall, the proposed framework provides a principled and interpretable methodology for benchmarking heterogeneous detection technologies while jointly characterizing the measurement properties of the texts used for their evaluation.
title: A Measurement Perspective on Benchmarking LLM-Generated Text Detectors using Item Response Theory
title_translated: 基于项目反应理论的LLM生成文本检测器基准测试测量视角
summary_translated: 对大型语言模型（LLM）生成文本检测器的基准测试通常依赖于整体检测器级别的指标，如准确率、F1分数和AUC。尽管这些指标有助于总结整体性能，但它们难以揭示基准构成如何影响检测器比较，也无法识别哪些文本能区分具有不同响应模式的检测器。我们提出一种基于测量的基准测试框架，采用多维项目反应理论（IRT）联合刻画基准异质性与检测器行为。通过将基准文本视为测量项目，检测器视为应答者，该框架估计文本层面的区分度与难度位置参数，同时推断多维检测器能力。我们将该框架应用于包含32,000条人工撰写与机器生成文本的基准，由14个检测器评估。估计的IRT项目参数空间揭示了人类与机器文本分布的显著但重叠特征，且在不同领域和文本长度间存在显著差异。人类/机器标签与该空间具有最强的多变量关联，而领域和文本长度进一步加剧了基准异质性。检测器能力图谱显示了多维且领域依赖的响应模式，这些特征无法完全体现在整体性能排名中。作为实际应用，对估计的IRT空间中的文本聚类，可得到仅2,088条文本（占完整基准的6.5%）的紧凑子集，基本保留了完整基准上的检测器性能比较模式。总体而言，该框架提供了一种原则性强、可解释的异构检测技术基准方法，同时联合刻画了用于评估的文本测量属性。

summary: Checklist rubrics applied by large language model (LLM) judges have become a standard instrument for evaluating open-ended outputs and for rewarding them during training. Two assumptions surround this practice: that leniency or strictness is a property of the judge model, and that a rubric can be improved by asking a model to review it. We test both in a controlled grading task with planted flaws and on two human-labeled datasets, SummEdits and RAGTruth. Holding the judge and the outputs fixed, rubric content moves the pass rate of correct outputs from 2% to 100%, whereas changing the judge model or the rendering of the same checks moves it by a few points. Model self-review then drifts the rubric toward the reviser's own standard: it adds requirements the task never stated and deletes checks that human labels had taught, with three reviser models and on all three datasets. To measure and control this, we show that under all-must-pass aggregation the Shapley value of each check has an exact closed form, which yields per-check catch credit, false-fail blame and unique catches in linear time. Attribution shows that self-review deletes the checks that do unique work and keeps the checks that cause false fails. A change-control gate that combines these quantities with a provenance freeze on label-derived checks holds nearly every drifting revision chain at its starting quality, with identical decisions under three judge models.
title: Rubrics Carry the Standard: Shapley Attribution for Checklist-Based LLM Judges
title_translated: 评分标准决定标准：基于Shapley值的清单式LLM评判器归因分析
summary_translated: 由大型语言模型（LLM）评判器使用的清单式评分标准已成为评估开放式输出及训练过程中奖励机制的标准工具。该实践背后有两个假设：一是宽严程度是评判模型本身的属性，二是可以通过让模型审查评分标准来改进它。我们在带有预设缺陷的受控评分任务以及两个由人类标注的数据集（SummEdits 和 RAGTruth）上验证了这两个假设。在固定评判模型和输出的前提下，评分标准的内容可使正确输出的通过率从2%提升至100%，而更换评判模型或相同检查项的呈现方式仅带来几百分点的变化。模型自审则使评分标准向修订者自身标准漂移：添加任务从未提及的要求，并删除人类标签所教授的检查项，这一现象在三种修订模型和所有三个数据集上均出现。为测量和控制这种漂移，我们证明在“全须全尾”聚合下，每个检查项的Shapley值具有精确闭合形式，可在线性时间内计算出每项的捕获信用、误判责任和独特捕捉能力。归因分析表明，自审过程删除了那些承担独特工作的检查项，却保留了导致误判的检查项。一种结合这些量度与标签衍生检查项溯源冻结的变更控制门，能够几乎完全保持每个修订链的初始质量，且在三种评判模型下决策一致。

summary: Reasoning post-training on long trajectories has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but scaling such training to large datasets is increasingly expensive. We study target-aware reasoning data selection, where a small reference set specifies a target capability and guides the selection of training trajectories for specialization. We find that existing target-aware methods can exhibit limited target discrimination on long reasoning trajectories, while dominant population-level structure in candidate gradients can obscure finer target-dependent variation during gradient matching. To address these limitations, we introduce Deconfounded Gradient Matching (DeGMatch), which first constructs a target-relevance gate and then reranks candidates using model-specific gradients. DeGMatch centers gradients using the candidate-population mean and removes leading principal directions before target matching, reducing the influence of dominant population-level structure and improving target discrimination. Across mathematics, science, and code, DeGMatch outperforms strong heuristic, target-aware, and reasoning-specific data selection baselines, while remaining effective across selection budgets, model families, and scales. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CHLee0801/degmatch.
title: DeGMatch: Target-Aware Reasoning Data Selection via Deconfounded Gradient Matching
title_translated: DeGMatch：通过去混淆梯度匹配实现目标感知的推理数据选择
summary_translated: 在长轨迹上进行推理后训练显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但将此类训练扩展到大规模数据集的成本日益高昂。我们研究了目标感知的推理数据选择，即通过一个小的参考集指定目标能力，并指导训练轨迹的选择以实现专业化。我们发现，现有目标感知方法在长推理轨迹上的目标区分能力有限，而候选梯度中的主导群体结构会掩盖梯度匹配过程中的细微目标相关变化。为解决这些局限性，我们提出去混淆梯度匹配（DeGMatch），该方法首先构建目标相关门控机制，然后使用模型特定梯度重新排序候选样本。DeGMatch 在候选样本与总体均值对齐并去除主要主方向后再进行目标匹配，从而降低主导群体结构的影响，提升目标区分能力。在数学、科学和代码任务中，DeGMatch 均优于强基线的启发式、目标感知及推理专用数据选择方法，且在不同选择预算、模型家族和规模下均保持有效性。代码已公开于 https://github.com/CHLee0801/degmatch。

summary: Language models behind coding agents are post-trained with outcome rewards, and recent methods concentrate credit on the turns that decide the outcome. We find that defensive actions beyond what a task requires escape both. They begin at silent forks, the turns where every next action leads to the same outcome. Such actions leave the success rate unchanged, and frontier models take the disproportionate branch there in up to 91% of decisive actions under implicit budgets. The most direct fix, a checker in the trajectory reward, reaches these forks only through fully proportionate trajectories, leaving 74% of GRPO groups with identical rewards and behavior unchanged. This motivates a rethink of where learning signals belong, namely where behavior diverges, which a behavioral checker can locate and the outcome cannot. Our method, ForkDPO, contrasts a proportionate and a disproportionate action at the same prefix, at silent forks on both sides of the required behavior. On a test set of unseen repositories, it lowers a 4B model's disproportionate behavior from 70.3% to 58.9%, against 67.7% for DPO at randomly chosen turns, establishing behavioral divergence as a learning signal for how agents act beyond whether they finish. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Astarojth/silent-forks.
title: Over-Defense in Coding Agents Begins at Silent Forks
comment: 27 pages, 10 figures, 31 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 编码智能体中的过度防御始于静默分支
summary_translated: 编码智能体背后的语言模型通过结果奖励进行后训练，近期方法集中于将信用分配给决定结果的决策回合。我们发现，超出任务需求的防御性行为也会被保留，这些行为始于静默分支——即所有后续动作都会导致相同结果的回合。这类行为不会改变成功率，前沿模型在隐含预算下高达91%的关键决策中选择了非比例分支。最直接的修复方法是轨迹奖励中的检查器，但它仅能通过完全比例的轨迹到达这些分支，导致74%的GRPO组奖励相同且行为不变。这促使我们重新思考学习信号应位于何处，即行为发生分歧之处，而行为检查器可定位这一区域，结果无法做到。我们的方法ForkDPO在相同前缀的静默分支两侧对比比例与非比例动作。在未见过的仓库测试集上，它将4B模型的非比例行为从70.3%降至58.9%，优于在随机回合采用DPO的67.7%，确立行为分歧作为智能体超越完成与否的行为学习信号。代码已公开于 https://github.com/Astarojth/silent-forks。

summary: We present Épi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. Épi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. Épi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, Épi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. We extend this research process to algorithmic coding with Épi-turbo, a lightweight configuration that develops executable solvers for tasks including vehicle routing, scheduling and production planning. On 30 FrontierOR tasks, Épi-turbo achieves a 5.4% higher total benchmark score than Codex at 64% of its model cost, using the same underlying model and reasoning effort. Épi is designed to support human understanding by connecting computational results to explicit methods and mathematical arguments that researchers can examine and build upon.
title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
title_translated: Epi：迈向持久、自我改进的自主研究智能体
