title_translated: BanglaShield：一种针对孟加拉语原生文本、罗马化文本和混合语言提示的抗脚本安全分类器与基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）的安全分类器通常在标准书写形式的文本上构建和评估，但像许多低资源语言一样，孟加拉语经常以原生文字、拉丁字母罗马化形式以及与英语、印地语或乌尔都语混合的形式书写。我们提出了BanglaShield，一个用于跨这些书写形式进行分级提示安全分类的资源和模型。我们将来自六个来源的10,245个孟加拉语提示整合到一个四级分类体系（安全、冒犯性、有害、严重）下，并将每个提示以三种对齐形式呈现，共享标签和群体感知的划分，从而实现严格的成对比较。在36,882个分类查询和24,318个人工标注响应上对六种当代LLM（包括一个专为孟加拉语设计的模型）进行基准测试，发现LLM分类器将47.0%的不安全原生文本提示标记为“安全”，在罗马化情况下上升至63.4%，而响应级别的安全准确率下降了10.3个百分点。三种多语言防护模型也通过了30.3%-57.3%的不安全原生文本提示。使用模型自身的分类作为输入过滤器仅能将有害合规性降低约五个百分点。相比之下，BanglaShield——一个紧凑的微调编码器——在原生文本上达到87.8的宏F1，在罗马化文本上达到84.4，分别比每种形式表现最佳的LLM高出42.8-46.1个百分点，且参数量仅为Gemma 4 31B的约1/130。我们已发布该语料库、划分、标注结果和模型。

summary: Computational models have explanatory power to understand cognition in individuals, but there is usually not enough training data to build such models with traditional machine learning. However, alternative architectures that model neural and cognitive processes in more detail can be more easily fit to individuals and can lead to mechanistic insights into human behavior. BiLex is such a computational model of the bilingual lexicon, containing a shared semantic system and phonetic language systems represented through self-organizing maps. In this study, BiLex was extended further into biological realism with excitatory and inhibitory lateral connections. This extension makes it possible to account for response times as well as common errors such as those based on semantic concept familiarity, typicality, and specificity. The Boston Naming Test was simulated in Spanish and English, and model performance approximated naming accuracy and error types in Spanish-English bilinguals with varying primary and secondary language histories. The results indicated that the approach captures semantic-level processes in bilingual lexical access, thus modeling the semantic cognition of individual subjects. In the future, such models may serve as a foundation for modeling impairments and treatment options.
title: Modeling bilingual naming performance through laterally-connected SOMs
title_translated: 通过侧向连接的自组织映射建模双语命名表现
summary_translated: 计算模型具有解释个体认知的能力，但传统机器学习通常缺乏足够的训练数据来构建此类模型。然而，能够更详细模拟神经与认知过程的替代架构更容易拟合个体，并可带来对人类行为的机制性洞察。BiLex是一种双语词典的计算模型，包含共享语义系统和通过自组织映射表示的语音语言系统。本研究进一步将BiLex扩展为更具生物真实性的结构，引入兴奋性和抑制性侧向连接。这一扩展使其能够解释反应时间以及常见的错误类型，如基于语义概念熟悉度、典型性和特异性的错误。我们模拟了西班牙语和英语的波士顿命名测试，模型性能近似于具有不同主语言和次语言背景的西英双语者的命名准确率和错误类型。结果表明，该方法捕捉到了双语词汇访问中的语义层面过程，从而实现了对个体受试者语义认知的建模。未来，此类模型可能成为建模语言障碍及其治疗方案的基础。

summary: BERT-based models require thousands of labeled samples to train. Larger models like GPT-X require only 1-5 examples per class. However, performance, cost and time tradeoffs of such models remain under-explored. In this work, we classify survey text data into 16 classes. We focus on experimental approaches and results on performance, cost, and time taken for this problem. We compare these parameters of a trained RoBERTa-based model, and an (off-the-shelf) GPT-3.5 model for text classification. Baseline experiments show that the time taken by GPT-3.5 for generating predictions on 10,000 records is 6 hours, whereas a RoBERTa-based model takes only 12 mins on a T4 GPU. To identify the best prompting approach for GPT-3.5, we explore batch prompting. We experiment with (1) batch-size, and (2) few-shot sampling. We find the best batch size is 20 with human few-shot curation. Experiments show the F1 score of a trained RoBERTa-based model (96%) is much higher than a GPT-3.5 model (83%). In case of GPT-3.5, batch prompting is beneficial in lowering inference costs by ~70%, without hindering task performance. We find the best approach is an ensemble of a RoBERTa-based and GPT-3.5 model (F1: 97.5%) incurring only 4.4% of inference cost compared to a standalone GPT-3.5.
title: Best of Both Worlds: Fine-Tuned Small Models Complement LLMs for Cost and Performance Benefits
comment: Work done in 2024, added for posterity
title_translated: 两全其美：微调的小型模型为成本与性能带来互补优势
summary_translated: 基于BERT的模型需要数千个标注样本进行训练，而更大的模型如GPT-X仅需每类1-5个示例即可。然而，这些模型在性能、成本和时间之间的权衡仍缺乏深入探索。本文针对调查文本数据进行16类分类任务，重点研究性能、成本和耗时方面的实验方法与结果。我们对比了训练好的RoBERTa模型与（现成的）GPT-3.5模型在文本分类上的表现。基线实验显示，GPT-3.5对10,000条记录生成预测耗时6小时，而RoBERTa模型在T4 GPU上仅需12分钟。为确定GPT-3.5的最佳提示策略，我们探索了批量提示技术，实验了（1）批量大小和（2）少样本采样。结果发现最佳批量大小为20，配合人工少样本筛选效果最佳。实验表明，训练后的RoBERTa模型F1得分为96%，远高于GPT-3.5模型的83%。对于GPT-3.5，批量提示可使推理成本降低约70%，同时不影响任务性能。我们发现最优方案是结合RoBERTa模型与GPT-3.5模型的集成方法（F1: 97.5%），其推理成本仅为独立使用GPT-3.5的4.4%。

summary: What happens after a learner makes an error, and how does the instructor's response shape the next turn? Investigating these exchanges across classrooms requires context-sensitive annotation that is difficult to scale manually. We introduce SLA-LENS, an end-to-end LLM-assisted framework that connects classroom transcripts to structured pedagogical annotations and evidence-linked descriptive analytics. Grounded in interactionist Second Language Acquisition (SLA) theory, its annotation schema captures second language learner errors, pedagogical functions, and uptake or repair while accounting for speaker roles, conversational context, and hierarchical labels. We apply the framework to 40 authentic online L2 Spanish classroom transcripts comprising over 21,000 sentence-level instances. We evaluate proprietary and open-weight LLMs, including task-specific QLoRA adaptation, using expert-reviewed gold annotations, held-out silver data, and metrics sensitive to different types of annotation error. A deterministic reporting layer generates reproducible visualizations of participation, feedback, learner errors, uptake, and temporal interaction patterns, linked to supporting transcript evidence. By making these patterns accessible and inspectable, SLA-LENS supports systematic classroom discourse research, pedagogical reflection, and curriculum design.
title: SLA-LENS: From Classroom Transcripts to CSLA-Informed and Evidence-Linked L2 Interaction Analytics
title_translated: SLA-LENS：从课堂转录到CSLA指导与证据关联的第二语言互动分析
summary_translated: 学习者出错后会发生什么？教师的回应如何影响下一回合？要研究这些课堂互动，需要上下文敏感的标注，但手动标注难以规模化。我们提出SLA-LENS，一个端到端的LLM辅助框架，将课堂转录连接到结构化教学标注和证据关联的描述性分析。该框架基于互动主义第二语言习得（SLA）理论，其标注模式捕捉第二语言学习者的错误、教学功能、接受或修正行为，同时考虑说话人角色、对话上下文和层级标签。我们将该框架应用于40个真实的在线第二语言西班牙语课堂转录，涵盖超过21,000个句子级实例。我们评估了专有和开源权重的LLM，包括任务特定的QLoRA适配，使用专家评审的黄金标注、保留的银色数据及对不同类型标注误差敏感的指标。一个确定性的报告层生成可复现的参与度、反馈、学习者错误、接受情况和时间交互模式的可视化图表，并链接至支持性的转录证据。通过使这些模式可访问、可检查，SLA-LENS支持系统的课堂话语研究、教学反思和课程设计。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in annotation tasks with varying success. While several studies have demonstrated the opportunities and shortcomings of LLMs for annotation, a critical question remains unanswered: is it possible to predict how well they will perform on a new dataset? To answer this and related questions, we construct two task families which induce 461 text classification datasets. We find that it is possible to predict LLM performance - to a certain degree - and that contrary to other work which highlights the usefulness of LLM verbalizations of self-confidence, internal log-probabilities are the most predictive signal.
title: Can This LLM Annotate My Data? Estimating Zero-Shot LLM Performance
title_translated: 这个LLM能标注我的数据吗？估计零样本LLM性能
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）在标注任务中被越来越多地使用，但表现参差不齐。尽管已有若干研究揭示了LLM在标注中的机遇与局限，但一个关键问题仍未解答：能否预测它们在新数据集上的表现？为回答这一问题及相关疑问，我们构建了两个任务族，生成了461个文本分类数据集。我们发现，一定程度上可以预测LLM的表现，且与以往强调LLM自我信心表述有用性的研究相反，内部概率值是最具预测力的信号。

summary: We empirically analyze two recently proposed encoder-free multimodal LLMs, Gemma-4 12B and Inkling-Small. Unlike previous multimodal LLMs, these models do not use modality-specific encoders to extract tokenized embeddings representing audio and image input; instead, they directly feed windows of samples, pixels, or spectral features to the Transformer language model. We analyze whether the early layers of these models learn to function similarly to dedicated audio and visual encoders. We find that these early layers do in fact act as ``implicit encoders,'' encoding audio and visual inputs in a way that is largely invariant to their cross-modal context. Furthermore, when performing multimodal reasoning tasks, we show that independently encoding the modalities throughout these early model layers achieves the same accuracy as jointly encoding them from the first layer onwards. Finally, we use layer-wise probing to analyze the salient information captured by the implicit encoders and find their behavior to be similar to several popular encoder models.
title: Encoder-Free Multimodal LLMs Learn Implicit Encoders
title_translated: 无编码器多模态大模型学习隐式编码器
summary_translated: 我们对两种近期提出的无编码器多模态大模型（Gemma-4 12B 和 Inkling-Small）进行了实证分析。与以往的多模态大模型不同，这些模型不使用特定模态的编码器来提取表示音频和图像输入的分词嵌入，而是直接将样本窗口、像素或频谱特征输入Transformer语言模型。我们分析了这些模型的早期层是否能起到类似专用音频和视觉编码器的作用。结果发现，这些早期层确实充当了‘隐式编码器’，以一种很大程度上不受跨模态上下文影响的方式编码音频和视觉输入。此外，在执行多模态推理任务时，我们证明在早期模型层中独立编码各模态，其准确率与从第一层开始联合编码相当。最后，我们通过逐层探测分析隐式编码器捕获的关键信息，发现其行为与多个主流编码器模型相似。

summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model solutions. Code is available at https://github.com/wenzhilics/tar.
title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
title_translated: 基于自适应回放保留可验证奖励强化学习中的推理多样性
summary_translated: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但常常会降低其推理行为的多样性。我们从有限样本学习动态的角度研究这一现象，发现有限的在线策略采样会逐步抑制语义上不同但奖励相同的推理模式。一旦某种模式被充分低估采样，标准的在线策略RLVR很少能恢复它。受此启发，我们提出了TAR（目标自适应回放）框架，旨在保留基础策略中已有的多样化正确推理行为。TAR构建了一个紧凑的记忆库，存储多样化的基础模型解决方案，并通过自适应机制选择性地回放这些行为，仅在RLVR过程中检测到存储行为被压制时才激活。在六个数学推理基准和两个Qwen2.5模型规模上，TAR始终在推理性能与多样性保持之间取得更优平衡，同时显著减少了对正确基础模型解的遗忘。代码已公开于 https://github.com/wenzhilics/tar。

summary: User simulators can help evaluate and train AI systems to interact with humans at scale. To do so, evaluation of user simulators must measure behavioral parity with people. We evaluate whether memory-constrained user simulators are sensitive to two factors known to affect human information retention: repetition of a fact and interference from competing information. We find that some simulators achieve human-like overall accuracy, and replicate the magnitude of repetition and interference effects, but none match people's accuracy on particular questions: while humans misremember facts, models forget them, leading to different error patterns. We release this data as a challenge benchmark for future work on user simulators.
title: Analyzing Repetition and Interference Effects in Memory-Constrained User Simulators
title_translated: 分析记忆受限用户模拟器中的重复与干扰效应
summary_translated: 用户模拟器可用于大规模评估和训练AI系统与人类交互。为此，必须衡量用户模拟器与人类行为的一致性。我们评估了记忆受限的用户模拟器是否对影响人类信息保留的两个因素敏感：事实的重复和竞争信息的干扰。我们发现，部分模拟器在整体准确率上达到人类水平，并复现了重复和干扰效应的量级，但没有一个能完全匹配人类在特定问题上的准确率：虽然人类会错误回忆事实，而模型则完全遗忘，导致错误模式不同。我们已将该数据集作为挑战基准发布，供未来用户模拟器研究使用。

summary: While aligned large language models (LLMs) can successfully complete many creative tasks, their outputs tend to be highly self-similar. Though solutions to this problem of "mode collapse" have been proposed, comprehensive large-scale surveys of the phenomenon in specific textual genres are still lacking. We address this gap through an extensive treatment of LLM mode collapse in poetry. Across 15 poetic forms, 248 subject matter tags, and 16 open-weight models, we generate over 1.1 million poems. To our knowledge, this constitutes the largest corpus of LLM-generated poetry to date. At million-poem scale, we find that LLM poetic vocabularies and rhyming abilities are substantial, but severely underutilized. In other words, LLMs are "lazy" poets: despite possessing large poetic inventories, LLMs over-rely on a small number of words, opening phrases, and rhymes. Further, we find that lexical homogenization differs across models and poetic forms, noting observed rhyming vocabulary is correlated with model size.
title: Language Models are Lazy Poets: Creative Mode Collapse at Scale
title_translated: 语言模型是懒惰的诗人：规模扩大下的创意模式坍塌
summary_translated: 尽管对齐的大语言模型（LLMs）能够成功完成许多创意任务，但其输出往往高度自我相似。虽然已有针对“模式坍塌”问题的解决方案，但针对特定文本体裁的大规模综合性调查仍显不足。我们通过深入研究诗歌领域的LLM模式坍塌现象填补了这一空白。在15种诗体、248个主题标签和16个开源模型上，我们生成了超过110万首诗歌。据我们所知，这是迄今为止最大的LLM生成诗歌语料库。在百万级诗歌规模下，我们发现LLM的诗歌词汇量和押韵能力虽可观，但严重未被充分利用。换句话说，LLM是‘懒惰的诗人’：尽管拥有庞大的诗歌资源，却过度依赖少数词语、开头短语和押韵模式。此外，我们还发现词汇同质化程度因模型和诗体而异，观察到的押韵词汇与模型规模呈正相关。

summary: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.
title: Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory
title_translated: 基于上下文管理与外部记忆的推理
summary_translated: 推理模型通过上下文记忆来维持其推理过程的状态。复杂问题需要更大的上下文窗口和更高的内存需求。在此情况下，若不采用缓存机制进行上下文管理，可能丢弃对推理有用的信息。我们提出RCMEM方法，通过引入外部记忆扩展上下文管理，从而在不增加推理模型上下文负担的前提下维护额外信息。RCMEM显著降低了需要反复计算中间步骤的问题的计算时间，同时在复杂问题上实现了更好的性能。我们在多种数学问题上验证了该方法，使用模型规模从0.4万到2500万参数不等，以及GPT-2模型。

summary: We investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multi-author style change detection. Using off-the-shelf LLMs or supervised fine-tuning solely within the target domain fails to yield effective features; for this reason, we propose cross-domain transfer learning with LLM-based embeddings fine-tuned for authorship verification. We fine-tune Mistral-7B embedding model and compare it with DeBERTa, used in the state-of-the-art (SOTA) systems in PAN-25 multi-author writing style analysis challenge. Results show that DeBERTa and Mistral excel in different user-generated text scenarios. We exploit this diversity by combining both embeddings, leading to more effective style change detection.
title: Multi-author style detection with stylistic embeddings
comment: Submitted and accepted to Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT) in Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), 2026
title_translated: 基于风格嵌入的多作者风格检测
summary_translated: 我们研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在多作者风格变化检测中的应用。仅使用现成的LLM或在目标领域内进行监督微调，无法获得有效特征；因此，我们提出了一种基于LLM嵌入的跨域迁移学习方法，该方法针对作者身份验证进行了微调。我们对Mistral-7B嵌入模型进行了微调，并将其与在PAN-25多作者写作风格分析挑战赛中表现优异的DeBERTa模型进行比较。结果表明，DeBERTa和Mistral在不同类型的用户生成文本场景中各具优势。通过结合两种嵌入，我们实现了更有效的风格变化检测。

summary: Human children learn language from continuous, prosodically structured speech long before they can read, yet almost all language models train on orthographic text. Building on previous phonemic BabyLM training (Goriely et al., 2024; arXiv:2410.22906), we ask whether supplying an estimate of the prosody infants exploit improves phonemic language modelling at BabyLM scale. We compare an orthographic baseline to three conditions forming a ladder of phonological richness. All conditions are trained as BERT MLMs at 10M and 100M words. Addressing the ecological validity of existing metrics in the small-data regime, we build a lexical decision task and two semantic organisation tasks. Our new lexical decision task offers improved insights into the distinction between wordlikeness, token familiarity, and lexicality as factors. Triphone phonotactic control and pseudo-log-likelihood scoring shows that these scores reflect phonotactic familiarity rather than wordhood: every model sits near or below chance on an adversarial inverted condition, revealing prior results of this kind as partly artefactual. On our new semantic tasks, a prosodically annotated phoneme stream gives the strongest taxonomic organisation at both the 10M and 100M word scales. Phonemic models with boundary structure are competitive with the orthographic baseline. These findings suggest that prosodic structure is a key component of phonemic language modelling in the small-data regime most analogous to infant learning.
title: Prosodic Structure as a Critical Component in Phonemic Language Modelling at BabyLM Scale
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (archival track)
title_translated: 韵律结构作为BabyLM规模下音素语言建模的关键组成部分
summary_translated: 人类儿童在能够阅读之前，便已从连续且具有韵律结构的语音中学习语言，然而几乎所有语言模型都基于书面文本进行训练。基于先前的音素BabyLM训练工作（Goriely等，2024；arXiv:2410.22906），我们探讨了提供婴儿所利用的韵律估计是否能提升BabyLM规模下的音素语言建模效果。我们比较了基于书面文本的基线与三种逐步增加语音丰富度的条件。所有模型均在1000万和1亿词规模下以BERT MLM形式进行训练。为应对小数据环境下现有评估指标的生态有效性问题，我们构建了一个词汇判断任务和两个语义组织任务。新的词汇判断任务提供了关于词形相似性、标记熟悉度和词汇性之间区别的更深入见解。三音素音位控制和伪对数似然评分显示，这些分数反映的是音位熟悉度而非词汇性：在对抗性反转条件下，所有模型的表现接近或低于随机水平，揭示了以往类似结果部分源于人为偏差。在新设计的语义任务中，带有韵律标注的音素流在1000万和1亿词规模上均展现出最强的分类组织能力。包含边界结构的音素模型表现可与书面文本基线相媲美。这些发现表明，在最接近婴儿学习的小数据环境中，韵律结构是音素语言建模的关键组成部分。

summary: Voice agents built as cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR)->large language model (LLM)-> text-to-speech (TTS) pipelines increasingly rely on conversational TTS: streaming, context conditioned models that adapt delivery to dialogue history. Such models are natural and expressive but offer little explicit control over how rare, trust-critical drug names are pronounced, because these entities are too infrequent, and their vocabulary too fast-growing, to be covered by any amount of pre-, mid-, or post-training. We retrofit phoneme controllability onto a pretrained conversational TTS model without any pre/mid-training, using an ARPAbet vocabulary exten-sion, continued phoneme-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a training-free inference-time acoustic-biasing step. On a 7,500 clip clinical drug-pronunciation evaluation, our model raises strict Gemini-judged correctness from 54.6% (no phoneme augmentation) to 90.7%, outperforming every conversational and stateless TTS baseline on the automatic metric. Because no training stage sees a drug name, the entire evaluation is out-of-domain, so the gains reflect learned pronunciation rather than memorization. In a blinded, randomized human study, adult listeners judge 84% of our clips correct, versus 82% for the strongest baseline, with overlapping confidence intervals on a stratified subset. Across all 250 matched clips, Gemini agrees with the human majority on 84.8% of binary labels (k{appa}=0.57).
title: Pronouncing Hard Words: Phoneme Adaptation of a Pretrained Conversational Text to Speech Model
title_translated: 攻克难发音词汇：预训练对话式文本转语音模型的音素适应
summary_translated: 基于级联自动语音识别（ASR）→大型语言模型（LLM）→文本转语音（TTS）架构构建的语音代理越来越多地依赖于对话式TTS：即流式传输、上下文感知的模型，能够根据对话历史调整表达方式。这类模型自然且富有表现力，但对罕见且关键的药物名称发音缺乏明确控制，因为这些实体出现频率过低，其词汇增长速度过快，任何预训练、中期或后期训练都无法覆盖。我们通过引入ARPAbet词汇扩展、持续的音素增强监督微调（SFT）以及无需训练的推理阶段声学偏置步骤，将音素可控性无缝集成到预训练对话式TTS模型中，无需任何预/中期训练。在包含7500个片段的临床药物发音评估中，我们的模型将Gemini严格判定的正确率从54.6%（无音素增强）提升至90.7%，在自动指标上优于所有对话式和无状态TTS基线。由于整个评估过程中未出现药物名称，所有测试均为域外，因此性能提升反映的是模型学到的发音能力而非记忆。在盲法随机的人类实验中，成年听众认为84%的音频片段正确，高于最强基线的82%，且在分层子集上的置信区间重叠。在全部250个匹配片段中，Gemini与人类多数意见一致率达84.8%（kappa=0.57）。

summary: We present CoDA, an open-source human-LM collaborative codebook development assistant that helps domain experts develop annotation guidelines for annotating new variables in unstructured text with language models. Existing language model annotation systems primarily focus on downstream classification performance, while assuming the availability of high-quality annotation guidelines, or codebooks. In practice, developing these codebooks is time-consuming and challenging, particularly for concepts that require expert knowledge. CoDA addresses this gap by collaborating with domain experts to iteratively develop codebooks through targeted review of incorrect language model predictions and incorporating expert feedback into the evolving codebook. We demonstrate CoDA on two real-world case studies: extracting health indicators from homelessness case management notes and classifying sentiment of wildlife trafficking posts on social media. Across both domains, CoDA produces codebooks that achieve downstream classification performance comparable to expert codebooks while reducing codebook development time from several weeks to two hours and requiring 5X fewer manually annotated examples. Applying CoDA to generate annotations at scale, we identified 2,410 case notes that contained health discussions or referrals and 10,196 social media posts expressing negative sentiment that may warrant investigation for potential wildlife trafficking. By accelerating codebook development, CoDA helps practitioners use language models to extract domain-specific insights from unstructured text at scale.
title: CoDA: A Human-LM Collaborative Codebook Development Assistant for Domain-Specific Text Annotation
comment: In Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing: System Demonstrations
title_translated: CoDA：面向特定领域文本标注的以人为本-LM协同代码本开发助手
summary_translated: 我们提出了CoDA，一个开源的人类与语言模型协同代码本开发助手，帮助领域专家利用语言模型从非结构化文本中为新变量开发标注指南。现有的语言模型标注系统主要关注下游分类性能，同时假设高质量的标注指南或代码本已经存在。但在实践中，开发这些代码本耗时且困难，尤其是涉及需要专业知识的概念时。CoDA通过与领域专家协作，通过对语言模型错误预测的针对性审查，并将专家反馈融入不断演进的代码本中，填补了这一空白。我们在两个真实案例研究中展示了CoDA的应用：从无家可归者管理记录中提取健康指标，以及对社交媒体上野生动物走私帖子的情感分类。在两个领域中，CoDA生成的代码本在下游分类性能上与专家代码本相当，同时将代码本开发时间从数周缩短至两小时，并减少了5倍的手动标注样本量。通过大规模应用CoDA生成标注，我们识别出2,410条包含健康讨论或转介的病例记录，以及10,196条可能涉及野生动物走私的负面情绪社交媒体帖子。通过加速代码本开发，CoDA帮助从业者大规模利用语言模型从非结构化文本中提取领域特定洞察。

summary: Everyday norms of social interaction - e.g. norms of sharing space, taking turns, or queuing - are essential to large societies, offering structured procedures for common interactions. However, it remains unclear how the underlying algorithms of these implicit joint plans evolve as they diffuse through populations. Here we show that this process of diffusion can select against complex algorithms in the earliest stages. We conducted a large-scale study of experimental diffusion of novel social norms among human participants, leveraging advances in program synthesis to characterize the procedures people developed in independent populations. Inherited procedures became structurally simplified and lost during interactions between participants who inherited different variants of joint-action norms; however, opportunities for interactive repair offset this pressure, preserving complex algorithms despite misalignment. These results demonstrate that interactive reasoning mediates selective pressures on structural complexity during cultural evolution of procedural norms.
title: Preservation and loss of algorithmic structure in experimental diffusion of joint-action norms
title_translated: 联合行动规范实验扩散中算法结构的保留与丧失
summary_translated: 日常社会互动规范——如空间共享、轮流发言或排队——对大型社会至关重要，为常见互动提供了结构化流程。然而，这些隐含联合计划背后的算法如何在人群中传播仍不清楚。本文表明，这种扩散过程在早期阶段就可能选择淘汰复杂算法。我们开展了一项大规模实验，研究人类参与者之间新型社会规范的扩散，借助程序合成技术来刻画不同群体独立发展出的操作程序。继承下来的程序在参与者间交互过程中发生结构简化并逐渐丢失；然而，交互修复的机会抵消了这一压力，使复杂算法得以在不一致的情况下仍被保留。这些结果表明，交互推理在程序规范的文化演化过程中调节着结构复杂性的选择压力。

summary: Prefix-tuning is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models (LLMs) that steers model outputs by prepending task-specific prefix representations to the input sequence. Despite its practical success, the theoretical understanding of the expressiveness of prefixes remains incomplete. In particular, the following question remains open: Given a pretrained autoregressive Transformer, for any input-output sequence pair $(\mathtt{x},\mathtt{y})$, does there always exist a prefix $\mathcal{S}$ such that prepending $\mathcal{S}$ to $\mathtt{x}$ induces the model to generate the target output $\mathtt{y}$? In this work, we prove that under the assumption that $\mathtt{y}$ is in the range of the pretrained Transformer, such a prefix $\mathcal{S}$ exists and can be explicitly computed by solving multiple linear systems. We further show that this assumption is necessary, in the sense that such a prefix may not exist when the assumption fails, thereby providing a complete answer to the above question. Our analysis is constructive and the obtained theoretical results hold under fairly general assumptions on model architecture. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 and Qwen3-4B demonstrate that our algorithm produces prefixes with strong control over model outputs.
title: Prefix-Tuning for Arbitrary Output Sequences on Pretrained Transformers
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL . Online demo: this https URL
title_translated: 基于预训练Transformer的任意输出序列的前缀调优
summary_translated: 前缀调优是一种针对大语言模型（LLM）的参数高效微调方法，通过在输入序列前添加特定任务的前缀表示来引导模型输出。尽管该方法在实践中取得了成功，但对前缀表达能力的理论理解仍不完整。特别是以下问题尚未解决：对于一个预训练的自回归Transformer模型，给定任意输入-输出序列对$(\mathtt{x},\mathtt{y})$，是否存在一个前缀$\mathcal{S}$，使得将$\mathcal{S}$附加到$\mathtt{x}$上能促使模型生成目标输出$\mathtt{y}$？本文证明，在假设$\mathtt{y}$位于预训练Transformer的输出范围内时，这样的前缀$\mathcal{S}$存在，并可通过求解多个线性系统显式计算得出。我们进一步表明，这一假设是必要的，因为当该假设不成立时，这样的前缀可能不存在，从而完整回答了上述问题。我们的分析具有构造性，所得理论结果在相当一般的模型架构假设下均成立。在GPT-2和Qwen3-4B上的大量实验表明，我们的算法能够生成对模型输出具有强控制力的前缀。

summary: Variable roles describe recurring behaviors such as accumulation, traversal, and retaining the best candidate encountered. We use Sajaniemi's independently defined taxonomy to study which role distinctions can be recovered from large language models, how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) retain those distinctions, and whether associated directions support control of generation. We introduce static annotation rules for all eleven roles and a corpus of 126,926 natural-code files across five languages. Across five model-SAE systems, residual probes outperform individual SAE features and tested lexical baselines, with modest losses after neutral target renaming. Combining SAE features closes much of the single-feature gap, but probes on SAE reconstructions are less sensitive to role-changing edits reviewed by LLMs. High paired ranking accuracy coexists with frequent false positives at fixed thresholds. During generation, interventions often change role annotations at the cost of correctness; changes accompanied by passing tests show no clear aggregate advantage over random controls. The benchmark separates role-related recoverability, SAE fidelity, and correctness-preserving control through matched prediction, source edits, and generation interventions.
title: Do LMs Know What Variables Do? Interpreting Code Representations via Variable Roles
title_translated: 语言模型是否理解变量的作用？通过变量角色解析代码表示
summary_translated: 变量角色描述了诸如累加、遍历和保留最佳候选等重复行为模式。我们采用Sajaniemi独立定义的分类体系，研究大语言模型能否恢复这些角色区分，稀疏自编码器（SAEs）如何保持这些区分，以及相关方向是否支持生成控制。我们为全部十一种角色引入静态注释规则，并构建了一个涵盖五种语言共126,926个自然代码文件的语料库。在五个模型-SAE系统中，残差探测器的表现优于单个SAE特征和测试的词汇基线，即使在中性目标重命名后也仅有适度损失。结合多个SAE特征可显著缩小单特征差距，但对SAE重构进行探测时，对角色变更编辑的敏感性较低。高配对排名准确率与固定阈值下的频繁误报并存。在生成过程中，干预操作常改变角色标注，但以牺牲正确性为代价；伴随通过测试的变更并未表现出相对于随机对照的明显整体优势。该基准通过匹配预测、源码编辑和生成干预，分离了角色可恢复性、SAE保真度和保持正确性的控制能力。

summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.
title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
comment: Code and Data: this https URL
title_translated: OR-License：评估LLM智能体作为真实世界运筹学实践者的性能
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能否直接从原始客户材料中交付专家级的运筹学（OR）解决方案，而无需事先由专家重新表述？现有的OR基准通常从自包含的描述或预定义优化任务开始，未能充分反映将原始商业材料转化为专业验证解决方案的过程。我们提出OR-License，这是一个涵盖10个工业场景、共计31个实例的端到端基准，数据来源于总价值达368万美元的付费OR项目。该基准保留了原始需求、输入数据、交付格式和信息边界（去标识化后）。为研究信息获取过程，我们引入ORSim，一个受控的客户模拟器，可在不提供运筹学专业知识的情况下披露业务事实。隐藏评估检查可行性，并将客观质量与基准构建前客户接受的原始专家解决方案进行对比。部署调整质量（DAQ）在各实例间平均专家相对质量，对不可行交付赋值为零。在使用编码代理框架的11个前沿LLM中，部分模型在条件客观质量上超过专家参考值，但无一达到其DAQu；最强的Claude Code配置实现88.39%的严格可行性，DAQu为0.87，而专家参考值为1.0。客户信息获取不仅限于澄清，还延伸至解决方案开发与验证，部分后期阶段显示出更高的确认问题解决比例。轨迹分析揭示了建模与实现失败，而任务均衡化研究链完成率在不同模型间介于24%至45%之间。这些发现强调了持续解决信息缺口、忠实问题建模以及基于证据的自我改进对可靠长周期智能体的重要性。

summary: As automated research is increasingly adopted for writing papers, automated review has become a critical link between paper generation and quality control. However, existing methods largely rely on single-model feedback or simple review aggregation, failing to explicitly model expert responsibilities or collective deliberation in actual peer reviews, which limits effective cross-examination and reliable decision-making. Therefore, we formulate paper review as a computational modeling problem of peer review mechanisms and propose RoundtableReview, a deliberative multi-agent framework for enhancing automated research. RoundtableReview structures each paper into eight semantic slots and coordinates six academic and industry reviewers with complementary perspectives, retrieval sources, and specialized responsibilities. Through independent assessment, cross-examination, roundtable deliberation, dynamically weighted voting, and chair synthesis, the framework generates evidence-based and traceable feedback. Experiments on two automated research backbones show that the method improves paper quality in both backbones and outperforms baselines in automatic and human evaluations with fewer comments.
title: Discuss More, Comment Less: Boosting Automated Research via Multi-Perspective Collaborative Review
title_translated: 多角度讨论，少些评论：通过多视角协作评审提升自动化研究
summary_translated: 随着自动化研究被越来越多地用于论文撰写，自动化评审已成为论文生成与质量控制之间的关键环节。然而，现有方法大多依赖单一模型反馈或简单的评审聚合，未能显式建模实际同行评审中的专家职责或集体审议过程，限制了有效的交叉质询和可靠决策。因此，我们将论文评审形式化为同行评审机制的计算建模问题，并提出RoundtableReview——一种增强自动化研究的审议型多智能体框架。RoundtableReview将每篇论文结构化为八个语义槽，协调六位具有互补视角、检索来源和专业职责的学术与产业评审员。通过独立评估、交叉质询、圆桌讨论、动态加权投票及主席综合，该框架生成基于证据且可追溯的反馈。在两个自动化研究基础架构上的实验表明，该方法提升了两者的论文质量，并在自动与人工评估中优于基线，同时减少评论数量。

summary: LLM agents that read untrusted content can be hijacked by prompt injections. Runtime monitors that try to catch a hijack before the agent acts, and benchmarks that score each task with a single run, share an assumption: whether an agent follows an injection is settled when the injection is read. We test this assumption with branching rollouts that replay an episode exactly up to the step at which the agent reads an injection and then resample the rest of the episode many times, splitting the outcome variance into a part fixed at read time and a part decided afterwards. Across four AgentDojo suites, a Qwen3 agent without thinking is largely decided at read time (0.91 of the outcome variance lies between states); with thinking on, this share drops to 0.62 (95% CI of the drop [-0.38, -0.22]), in the same direction for three attack templates and two success labels. How much is fixed at read time is a property of the model that the same measurement reveals, and thinking lowers the attack success rate of Qwen3 but raises it for two other models. Resampling from reasoning prefixes shows that the decision forms gradually as the agent reasons. Zero-shot chain-of-thought monitors built on cheaper models miss much of what is already decided, whereas stronger monitors, and a lookahead monitor that judges simulated next actions, come close to what the prefix determines. Finally, single-run labels of thinking agents disagree with a rerun up to 35% of the time, so benchmarks need repeated runs per task.
title: The Window Is in the Reasoning: When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections
title_translated: 窗口在推理之中：当LLM智能体决定是否遵循提示注入时
summary_translated: 读取不受信任内容的LLM智能体可能受到提示注入的劫持。运行时监控器试图在智能体执行前捕获劫持，以及以单次运行评分每个任务的基准，都基于一个假设：智能体是否遵循注入，是在读取注入时即已确定。我们通过分支回放测试这一假设，即精确重播一个情节直到智能体读取注入的步骤，然后多次重新采样后续情节，将结果方差分解为读取时刻固定的成分和之后决定的成分。在四个AgentDojo套件中，未启用思考的Qwen3智能体的结果方差主要在读取时刻确定（0.91的方差位于状态之间）；启用思考后，该比例降至0.62（95%置信区间下降[-0.38, -0.22]），在三种攻击模板和两种成功标签下方向一致。读取时刻固定的程度是模型本身的属性，同一测量揭示了思考会降低Qwen3的攻击成功率，却提高另外两个模型的攻击成功率。从推理前缀重新采样显示，决策随智能体推理逐步形成。基于更廉价模型的零样本思维链监控器遗漏了大量已在读取时决定的内容，而更强的监控器以及能判断模拟下一步动作的前瞻监控器，则接近前缀所决定的结果。最后，启用思考的智能体的单次运行标签与重跑结果在高达35%的情况下不一致，因此基准需要对每个任务进行多次运行。

summary: Machine translation systems often preserve meaning but systematically flatten linguistic style, a failure that is most acute when translating into non-Western languages. The RASTA framework of Havaldar et al. (2025a) addresses this through retrieval-augmented stylistic alignment, but relies on GPT-4, a closed, proprietary model. We investigate whether an open-weight translation specialist, Hunyuan-MT-7B, can serve as an open-weight alternative. We evaluate three variants of the model, the base model, a LoRA supervised fine-tune, and a GRPO-steered policy. We do this across three style dimensions (formality, politeness, and intimacy) and twelve directed language pairs, measuring style alignment with the correlation-based metric $\mathcal{A}$. We find that fine-tuning does not reliably improve alignment: the three variants are statistically indistinguishable in aggregate. The open backbone does not match RASTA-GPT-4 overall, but the shortfall is concentrated in formality and largely closes for intimacy and Chinese directions, where the open model matches or surpasses GPT-4 on individual pairs. An accessible RASTA pipeline built on an open model is thus already viable for parts of the problem.
title: Translating in style: An open-weight alternative to GPT-4 for culturally aligned machine translation
title_translated: 风格化翻译：一种文化对齐的机器翻译开源替代方案
summary_translated: 机器翻译系统通常能保留语义，但会系统性地弱化语言风格，尤其在翻译为非西方语言时更为明显。Havaldar 等人（2025a）提出的 RASTA 框架通过检索增强的风格对齐解决了这一问题，但依赖于 GPT-4 这类封闭的专有模型。我们研究了开源的专用翻译模型 Hunyuan-MT-7B 是否可作为替代方案。评估了该模型的三种变体：基础模型、LoRA 监督微调版本以及 GRPO 驱动的策略模型。在三个风格维度（正式程度、礼貌性、亲密性）和十二个方向的语言对上进行测试，使用基于相关性的度量 $Δ$ 来衡量风格对齐程度。结果发现，微调并未显著提升对齐效果：三种变体在整体上统计上无差异。尽管开源主干模型整体未达到 RASTA-GPT-4 的水平，但在正式程度方面存在差距，而在亲密性和中文方向上，该模型在个别语言对上已达到甚至超越 GPT-4。因此，基于开源模型构建的可访问 RASTA 流水线已在部分问题上具备可行性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as simulated respondents in computational social science, yet accurately reproducing population-specific heterogeneous response distributions remains challenging. Existing methods such as demographic prompting are sensitive to prompt design and increase inference overhead, while parameter-based methods struggle to reuse demographic information efficiently, limiting generalization to unseen combinations. In this regard, we propose PARADE, a composable PARAmetric DEmographic injection framework that represents each demographic attribute value with a reusable and composable LoRA module. Specifically, PARADE separates task-common survey capability from demographic-specific value shifts via a shared Task LoRA and attribute-level Demographic LoRAs, with composition calibration to reduce parameter interference. At inference time, target population models can be constructed on demand by recombining the relevant modules, including demographic combinations not observed during training. Extensive experiments on the World Values Survey and SocioBench across three backbone models show that PARADE achieves strong population-level distribution alignment while maintaining competitive predictive performance, reducing KL divergence by up to 52.8% relative to the strongest baseline.
title: Composable Parametric Demographic Injection for Values Survey Simulation
title_translated: 可组合的参数化人口属性注入用于价值观调查模拟
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在计算社会科学中越来越多地被用作模拟受访者，但准确再现特定人群的异质性响应分布仍具挑战性。现有方法如人口提示对提示设计敏感且增加推理开销，而基于参数的方法难以高效复用人口信息，限制了对未见组合的泛化能力。为此，我们提出 PARADE——一种可组合的 PARAmetric DEmographic injection 框架，将每个人口属性值表示为可复用、可组合的 LoRA 模块。具体而言，PARADE 通过共享的任务 LoRA 和属性级别的群体 LoRAs 分离任务通用能力与人口特异性偏移，并通过组合校准减少参数干扰。推理时，可通过重新组合相关模块按需构建目标人群模型，包括训练中未观察到的人口组合。在世界价值观调查和 SocioBench 数据集上，基于三种主干模型的大量实验表明，PARADE 实现了强大的群体级分布对齐，同时保持了具有竞争力的预测性能，相比最强基线 KL 散度降低高达 52.8%。

summary: The Prisoner's Dilemma has long served as a foundational framework for studying human decision-making and cooperative outcomes across social scenarios, yet human behavior consistently deviates from predictions of fully rational economic theory. Previous works have studied human and LLM outcomes in the Prisoner's Dilemma; however, these studies have lacked at least one key feature: a memory component for LLM agents, accessible open-source models, or comparison against empirical human data. This project investigates whether open-source LLMs, TII Falcon 7B Instruct, Google Gemma 7B, Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Microsoft Phi Mini MoE Instruct, and Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, can model human cooperation patterns in repeated Prisoner's Dilemma games, while examining how an LLM's knowledge that its opponent will be shuffled affects its decisions. Using a standardized prompting framework, we simulated interactions in two trial types: a fixed-partner setting where both agents retain memory, and a shuffled-partner setting where a memory-enabled agent, informed that its opponent changes across rounds, interacts with a memoryless agent. For each trial, we measured cooperation rates over 100 rounds and 10-round increments and compared them to human data from Montero-Porras et al. (2022). Under both frameworks, all LLMs differed from the human cooperation rate. Open-source LLMs generally over-cooperated relative to humans, particularly in the shuffled framework, where human cooperation averaged 28.5% while several models exceeded 80%. Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct showed deterministic tendencies, while Phi-mini-MoE-Instruct displayed greater variability and briefly approximated human rates. These findings suggest that LLMs have potential as behavioral simulation agents and provide a benchmark across two interaction environments, although open-source models are not yet reliable substitutes for human participants.
title: Modeling Human Behavior in the Prisoner's Dilemma with Large Language Models
title_translated: 利用大语言模型建模囚徒困境中的人类行为
summary_translated: 囚徒困境长期以来是研究人类决策与合作结果的基础框架，但人类行为始终偏离完全理性的经济理论预测。以往研究虽探讨过人类与 LLM 在囚徒困境中的表现，但普遍缺乏至少一个关键要素：LLM 代理的记忆机制、可获取的开源模型或与实证人类数据的对比。本研究考察开源 LLM（TII Falcon 7B Instruct、Google Gemma 7B、Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Microsoft Phi Mini MoE Instruct、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct）是否能在重复囚徒困境游戏中模拟人类合作模式，并分析 LLM 知道其对手会轮换时对其决策的影响。采用标准化提示框架，模拟两种试验类型：固定搭档场景（双方均具备记忆），以及轮换搭档场景（记忆启用的代理知道对手每轮变化，与无记忆代理互动）。每种试验中测量 100 轮及每 10 轮增量的合作率，并与 Montero-Porras 等人（2022）的人类数据进行比较。在两种框架下，所有 LLM 均与人类合作率存在差异。开源 LLM 总体上表现出过度合作，尤其在轮换框架中，人类平均合作率为 28.5%，而多个模型超过 80%。Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 表现出确定性倾向，而 Phi-mini-MoE-Instruct 变异更大，短暂接近人类水平。这些发现表明 LLM 具备作为行为模拟代理的潜力，并为两种交互环境提供了基准，但当前开源模型尚不能可靠替代人类参与者。

summary: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.
title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
comment: 45 pages, 16 figures, project page: this https URL
title_translated: 它真的能行吗？功能型 CAD 机构的合成
summary_translated: 尽管 LLM 代理能够生成视觉上合理的 CAD 组装，但这些设计往往无法实现预期的物理功能。我们研究了功能型 CAD 设计场景，即代理需理解模糊请求，构建并迭代修订满足物理仿真中功能要求的机构。验证这些要求极具挑战：不同候选机构可能通过完全不同的组件、控制方式和操作序列实现相同功能。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 FunCAD-Harness 框架，将抽象需求转化为针对候选机构的特定物理测试，并利用仿真反馈引导设计修正。为系统评估此能力，我们引入 FunCADBench 基准，涵盖 46 种机构族，包含相互依赖且多步骤的操作。在前沿 LLM 代理上的实验表明，FunCAD-Harness 能揭示肉眼无法察觉的细微机械故障，显著提升功能成功率，优于标准仿真增强基线。最终，我们的工作标志着迈向能够将人类意图转化为有效机构的 CAD 代理的重要一步。

summary: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.
title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 12 tables, including references and appendices
title_translated: WeAct：动态权重切换作为智能体动作
summary_translated: 长时程智能体必须从交错轨迹中学习多种能力。更新共享参数以学习新能力可能导致先前获得的能力退化，引发灾难性遗忘。随着轨迹展开，不同阶段可能需要不同能力，但传统联合训练和静态适配器合并维持固定的参数配置。我们提出 WeAct（Weight-level Internal Actions），在冻结主干网络上训练独立的能力特定 LoRA 适配器，并将适配器选择加入智能体的动作空间。这些内部动作利用模型原生工具调用接口，在共享上下文中按需组合能力。在八个深度研究基准上，Qwen3-32B 搭载 WeAct 的平均准确率比全微调对应方法高出 6.2%，且计算资源更少；相比最强的静态 LoRA 合并方法更是提升 27.5%。WeAct 还支持模块化持续适应：通过添加新的代码计算适配器扩展智能体能力，或更新现有写作适配器以提升报告质量。两项更新均不改变主干网络和其他适配器，支持智能体的模块化持续适应。

summary: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
title_translated: 野外智能体世界模型：计算机使用智能体环境合成
summary_translated: 智能体学习正从依赖人类数据转向通过与世界互动进行学习。然而，在真实计算机系统中直接扩展此类学习具有挑战性，并可能引入重大安全风险。为此，我们提出了野外智能体世界模型（WildAWM），一个可扩展的管道，用于合成可控的环境和任务，以训练通用计算机使用智能体（CUAs）。与现有方法通常专注于单一交互接口不同，我们构建了支持图形用户界面、模型上下文协议服务和命令行接口的可执行环境，使智能体能够灵活结合视觉交互、工具使用和代码执行。WildAWM 完全由开源模型驱动，证明高质量的计算机使用环境可以在不依赖专有前沿模型的情况下生成。除了环境外，我们通过引入基于执行的质量检测机制，解决了任务合成中的三个常见挑战：确保可解性、维持足够难度以及生成可靠的验证器，该机制结合异构智能体回放、交叉判断一致性检查和判断鲁棒性的反事实探测。由此产生的管道合成了341对长时程环境-任务组合，解决这些任务可能需要超过100步智能体操作，即使对于前沿模型也仍具挑战性，GPT-6-Astra仅能解决其中60%。我们在这些合成世界中仅训练了两个不同规模的Qwen模型，两者在涵盖网页、机械臂和计算机使用智能体的8个分布外基准上均取得显著提升，表明在WildAWM合成世界中学习能够广泛泛化到未见过的计算机使用任务。代码已公开于 https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM。

summary: Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher's bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher's coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce's choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher's probabilities ends at the teacher's decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.
title: Teacher Supervision, Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code in ancillary files
title_translated: 教师监督、固定表示与校准：候选评分决策模型的精确风险计算
summary_translated: 候选评分决策模型返回一组给定答案的概率分布。某系统Jev及其开源对应系统JevAny的公开文档描述了决定这些概率估计的三个训练要素：来自大模型的软目标、冻结的预训练主干网络和温度校准。我们在高斯近似模型中分析每个要素，其中有限样本风险可精确计算。学生模型在教师目标上训练会继承教师的偏差，更多学生数据无法消除该偏差，且与教师的一致性也无法揭示此偏差。固定表示仅在样本量低于明确阈值时降低风险。在probit模型中，精确校准映射为温度缩放，仅当教师系数方向正确时才能完全消除额外风险，否则会留下校准诊断无法检测的残余风险。在Luce选择公理下，候选评分在事件细化下一致当且仅当其通过log-sum-exp聚合。在来自消费者金融保护局的231,521条信用卡投诉数据上，基于逻辑教师概率训练的学生模型达到教师的决策成本，而基于结果训练的学生模型则低8%，30B模型零样本仍在校准后劣于教师，且该模型偏离一致性条件达17.5德比安。预训练表示减少了所需标注数据量，校准修正了概率尺度，但二者均无法纠正有偏教师，因此必须将概率与实际结果进行对比验证。

summary: Phone scams impose substantial and growing costs on individuals and financial systems worldwide, yet existing countermeasures impose no resource cost on perpetrators. Strategic scam-baiting, in which automated agents engage scammers to deplete their operational capacity, offers a proactive alternative but requires dynamic strategy adaptation that static systems cannot provide. We introduce a game-theoretic framework enabling LLMs to learn effective counter-strategies through in-context experience without fine-tuning. The framework models scammer-baiter interactions as a two-player game with empirically grounded strategies and utility functions, using Nash equilibrium as a formal benchmark for evaluating learned behaviour. Across 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, adaptive strategy selection achieves 28.9-79.7% closer alignment to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines. The code and an annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores are released at https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/ .
title: Game of Phones: Harnessing Game Theory and LLMs in 'Bot Wars' to Counteract Phone Scams
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Joint European Conference on Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD 2026)
title_translated: 电话博弈：利用博弈论与大语言模型在‘机器人战争’中对抗电话诈骗
summary_translated: 电话诈骗在全球范围内对个人和金融系统造成巨大且持续增长的损失，但现有反制措施并未对实施者施加资源成本。战略式反诈（scam-baiting）通过自动化代理与诈骗者互动以耗尽其运营能力，提供了一种主动替代方案，但需要动态策略适应，静态系统无法满足。我们提出一种博弈论框架，使大语言模型能够在不微调的情况下通过上下文经验学习有效的反制策略。该框架将诈骗者与反诈者之间的互动建模为具有实证基础策略和效用函数的双人博弈，以纳什均衡作为评估学习行为的正式基准。在300次模拟对话和三种大语言模型架构中，自适应策略选择相比非自适应基线，与纳什均衡的对齐度提高了28.9%-79.7%。代码及包含300次对话的标注数据集（含逐轮策略标签和效用分数）已发布于 https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/。

summary: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
title_translated: HarnessPro：基于帕累托优化的递归赋能自改进以实现性能-成本权衡
summary_translated: 赋能开发在构建强大AI智能体中起关键作用。近期方法通过递归自改进（RSI）提升赋能，但其性能提升常伴随更高的执行成本。我们提出HarnessPro，一种无需标签的赋能演化方法，可在提升任务性能的同时降低执行成本。在此设定中，候选赋能通过LLM生成的测试进行评估，无需真实解或官方测试。专用代理诊断执行轨迹，根据不同的性能-成本优先级规划更新，并将其作为候选赋能实现。HarnessPro不返回单一赋能，而是使用归一化加权平方距离选择法，提供面向成本优化（轻量）、平衡（中等）和性能优化（重型）的赋能，以适应不同部署预算。选定的赋能进入下一轮迭代，执行反馈引导进一步更新。实验覆盖Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro和ProgramBench，使用GPT-5.5+Codex和GLM-5.2+Claude Code。在GPT-5.5+Codex上，HarnessPro的重型模式相比RHO平均通过率提升2.0个百分点，每任务成本平均降低26.1%。该优势在使用GLM-5.2+Claude Code时同样成立。代码已公开于 https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro。

summary: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.
title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
