title_translated: recAMPLIFY：递归蛋白质语言模型的大规模预训练
summary_translated: 蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）是蛋白质注释和突变效应预测的强大工具，但进展主要依赖于模型规模和数据量的扩大，导致成本高昂且易产生记忆现象。测试时缩放提供了互补路径，但针对自回归大语言模型开发的方法无法直接迁移：掩码编码器缺乏生成循环，且氨基酸不会以推理语言形式表达。因此，我们针对掩码pLMs适配递归预训练，其中权重共享的Transformer核心在可调节的循环次数内对残基对齐的隐藏状态进行精炼。我们将此方法实例化为recAMPLIFY，一个拥有1.55亿唯一参数的pLM，在与AMPLIFY-350M相同的2T token上进行训练。尽管参数量减少56%，它在CASP接触恢复和四个监督任务中的三个上表现更优，尤其将折叠准确率提升了22.5%。由于recAMPLIFY的最佳深度因任务和检测而异，我们随后引入门控混合递归（GMR）框架，该框架从递归过程中访问的隐藏状态的概率加权混合中解码每个蛋白质。GMR在标量、低秩或逐维度分辨率上采用学习到的残差门控，控制每次循环提出的更新有多少被接受到状态中。这将停止和门控统一为单一自适应计算目标，同时将PonderNet风格的停止作为无门控的特例。在recAMPLIFY基础上叠加GMR，可将期望层数深度最多降低37%，尽管准确率权衡因任务而异。机制分析显示，残差门控不仅控制递归稳定性，还超越训练深度；停止深度与生物特性相关。

summary: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.
title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
title_translated: 重复中的复制：从前缀匹配到位置哈希
summary_translated: 前沿大语言模型几乎能无误地复制随机文本，但在处理长串重复字符时常常出现越界或截断。在重复字符串中，仅通过局部内容匹配已无法可靠判断复制应继续还是终止。然而，我们证明了一个两层Transformer模型，其精度为$O(\log\log N)$比特、宽度为$O(\log N / \log\log N)$，可以在任意重复模式下正确复制长度达到设计范围$N$的任意字符串并正确终止。我们采用类似RoPE的注意力值和输出旋转（VO-旋转），使用小素数周期编码与分隔符锚点的距离模这些素数。根据中国剩余定理，这些周期性编码联合区分所有所需距离，使得单一检索规则可选择下一个源标记或结束标记。相比之下，我们证明了在顺序有限精度softmax累积下，复制任务存在与宽度无关的不可能性结果。该结果适用于仅以加性注意力偏置作为位置输入且最终趋于恒定的Transformer模型，包括NoPE和ALiBi的递归实现。一旦相同标记序列超过由此产生的饱和阈值，后续重复不会改变logits。若该阈值随$N$亚线性增长，这些模型无法同时完成长串全相同复制并正确停止，这一现象与前沿大模型的终止错误相似。在合成复制实验中，基线Transformer模型即使在训练范围内也对长重复字符串失效。而训练后的VO模型则能在接近5005的长度上以近乎完美的准确率泛化，该长度为所选素数周期的乘积。

summary: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.
title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding
title_translated: 通过变分解码实现并行语言模型
summary_translated: 自回归语言模型每次前向传播仅生成一个标记，导致推理延迟较高，尤其在模型规模扩大以提升质量时更为明显。本文提出并行语言模型（PLMs），通过将依赖关系路由至潜在辅助变量，在一次前向传播中生成相互一致的多个标记。PLMs使用变分界进行训练，该界简化为自回归损失加上并行解码损失。实证表明，PLMs在速度与性能的权衡曲线上优于自回归模型和离散扩散基线。预训练的PLMs在80M至3B参数规模下达到接近自回归的预训练损失，且加速效果随模型规模呈幂律增长。微调后，我们的1.3B模型在数学、编程和指令遵循基准测试中表现与同等训练的自回归模型相当或更优，推理速度提升2.3至5.7倍。综上，我们展示了并行生成可通过单一训练目标实现自回归级别的性能。代码将公开于https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm。

summary: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.
title: Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing
title_translated: 评分标准内部奖励分歧：通过潜在维度恢复与平衡缓解评分作弊
summary_translated: 评分标准作弊限制了基于评分标准的强化学习在性能和训练鲁棒性方面的表现。通过对评分标准进行子维度分解，我们揭示了‘评分标准内部奖励分歧’现象：随着总评分上升，某些子维度评分系统性下降，表明模型为优化整体目标而牺牲特定质量方面。从子维度视角观察到两种现象：（1）维度不平衡，导致策略偏向被充分覆盖的维度；（2）维度缺失，造成奖励与真实质量之间的系统性差距。为缓解这些问题，我们提出公平竞争维度聚合（FRDA），使生成在每个维度内独立竞争以缓解评分不平衡；以及残差语义维度补全（RSDC），挖掘整体偏好信号中隐含的评估维度以补全评分覆盖。在聊天、科学和医疗领域的实验表明，FRDA有效缓解评分作弊并带来更稳定的改进；而RSDC在单奖励训练和朴素多奖励聚合之外表现更优，生成整体质量更高的响应。

summary: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.
title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
comment: Preliminary version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI)
title_translated: 何种模型承担何种角色？面向LLM智能体工作流的成本高效帕累托推荐
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体工作流越来越多地为不同角色分配不同模型。用户可能在任务质量与部署成本之间寻求不同权衡，有时也考虑延迟。寻找优质模型分配需额外搜索成本，因需评估多个候选方案。我们引入成本耦合吉廷斯（CC-Gittins），一种多目标扩展的单目标成本感知吉廷斯搜索方法，用于帕累托推荐。它利用评估成本与部署成本之间的耦合关系：部署成本越高的分配，评估成本也越高。搜索过程在追求更高质量和更低部署成本之间交替进行，并复用每次评估结果同时指导两类搜索。每批评估后，CC-Gittins基于质量与部署成本的不确定性调整估计，推荐非支配的分配方案。我们在包含2至5个角色、最多1681个候选分配的八组质量-成本矩阵上评估了该方法，并进一步将延迟作为第三目标进行评估。在八个基准测试中，CC-Gittins仅以约10%的穷举评估成本就恢复了大部分真实帕累托前沿，到30%评估成本时基本恢复全部前沿且仅有少量误报。

summary: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.
title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
title_translated: SpatialScout：视觉语言模型智能体能否主动探索并映射三维场景？
summary_translated: 空间智能要求智能体主动获取视觉证据，并将观测结果整合为对三维世界的连贯表征。然而，空间问答任务提供的证据有限，难以判断模型是否能通过自主探索构建精确的度量地图。我们提出SpatialScout，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体在主动对象级三维建图能力上的基准测试。SpatialScout包含80个多样化的室内场景，共3,140个目标物体。给定物体清单、RGB观测、相机标定和相机位姿，智能体控制摄像头探索每个场景，并在共享坐标系中估计物体中心。该任务要求协调视角选择、跨视图关联、几何估计和在有限交互预算下的地图修订。评估联合衡量定位准确性和目标覆盖率，通过物体尺度重叠得分惩罚遗漏预测。对前沿VLM的实验揭示显著局限性：最强评估模型Claude Opus 5.5的平均重叠得分为41.71%，其中47.23%的目标IoU超过0.5，但仅有3.25%超过0.9。这些结果表明，从恢复粗略物体布局到构建完整、精确的度量地图之间仍存在巨大差距。SpatialScout为开发通过主动感知构建可靠三维空间表征的智能体提供了定量测试平台。代码见https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout。

summary: An LLM-generated repair action specifies which records to change and by how much. A failed action may still contain a useful target set or numerical update, depending on how the two are paired. We evaluate this problem in traffic networks and databases, where aggregate observations obscure the records that need correction. We examine the pairings by executing each combination from the same initial state, using a reference action that restores the affected records. In 76 of 114 traffic actions, the gain from correcting both parts exceeds the sum of the gains from correcting each part alone. Six of these actions become worse after either correction alone, but improve when both parts are corrected. In database repair, replacing only the proposed update with the reference update worsens 17 of 108 model actions, all of which select unaffected records. We also test whether parts of two proposals can be reused. On held-out observations, selecting among the proposals and their recombined target-update pairs recovers 61.6% of the reference action's loss reduction, compared with 58.0% from selecting between the proposals alone.
title: From Outcomes to Components: A Counterfactual Evaluation Framework for LLM-Proposed Repairs
title_translated: 从结果到组件：一种针对LLM提议修复的反事实评估框架
summary_translated: 由大语言模型生成的修复操作指定了需要更改的记录及其修改量。即使修复失败，其包含的有用目标集或数值更新也可能具有价值，具体取决于目标与更新的配对方式。我们在交通网络和数据库中评估了这一问题，其中聚合观测值掩盖了需要修正的记录。通过从相同初始状态执行每种组合，并使用参考操作恢复受影响的记录，我们发现，在114个交通操作中的76个，同时修正两部分所带来的收益超过了单独修正每一部分收益之和。其中有6个操作在仅修正一部分后表现更差，但当两部分都修正时则得到改善。在数据库修复中，仅用参考更新替换提议更新会使108个模型操作中的17个恶化，且这些操作均选择了未受影响的记录。我们还测试了两个提议的部分是否可以复用。在保留的观测中，通过在提议及其重新组合的目标-更新对之间进行选择，可恢复参考操作损失减少量的61.6%，而仅在提议之间选择只能恢复58.0%。

summary: Agent harnesses decide what a language model sees across turns: they drop old turns, summarize them, or replay the model's own earlier reasoning. We ask when these choices change whether an agent succeeds, not only what it costs, and report three findings. First, in a pre-registered synthetic probe, truncating the context window costs a low-cost reasoning model nothing in success when a needed fact can be looked up again (it looks the fact up instead), but drops its success to chance when the fact cannot be re-observed: the two penalties differ by 92.5 percentage points (90% CI [89.5, 95.5]). A pre-registered replication on one model from a second provider showed the same contrast. Once the fact was lost, that model chose no answer rather than guessing. Second, on ARC-AGI-3, where the benchmark's Standard harness trails its Provider Adapter harness by a wide margin, we decompose that gap one component at a time, for one model on four games. Summarizing old turns instead of dropping them, while keeping the Standard harness's invitation to take notes, recovers 86% of a 63-point gap without replaying the model's reasoning. The same harness without the invitation recovers 43%, and adding the provider's native replay of the model's reasoning recovers the remaining 57%. These are point estimates from one counted run per configuration and game, and the replay share depends on a single run. Third, in the benchmark's published runs and in ours, the Adapter's advantage in the probability of clearing a level it has reached is larger at deep levels than at early ones. This largely restates where runs stopped and does not separate a growing advantage from a constant one.
title: When the harness decides success: state that cannot be re-observed
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Pre-registered; code, pre-registration and cost ledger at this https URL
title_translated: 当约束决定成功时：无法重新观测的状态
summary_translated: 智能体约束决定了语言模型在多轮交互中所见的内容：它们会丢弃旧轮次、对其进行摘要，或重播模型自身的早期推理过程。我们关注这些选择何时影响智能体的成功，而不仅仅是成本，并报告三个发现。首先，在一项预注册的合成探测中，当所需事实可再次查找时，截断上下文窗口对低成本推理模型的成功无影响（它会重新查找该事实），但当事实无法重新观测时，成功率降至随机水平：两种惩罚差异达92.5个百分点（90%置信区间[89.5, 95.5]）。在第二家供应商的一个模型上的预注册复制实验也显示出相同对比。一旦事实丢失，该模型选择不作回答而非猜测。其次，在ARC-AGI-3基准中，标准约束相比提供方适配器约束存在显著差距，我们对单一模型在四个游戏上逐项分解该差距。将旧轮次摘要替代丢弃，同时保留标准约束的记笔记邀请，恢复了63分差距中的86%，无需重播模型推理；若无记笔记邀请，则仅恢复43%；加入提供方原生的模型推理重播，可恢复剩余57%。这些是每个配置和游戏一次计数运行的点估计，且重播比例依赖于单次运行。第三，在基准公开运行及我们的运行中，适配器在已达到关卡的通关概率优势随深度层级增加而扩大，这主要反映了运行停止的位置，并未区分增长优势与恒定优势。

summary: Attack success rate (ASR) evaluates jailbreaks against large language models without accounting for repeated calls to the victim model. Yet each additional call gives the deployed system another opportunity to detect the attack and intervene. We introduce $\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}}$, which penalizes additional victim-model calls while retaining binary success judgments. Our evaluation considers GCG~\cite{zou2023universal}, PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking} with a step budget, and a single-step PAP~\cite{zeng2024johnny} baseline on JailBreakBench across three model families. GCG's scores decrease by 7.0--8.7 percentage points after discounting, while PAP's remain unchanged. While for PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}, we see a wider discounting range between 3.4-12 percentage points, showing that the "step" quantity differs per iterative strategy. Reporting both metrics makes the discount due to repeated victim-model interaction explicit. Code is available \hyperlink{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/beyond_asr}{here}.
title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Cost-Aware Metric for Evaluating Iterative LLM Jailbreaks
title_translated: 超越攻击成功率：一种考虑代价的迭代LLM越狱评估指标
summary_translated: 攻击成功率（ASR）评估针对大语言模型的越狱攻击时，未考虑对目标模型的重复调用。然而，每次额外调用都会给部署系统提供一次检测并干预攻击的机会。我们引入$$\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{STEP}}$$，在保留二元成功判断的同时，对额外的目标模型调用施加惩罚。我们的评估涵盖GCG~\cite{zou2023universal}、带有步骤预算的PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}以及单步PAP~\cite{zeng2024johnny}基线，在JailBreakBench上针对三个模型家族进行。GCG的得分在扣除后下降了7.0至8.7个百分点，而PAP的得分保持不变。对于PAIR~\cite{chao2025jailbreaking}，我们观察到更宽的扣减范围（3.4–12个百分点），表明不同迭代策略的“步数”量级存在差异。同时报告两项指标使重复目标模型交互带来的折扣效应更加明确。代码已公开\hyperlink{https://github.com/SuELS-Group/beyond_asr}{此处}。

summary: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.
title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 多教师在线策略蒸馏的Fisher-几何视角
summary_translated: 将专业基础模型整合为统一通用模型是后训练阶段的核心目标。目前常用两种方法：模型合并，速度快但被视为启发式方法；多教师在线策略蒸馏，能匹配分布但需要大量滚动计算资源，并面临跨任务梯度冲突问题。我们证明这两种方法本质上是同一目标在不同阶次下的体现。在同源专业模型共享的基底中，多教师在线策略蒸馏目标在二阶意义上恰好等于Fisher合并目标。因此其最小化解即为Fisher合并——一种经典的模型合并方法，由专业模型的闭式组合给出，故合并作为蒸馏的闭式阶段在二阶意义下是最优的。基于此识别，我们提出残差驱动的分支-合并（RGBM）两阶段整合流程。具体而言，由于全参数Fisher合并对基础模型不可行，第一阶段将合并限制在任务向量子空间。扩展合并的切空间分析，我们发现混合任务向量的系数同样适用于混合隐含奖励，从而允许一个残差程序在无标签提示上求解这些系数。该程序最小化各领域最坏残差，并将能量归一化的值作为领域残差谱。第二阶段利用该谱来决定可添加内容：RGBM对低归一化残差领域进行抑制，仅对高于谱隙的领域训练孤立分支，并以校准收缩的方式写回被接纳的更新。在两个开源整合套件上，仅第一阶段合并就达到或超过完全训练的多教师蒸馏性能，而RGBM进一步提升性能且无需额外联合训练步骤，而所有未受控的写回（包括从合并继续联合蒸馏）均低于此性能。

summary: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.
title: RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing
title_translated: RouterWorld：基于延迟感知的LLM路由实现对话式AI规模化
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLMs）构建的对话式AI系统需要路由机制，在大规模场景下平衡答案质量和响应延迟。然而，现有LLM路由基准假设可完全观测所有候选模型输出，低估延迟作为首要指标的重要性，并在异构协议间碎片化评估，与真实世界设置不符。我们提出RouterWorld，一个面向对话式生成式AI中LLM路由的综合性基准。RouterWorld统一了37.1万条单轮响应和7.6万条多轮代理轨迹，采用标准化的LLM作为裁判协议的自然用户交互，并通过硬件基础的延迟标注将效率与瞬时定价解耦。关键的是，RouterWorld通过两种设置形式化了部分可观测性下的路由：Cold-Start设置限制学习仅基于稀疏静态日志；Voyager设置模拟连续数据流，其中路由决策塑造未来的训练分布。评估13种路由基线后，我们发现大多数路由器在部分可观测性下过度强调准确性而忽视延迟。代码和基准数据均已公开。

summary: Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion. Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.
title: Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes
title_translated: 稀疏自编码器代码中的强度控制如何影响干预效果的比较
summary_translated: 改变稀疏自编码器（SAE）代码会同时影响干预的方向和幅度，因此比较干预效果需要一个强度控制来指定哪些因素保持不变。范数匹配和输出校准提供了不同的控制方式，但经过强度匹配后，不同代码下干预是否产生不同效果仍不明确。我们在Gemma和Llama中对固定特征组进行了比较，观察到：(1) 整体补丁缩放。每个输入一个系数时，全输出Kullback-Leibler（KL）校准在非负最小二乘（NNLS）重拟合中比总范数匹配留下更小的平均效应差距。在新的Llama输入上，总范数匹配损失了11个参考转移，而全输出校准则保留了所有转移决策。(2) 位置缩放。在一个小的匹配性别一致子集上，位置范数匹配比全输出校准留下更小的观测平均差距。(3) 答案排除。与未缩放的NNLS相比，答案排除校准减少了测量的主谓一致比较中的差距，但增加了性别重拟合中的差距。全输出KL校准也减少了范数匹配构造候选者的较大差距，尽管在多个设置中匹配覆盖不完整。由于校准使用评估输入的输出，它可作为残余不一致性的诊断工具。

summary: Ground truth in Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is often presented as a single categorical fact, yet an acted emotion and the emotion heard by listeners describe different aspects of the same recording. We examine this distinction in Emozionalmente, an acted Italian corpus that provides both an elicited production label and five listener judgements for every clip. Using frozen XLS-R, HuBERT, and WavLM representations with matched probes, we compare three label authorities: the expressed condition, the listeners' hard plurality, and their complete vote distribution. The results tell a consistent story. Recovering the expressed condition is easier than predicting a tie-broken listener plurality, but that gap compares two different questions rather than revealing a general loss of SER ability. As listener agreement weakens, the plurality becomes an increasingly brittle hard target. Training on the full vote distribution does not substantially change which class wins the model's hard decision, but it produces probability assignments that more closely follow the alternatives selected by listeners, especially for ambiguous clips. No authority therefore replaces the others. Expressed labels describe how speech was produced, pluralities provide an operational single-class decision, and vote distributions preserve perceptual uncertainty. For human-facing Internet of Sounds applications, evaluations should state which authority is being predicted, retain its aggregation rule and agreement information, and use distributional scores when disagreement is part of the target.
title: Label Authority in Speech Emotion Recognition: Intended and Perceived Ground Truth in Emozionalmente
title_translated: 语音情感识别中的标签权威性：Emozionalmente中的意图与感知真实值
summary_translated: 语音情感识别（SER）中的真实值通常被呈现为单一类别事实，然而表演的情感与听者感知到的情感描述的是同一录音的不同方面。我们在Emozionalmente这一意大利语表演语料库中研究了这一区别，该语料库为每段音频提供了诱发的生成标签和五个听者判断。使用冻结的XLS-R、HuBERT和WavLM表示及匹配探测器，我们比较了三种标签权威性：表达状态、听者硬多数和其完整的投票分布。结果呈现出一致的图景：恢复表达状态比预测由少数决定的听者多数更容易，但这种差距反映的是两个不同问题而非SER能力的一般性下降。随着听者一致性减弱，多数成为越来越脆弱的硬目标。在完整投票分布上训练并未显著改变模型硬决策所选择的类别，但使概率分配更贴近听者选择的替代选项，尤其是在模糊片段上。因此，没有一种权威能取代其他。表达标签描述了语音的生成方式，多数提供了一个操作性的单类决策，而投票分布保留了感知不确定性。对于面向人类的互联网声音应用，评估应说明预测的是哪种权威，保留其聚合规则和一致性信息，并在目标包含分歧时使用分布评分。

summary: Much of the manipulation in online influencer content is not false but disproportionate: an accurate fact is framed as historic, urgent, or catastrophic. Fact-checking and clickbait detection are not designed to capture such framing, and little is known about where it originates: with the creator, the topic, the platform, or the audience that replies. We operationalize rhetorical distortion through five literature-grounded dimensions (Significance Inflation, Anxiety Manufacturing, Novelty Claims, Loaded Language, and Temporal Distortion) and measure it with a three-tier pipeline in which bilingual lexical rules propose candidates, negative filters cancel known false-positive contexts, and an LLM verifies or relabels the candidates. Applying the pipeline to 13,060 posts from 330 accounts on six platforms (RSS/newsletters, YouTube, Bluesky, Reddit, Weibo, and X/Twitter), we find that platform is far more strongly associated with account-level distortion than content category (Kruskal-Wallis $\varepsilon^2=0.33$; two-way ANOVA $η_p^2=0.49$ for platform vs. $0.09$ for category). X/Twitter scores highest (DI 7.74 vs. 0.78 for RSS). Classifying tweets and their replies separately shows where this comes from: the reply layer readers see under a post (its top-5 replies) carries 3.5x the distortion of the tweet it answers (7.65 vs. 2.17, $p<10^{-6}$, 36 of 43 accounts), driven by Loaded Language. At equal text length the gap shrinks to 1.5x but remains significant, and creator tweets alone are statistically indistinguishable from YouTube and Bluesky. Two independent human annotators confirm the reply gap, and the platform ordering and the reply gap replicate with GPT-4o as a second classifier. On threaded platforms, measured distortion thus lives largely in the audience layer, which motivates measurement that separates creator and reply text.
title: Where Does Rhetorical Distortion Live? A Multi-Platform, Multi-Language Measurement of Influencer Content
title_translated: 修辞扭曲存在于何处？多平台、多语言的影响力内容测量
summary_translated: 在线影响力内容中的许多操纵并非虚假，而是夸大：一个准确的事实被表述为历史性的、紧迫的或灾难性的。事实核查和点击诱饵检测并未设计用于捕捉此类框架，且目前尚不清楚这种框架源自创作者、主题、平台还是回复观众。我们通过五个基于文献的维度（重要性夸大、焦虑制造、新颖性主张、煽动性语言、时间扭曲）来操作化修辞扭曲，并采用三阶段管道进行测量：双语词汇规则提出候选，负向过滤器排除已知的假阳性上下文，大语言模型验证或重新标注候选。将该管道应用于来自六个平台（RSS/新闻简报、YouTube、Bluesky、Reddit、Weibo和X/Twitter）的330个账号共13,060条帖子，发现平台与账户级扭曲的相关性远强于内容类别（Kruskal-Wallis ε²=0.33；双因素方差分析 η_p²=0.49 对比类别仅0.09）。X/Twitter得分最高（DI 7.74 vs. RSS的0.78）。分别分类推文及其回复显示，原因在于：读者在推文下方看到的回复层（前5条回复）的扭曲程度是其所回应推文的3.5倍（7.65 vs. 2.17，p<10⁻⁶，43个账户中有36个），主要由煽动性语言驱动。在相同文本长度下，差距缩小至1.5倍但仍显著，且创作者推文本身与YouTube和Bluesky无统计差异。两名独立人工标注者确认了回复差距，且使用GPT-4o作为第二分类器时，平台排序和回复差距均得以复现。因此，在线线程平台上测得的扭曲主要存在于观众层，这促使我们采取分离创作者与回复文本的测量方法。

summary: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) localizes the image region described by a natural language expression, underpinning applications such as autonomous navigation, human-robot interaction, and medical image analysis. Under weak supervision, REC is challenged by the visual-linguistic semantic gap and the difficulty of inferring region-text correspondences from coarse image-level signals alone. Moreover, no single visual encoder captures all complementary properties---semantic alignment, fine-grained texture, and boundary awareness---while naively fusing multiple pretrained encoders yields heterogeneous, hard-to-reconcile representations. We propose LaMER, a weakly supervised REC framework that dynamically aggregates four frozen expert encoders through a language-conditioned Cross-Modal Routing Fusion module, adapting expert selection to each referring expression without instance-level bounding-box supervision. A Cell-Text Matching Head with Negative Anchor Augmentation, trained with a multi-objective loss combining contrastive, reconstruction, alignment, and load-balancing terms, further stabilizes optimization. LaMER achieves 77.67\%, 62.81\%, and 69.49\% Acc@IoU\(\geq 0.5\) on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg, surpassing DViN and WeakMCN by up to 16.49 and 14.49 points, with ablations validating each component.
title: LaMER: Language-Conditioned Multi-Expert Routing for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
title_translated: LaMER：面向弱监督指代表达理解的语言条件多专家路由
summary_translated: 指代表达理解（REC）旨在定位自然语言表达所描述的图像区域，支撑自动驾驶导航、人机交互和医学图像分析等应用。在弱监督条件下，REC面临视觉-语言语义鸿沟以及仅从粗粒度图像级信号推断区域-文本对应关系的困难。此外，单一视觉编码器无法捕捉所有互补属性——语义对齐、细粒度纹理和边界感知——而简单融合多个预训练编码器会产生异质且难以调和的表示。我们提出LaMER，一种弱监督REC框架，通过语言条件化的跨模态路由融合模块动态聚合四个冻结的专家编码器，根据每个指代表达自适应选择专家，无需实例级边界框监督。一个带有负锚点增强的单元-文本匹配头，结合对比、重建、对齐和负载均衡项的多目标损失进行训练，进一步稳定优化过程。LaMER在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg上的Acc@IoU≥0.5分别达到77.67%、62.81%和69.49%，超越DViN和WeakMCN达16.49和14.49个百分点，消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。

summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.
title: An Empirical Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
title_translated: 面向混合专家大模型的参数高效微调的实证研究
summary_translated: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法在资源受限环境下对大型模型的适配至关重要。然而，随着混合专家（MoE）架构因其在大规模参数量下实现高效推理而日益普及，一个关键空白随之出现：缺乏系统性的PEFT应用于MoE模型的实践指南。为弥合这一差距，我们开展了一项大规模系统性研究，探讨一系列核心设计策略，包括应调整哪些模块、以何种粒度调整MoE模块、使用何种PEFT方法，以及负载均衡目标应使用到何种程度，涵盖三个MoE骨干模型在下游任务和通用知识任务上的表现。实验得出若干关键见解：第一，仅调整MoE专家即可在相近参数预算下实现最高的下游性能并保持有竞争力的通用能力。第二，原生专家权重更新相比绕过专家或整个MoE模块的适配器，提供了更好的下游性能与保留能力之间的权衡。第三，LoRA与DoRA共同定义了所评估PEFT方法中高下游准确率的最佳操作区间。第四，任何非零负载均衡系数均未在帕累托意义上优于零基线。最后，我们对MoE²-LoRA进行了权重级重构，在Qwen3上评估，将其模块级绕过池移入原生专家权重，使所有四个上游指标提升2.4至17.9分，可训练参数减少17%，下游成本平均降低3.2分。

summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.
title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
title_translated: VibeTraining-Bench：用于迭代系统优化的数据-训练器-推理框架协同设计
summary_translated: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体能够诊断系统瓶颈，并在训练与推理之间协调改进。我们称智能体联合优化训练数据、训练器和推理框架的能力为跨组件协同设计。我们提出了VibeTraining-Bench，一个用于评估该能力的基准，涵盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具使用和数学推理等任务。在每个任务中，研究智能体从相同的初始智能体系统出发，在固定资源预算下进行迭代优化：通过验证反馈不断改进数据、训练器和推理框架，最终选择并提交一个智能体系统以在测试集上进行评估。为防止奖励滥用，我们设置了三项保障措施：测试数据隔离、研究与评分容器分离以及对研究智能体的网络限制。评估结果表明，前沿研究智能体显著提升了目标智能体系统的性能。例如，在SWE-bench Verified上，GPT-6-Astra将目标智能体系统的表现从32.9%提升至53.7%，接近人类开发的指令模型的55.4%。然而，其在协同设计并迭代优化数据、训练器和推理框架以实现累积性能提升方面仍有改进空间。我们希望VibeTraining-Bench能成为推动RSI发展的统一平台，深化对智能体系统跨组件优化的理解。代码与数据可在https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench获取。

summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.
title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Code, protocol and per-example outputs: this https URL
title_translated: 在流行度偏移下的类型化决策模型：决策训练、校准与隐式先验
summary_translated: 类型化决策模型（TDMs）返回用户定义选项的概率分布，Jev被其供应商描述为已校准。但在部署时类别频率发生变化，因此在固定测试集上测量的校准性在应用阈值时未必成立。现有评估存在两个空白：厂商决策训练的收益尚未与相同读出头下的基础模型收益分开；TDMs仅在测试集的类别分布下进行测试。我们探讨决策训练是否使模型优于其自身基础模型，以及TDM的校准性和阈值在流行度（标签）偏移下是否比微调分类器更具鲁棒性。我们在五个公开数据集上，对三种TDMs（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）、其基础模型及两种微调分类器进行了模拟偏移下的35组配对测试。首先，决策训练并非普遍有益：Nimble-9B（仅与Qwen3.5-9B相差一个LoRA适配器）在意图任务上更校准，但在金融情感任务上Macro-F1低12.0个百分点。其次，在中等偏移下，Jev的期望校准误差（ECE）和阈值风险在金融情感任务上显著高于微调的DeBERTa，分别增加1.7和2.5个百分点；在2,000种偏移情景下的平均差距不超过每项数据集1个百分点。第三，使用模型在开发阶段的平均预测作为先验的EM先验修正无需标签，可使Jev在两类数据集上的ECE分别降低2.7和1.8个百分点，尽管标注重校准效果更显著。我们测试的三种TDMs既非始终优于其基础模型，也非在偏移下唯一脆弱；对于校准而言，其主要弱点是偏移前已存在的校准偏差。所有输入、代码和输出均已发布。

summary: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.
title: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
title_translated: 调度器是隐藏的检索器：异步如何塑造搜索智能体的证据获取
summary_translated: 语言模型智能体越来越多地通过并行推理和异步信息收集解决复杂任务。在两个模型家族和三个基准上的受控回放显示，交付时间会改变在所有结果到达前做出的搜索决策，即使初始证据完全相同。证据获取分歧最高可达同序重复变异的24个百分点。这种依赖关系在初始证据全部到达后仍持续存在，并贯穿第二次搜索，将智能体短暂看到的内容差异转化为持久的获取差异。我们提出一个获取后悔界及其匹配构造，表明在固定早期到达数量下的不变性会限制对已接收证据的利用。我们引入共融证据获取（CEA），即当每个子问题的证据完整时释放本地推理，并独立分配共享搜索，不依赖完成顺序。在固定计划和稳定条件响应律下，我们证明了决策、获取和答案的联合不变性。在三个基准上使用仅问题计划，CEA使获取分歧降至与重复变异相差1.0个百分点以内，且准确率接近完整输入控制，相比早期承诺最多提升12.6个百分点。若将CEA的固定分配替换为竞争情况下的首个就绪分配，则获取分歧增加21.6个百分点，而本地查询目标分歧仍接近重复变异水平。定时比较显示，CEA比等待所有初始证据的同一程序更早做出决策并更快响应。

summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) reason over speech, environmental sounds, music, and other acoustic information. However, their audio encoders produce dense token sequences that make long-form audio costly to process. Existing audio pruning methods reduce this cost using heuristics such as attention, representation similarity, or temporal sampling, but do not explicitly learn which tokens are most useful for a given question. We propose AudioScorer, a lightweight model that scores audio tokens according to the user question. It is trained by distilling the ranking of audio tokens under the frozen LALM's answer-gradient saliency, together with downstream answer supervision. Compared with other pruning methods, AudioScorer achieves the best or tied-best result at 10% token retention on 7 of 10 semantic and acoustic tasks, including speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio-scene classification.
title: AudioScorer: Learning Question-Aware Token Relevance for Large Audio Language Models
title_translated: AudioScorer：为大型音频语言模型学习问题感知的标记相关性
summary_translated: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）能够对语音、环境声音、音乐及其他声学信息进行推理。然而，其音频编码器生成密集的标记序列，导致长音频处理成本高昂。现有的音频剪枝方法通过注意力、表示相似性或时间采样等启发式方法降低开销，但并未显式学习哪些标记对特定问题最有用。我们提出AudioScorer，一个轻量级模型，根据用户问题对音频标记进行评分。它通过蒸馏冻结的LALM在答案梯度显著性下的标记排序，并结合下游答案监督进行训练。相较于其他剪枝方法，AudioScorer在10个语义和声学任务中的7个任务上，于10%标记保留率下达到最佳或并列最佳表现，包括语音识别、情绪识别和音频场景分类。

summary: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.
title: Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law
title_translated: Machina Pauliana：荷兰破产法中保罗尼亚行为的神经符号方法
summary_translated: 频繁适用法律条文通常需要结构化规则推理与对判例法中发展出的开放性术语的敏感性。荷兰破产法（Faillissementswet, Fw）第42条规定的保罗尼亚行为（actio pauliana）允许破产管理人撤销损害债权人利益的交易，这二者均需满足。我们提出一种第42条Fw的神经符号模型。其符号核心以Catala编写，采用文献式风格，保持法律条文与形式化的一致性，并通过结对编程开发，开放性术语以布尔输入表示，神经组件与符号求解器耦合。一个神经流程将案件的自然语言事实结构化为布尔和日期输入。神经子程序通过基于案例的推理，从荷兰民事判决中检索相关信息，检索管道根据待解决的要求进行过滤，并沿案件的程序链扩展。对这些判决进行分段和标注，在100个手动标注的黄金标准判断上达到高精度和高召回率。在十个手工标注的案例中，该神经符号模型合理处理了大多数标准，但在知识要求方面表现不佳。检索深度未显示出明确的定量影响，尽管检索到的判决提供了对先前判例法的明确依据。

summary: Decision models, such as the commercial Jev, are language models that return one probability for each option of a question instead of generating text. We present Decision4Rec, an open and modular framework that makes decision models useful for recommendation. A knowledge graph writes the logs of each recommendation scenario as short statements on a defined scale, such as "sold: top 10%". A pool of agents, proposes candidates, and a residual ranker keeps the best 30. A decision model, trained once on real choices of three scenarios, reads them through one interface of typed questions, and a fusion step combines its answers with the score of the ranker. Any model with this interface can be used, and we run the commercial Jev, the released open Kev and Kev models trained by us on recommendation requests. The framework with a trained 4B decision model is 25 to 36% above the best trained baseline in NDCG@10 in three sparse Amazon catalogues, one of them never used to train the decision model, and almost tie with baselines on the dense Steam dataset. Most of the gain comes from the pool, and with a trained recommender it comes from what the agents know about its candidates rather than from new candidates. The 27B decision model adds to the pool 5 to 6% above the 0.8B model in three of four domains. A trained 0.8B open model beats the released Jev in eleven of fifteen settings and is never worse. On MovieLens-1M, a dense domain never seen in training, the gain is 5 to 7%. Code, configurations and trained models are available at https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec and https://huggingface.co/m-polignano.
title: Decision4Rec: A Jev-Inspired Framework of Decision Models on Knowledge and Active Graphs for Multi-Agent Recommender Systems
title_translated: Decision4Rec：一种基于知识与主动图的决策模型框架，用于多智能体推荐系统
summary_translated: 决策模型（如商业化的Jev）是语言模型的一种，对每个问题选项返回一个概率值而非生成文本。我们提出了Decision4Rec，一个开放且模块化的框架，使决策模型可用于推荐任务。知识图谱将每个推荐场景的日志以定义尺度上的简短陈述形式记录，例如“售出：前10%”。一组智能体提出候选项，残差排序器保留最佳30个。一个经过三次场景真实选择训练的决策模型通过统一的类型化问题接口读取这些信息，融合步骤将其答案与排序器得分结合。任何具备该接口的模型均可使用，我们运行了商业Jev、公开发布的Kev以及由我们针对推荐请求训练的Kev模型。在三个稀疏的亚马逊目录中，使用训练好的4B决策模型的框架在NDCG@10上比最佳基线高出25%至36%，在一个从未用于训练决策模型的目录中表现优异；在密集的Steam数据集上几乎与基线持平。大部分增益来自智能体池，而使用训练好的推荐系统时，增益主要源于智能体对其候选项的知识，而非引入新候选。27B决策模型在四个领域中的三个中比0.8B模型高出5%至6%。训练好的0.8B开源模型在十五个设置中的十一个中优于发布的Jev，且从未更差。在MovieLens-1M（一个训练中未见过的密集领域）中，增益为5%至7%。代码、配置和训练好的模型可在https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec 和 https://huggingface.co/m-polignano 获取。

summary: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. We test replication across two reasoning-native target-serving configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar and Qwen3.8-27B through LM Studio. For each target, we evaluate the same held-out tasks and four conditions - minimal baseline, GEPA prompt, SkillOpt skill, and manually engineered prompt - on HotpotQA (n=500 per condition) and MATH-500 (n=250). In the primary Qwen v2 rerun under the same frozen protocol, GEPA selects the HotpotQA seed and exactly reproduces baseline behavior, whereas SkillOpt's validation gain reverses into held-out degradation. On MATH-500, GEPA raises exact match from 0.828 to 0.904 while reducing latency but increasing token consumption, so lower response time does not imply lower token cost. DeepSeek likewise shows its strongest GEPA effect on MATH-500 (0.852 to 0.908). Across both targets, GEPA's strongest gains occur on MATH-500, while neither optimizer improves the HotpotQA baseline. Optimization is therefore task- and method-dependent, and validation gains may reverse on held-out evaluation. An earlier Qwen run is retained as serving-sensitivity evidence. These results suggest that textual headroom for a model-task pair and the observed effect of a text-space optimizer are more informative when decomposed into content/reasoning, answer-realization/evaluator alignment, and serving-completion/reliability. The cross-benchmark pattern further suggests that optimization may benefit from low-ambiguity, actionable evaluation signals.
title: Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt
title_translated: 理解反思式提示与技能优化在本地部署推理模型中的有效性：GEPA与SkillOpt的双模型研究
summary_translated: 反思式文本空间优化器（如GEPA和SkillOpt）在前沿和中等规模模型上报告了显著提升。我们在两种原生推理目标服务配置下进行了复现测试：通过DwarfStar部署的DeepSeek V4 Flash，以及通过LM Studio部署的Qwen3.8-27B。针对每个目标，我们在HotpotQA（每种条件n=500）和MATH-500（每种条件n=250）上评估相同保留任务及四种条件——最小基线、GEPA提示、SkillOpt技能和手动工程提示。在相同的冻结协议下对Qwen v2进行重新运行时，GEPA选择了HotpotQA种子并完全重现基线行为，而SkillOpt的验证增益反转为保留评估的退化。在MATH-500上，GEPA将精确匹配率从0.828提升至0.904，同时降低延迟但增加token消耗，因此更低响应时间并不意味着更低token成本。DeepSeek同样在MATH-500上表现出最强的GEPA效果（从0.852提升至0.908）。在两个目标中，GEPA的最大增益出现在MATH-500，而两种优化器均未改善HotpotQA基线。因此，优化效果依赖于任务和方法，验证增益可能在保留评估中逆转。早期的Qwen运行结果作为服务敏感性的证据被保留。这些结果表明，将模型-任务对的文本冗余度以及文本空间优化器的实际效果分解为内容/推理、答案实现/评估器对齐、服务完成/可靠性，更具信息量。跨基准模式进一步表明，优化可能受益于低歧义、可操作的评估信号。

summary: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.
title: Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
title_translated: 基于正确性依赖的非对称目标分布用于自蒸馏策略优化
summary_translated: 自蒸馏策略优化通过反馈条件下的自教师提供密集的token级监督，用于大语言模型的后训练阶段。然而，直接匹配自教师可能会破坏正确回放中的成功行为，同时在错误回放中提供的修正不足。我们提出通过自蒸馏实现的非对称策略优化（APSD），通过混合学生和自教师分布构建依赖正确性的目标：插值保留正确回放中的成功行为，而外推超出自教师则加强错误回放中的纠正能力。我们通过分歧分解、反KL巴氏几何和梯度分析对APSD进行分析，强调了通过学生依赖目标的梯度流动的重要性。在具有可验证奖励和丰富反馈的强化学习实验中，APSD在整体性能上优于强化学习和自蒸馏基线，并在Qwen3模型尺度上平均仅需2.6倍的训练步数即可达到与SDPO相当的效果。

summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.
title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
title_translated: GLOBE：基于几何引导的在线行为提前退出机制，通过单位球轨迹实现
summary_translated: 思维链（CoT）推理可以提升问题解决能力，但模型常常在正确答案已可达的情况下仍继续生成；额外步骤会增加服务成本，并可能用错误的中间结果替换正确的中间结果。我们提出GLOBE（Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit），一种无需训练的在线算法，可提前终止模型的CoT过程。GLOBE将每个已完成的推理片段嵌入为单位球上的一个点，并分析由此产生的语义轨迹形状。GLOBE首先执行试运行阶段，在独立分支中生成简短的试答，一旦确认置信度超过阈值即停止主流程。若生成继续，则进入轨迹阶段，当路径反复反转方向且净进展极少时停止流。在包括数学推理、工具调用和智能体记忆在内的五个基准测试中，GLOBE在两个模型上分别减少了49.7%的输出token和51.0%的活跃端到端墙时时间（E2E），五任务平均准确率达到80.58%，与完整CoT表现相当。

summary: We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.
title: Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation
