title_translated: Token集合选择混淆POPE：视觉语言模型幻觉评估中是/否提取的系统审计
summary_translated: 我们试图复现近期在POPE基准上关于幻觉缓解的结果。我们测量的LLaVA-1.5-7B基线在对抗性划分上的F1得分为82.21，比我们计划对比的三个对抗性基线（81.00、79.30和73.54）高出1.21至8.67分。我们检查了评估代码，发现一个读出选择本身就能改变F1得分。采用两token logits读出方式，通过比较两个词表ID（3582表示“yes”，1217表示“no”）决定是/否。在跨越所有三个划分的9,000个贪婪解码问题中，这两个ID一次也未被生成。模型实际输出的是“ Yes”（token 3869）和“ No”（token 1939），因为SentencePiece在提示后缀“ASSISTANT:”之后添加了一个空格字节。使用覆盖空格前缀表面形式的八token查找，LLaVA-1.5-7B在对抗性、流行性和随机划分上的F1分别为0.8221、0.8498和0.8713。这一6.13分的对抗性偏差超过了我们调查的六篇论文中五篇报告的对抗性增益。其中没有一篇说明其读出方式，我们的参考运行在4-bit NF4量化下，因此无法判断任何报告增益在匹配评估条件下能保留多少。该比较在读出方式和精度匹配之前仍无法解决。我们在固定基线上进行了九次推理时修正（均未超越基线），并剖析了为何对抗性划分抵抗logit级干预。在3,000个问题探测中，错误预测比正确预测吸引更多的图像注意力（Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$），这与基于接地的修正假设相反。对来自三个分词器家族的四款其他VLM进行的四读出审计确认，这种混淆是协议层面的，而非模型特有：直接移植LLaVA-1.5的ID会导致两个词汇不重叠模型的F1降至0.00，而基于分词器的读出则保持在0.80至0.92之间。

summary: Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.
title: Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding
title_translated: 保持谱系延续：用于扩散型语言模型解码的多样性保留序贯蒙特卡洛方法
summary_translated: 推理阶段的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码可通过根据奖励对部分生成结果进行重采样，无需训练后调整即可提升掩码扩散语言模型（扩散LLM）的推理准确性。其有效性取决于重采样步骤，该步骤必须集中计算资源于有前景的候选者，同时保留足够的多样性以探索其他推理路径。奖励可以是内部的（解码器对已确定前缀的置信度），也可以是外部的（过程奖励模型对前缀的评分）。在任一奖励设置下，多项式重采样可能破坏这一平衡，通过复制高权重粒子并丢弃仍可能得出正确答案的谱系。有效样本量（ESS）无法反映这种损失：多项式重采样会将ESS重置为最大值，即使不同谱系已消失。为保留这些谱系，我们提出谱系保留SMC（LP-SMC），结合Chopthin重采样与输入权重下限。与均等化权重不同，Chopthin限制返回的最大与最小权重之比，并将不均等权重传递下去。下限限制权重在重采样前可降至多低，使早期权重较低的谱系仍有恢复机会。在两个基础模型的数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，LP-SMC在所有设置下均提升了Oracle覆盖率（至少有一个正确粒子的问题比例），提升幅度为1.8至25.6个百分点；在常见奖励模型选择器下，12个设置中有11个提升了端到端准确率，最高达LLaDA-1.5的7.9点和Dream-7B的18.3点。在外部奖励模型下，覆盖率提升依然存在，表明多样性保留重采样与引导信号在推理时搜索中分别起作用。

summary: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch. We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. With fine-grained ground truth, EvoSkill v2's skills raised the held-out pass rate above the stronger of SkillOpt and SkillBoost by 7.7 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and by 5.4 on $τ^3$-bench banking. In both benchmarks and both feedback settings, EvoSkill v2's evolver cost less per percentage point of held-out pass rate gained than either baseline's optimizer. EvoSkill v2 also enables a less capable model to improve its own skills, demonstrated by a gain of up to 21.5 percentage points in the $τ^3$-bench banking experiment where Claude Haiku 5.5 powers both solver and evolver.
title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
title_translated: EvoSkill v2：从基准适配到状态化演化器的完全自主技能进化
summary_translated: EvoSkill v2是一个三智能体系统，可编辑智能体所接收的指令（技能），而保持其模型和工具不变。用户通过描述一个基准并提供评分器启动运行，基准适配器将其转化为特定基准插件。求解器尝试完成任务，演化器则读取求解器的训练轨迹，并在每个周期重写技能。我们实现演化器为一个具有bash工具的持续状态编码智能体，不同于我们在调研中发现的两种主流设计：如SkillOpt采用一系列单模型调用，或如SkillBoost采用每轮重新开始的智能体。我们还测量求解器在不同尝试间的轨迹变化，为每个训练任务提供多次尝试机会，并接受每个周期的技能而非基于噪声得分进行选择。在细粒度真实数据下，EvoSkill v2的技能使保留集通过率在SpreadsheetBench v2上比SkillOpt和SkillBoost更强者高出7.7个百分点，在$τ^3$-bench银行任务中高出5.4个百分点。在两个基准和两种反馈设置下，EvoSkill v2的演化器每提升一个百分点保留通过率的成本均低于任一基线优化器。此外，EvoSkill v2还使能力较弱的模型能够改进自身技能，例如在Claude Haiku 5.5同时作为求解器和演化器的$τ^3$-bench银行实验中，性能最高提升了21.5个百分点。

summary: Software engineering (SWE) benchmarks are the primary way to measure the capabilities of coding agents: an agent is placed in a code repository or machine environment, given a request, and judged by hidden tests. These benchmarks almost always start the agent from a clean state that contains no earlier work on the task. In practice, however, agents often continue work that a developer or another agent has already done and reported as complete, with no indication of what remains incorrect or missing. We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness: the ability to maintain performance on a task when the starting state already contains earlier work on that task. SWE-Residual contains 198 Residual States drawn from 111 tasks in DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench, where the earlier work modifies a code repository or a whole machine environment. Each Residual State is the state a predecessor agent left behind after submitting its work as complete, although the hidden tests still fail. The evaluated agent receives only the original request and this state, without the predecessor's trajectory or any sign that the attempt failed; because the request and hidden tests are unchanged, the starting state is the only difference from the source benchmark. Across five frontier agents, success drops by 20.6--53.5 percentage points on DeepSWE and 20.6--34.9 points on Terminal-Bench relative to a Clean Start, and agent rankings on DeepSWE reverse. Failed continuations show a pattern we call acceptance bias: agents treat the inherited work as the definition of what remains to be done instead of checking it against the request. On DeepSWE, in 58.9--88.2% of failed runs, they submit with exactly the same tests failing, although they pass most of these tests from a Clean Start. SWE-Residual thus exposes a capability gap that clean-start evaluation does not capture.
title: SWE-Residual: Evaluating Starting-State Robustness of Coding Agents
title_translated: SWE-Residual：评估编码智能体的起始状态鲁棒性
summary_translated: 软件工程（SWE）基准是衡量编码智能体能力的主要方式：将智能体置于代码仓库或机器环境中，给出任务请求，并由隐藏测试评判。这些基准几乎总是从干净状态开始，即任务无先前工作。然而在实践中，智能体经常继续开发人员或其他智能体已完成但未通过隐藏测试的工作，且未标明哪些部分仍错误或缺失。我们引入SWE-Residual，一个用于起始状态鲁棒性的基准：当起始状态已包含该任务的先前工作时，维持任务表现的能力。SWE-Residual包含来自DeepSWE和Terminal-Bench的111个任务中的198个残余状态，其中先前工作修改了代码仓库或整个机器环境。每个残余状态是前一个智能体提交工作后留下的状态，尽管隐藏测试仍未通过。被评估的智能体仅接收原始请求和此状态，不包含前驱轨迹或任何失败迹象；由于请求和隐藏测试不变，唯一区别在于起始状态。在五个前沿智能体上，相对于干净起始状态，DeepSWE上的成功率下降20.6–53.5个百分点，Terminal-Bench上下降20.6–34.9个百分点，且DeepSWE上的智能体排名发生逆转。失败的延续表现出一种称为‘接受偏差’的模式：智能体将继承的工作视为剩余任务的定义，而非与请求进行核对。在DeepSWE中，58.9–88.2%的失败运行中，它们提交时恰好与干净起始状态相比，相同测试仍然失败，尽管在干净起始状态下这些测试大多能通过。因此，SWE-Residual揭示了一个干净起始评估无法捕捉的能力差距。

summary: As jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) become increasingly diverse, red-teaming has come to rely on large libraries of jailbreak prompts and attack strategies to evaluate the robustness of victim models and their defense settings. However, attack effectiveness is highly condition-dependent: an attack that succeeds under one victim-defense setting may fail under another, while exhaustively evaluating the full attack library for each setting incurs substantial token and monetary costs. This motivates studying how jailbreak attacks should be prioritized under a limited attempt budget for efficient robustness evaluation. In this work, we formalize this problem as budgeted attack scheduling over a fixed attack library and investigate three complementary signals under a fixed victim-defense condition: (1) static historical attack success rate (ASR) priors; (2) semantic guidance from LLMs; and (3) online feedback from earlier queries. Building on these signals, we design four scheduling strategies and evaluate them across three victim models and three defense settings on GPT-5.2. Extensive experiments clearly characterize the conditions under which each signal is most effective. Historical ASR provides a strong initialization, but its reliability degrades under defense-induced distribution shifts. Semantic guidance consistently improves or matches static prior-based scheduling in the cold-start regime, while online feedback becomes particularly valuable when transferred priors become stale. Semantic guidance and online feedback can also partially compensate for missing historical priors. Taken together, these findings characterize budgeted red-teaming as an attack scheduling problem in which historical priors, semantic guidance, and online feedback play complementary roles.
title: Budgeted Attack Scheduling for LLM Red-Teaming: The Roles of Static Priors, Semantic Guidance, and Online Feedback
title_translated: 面向LLM红队测试的预算化攻击调度：静态先验、语义引导与在线反馈的作用
summary_translated: 随着针对大型语言模型（LLMs）的越狱攻击日益多样化，红队测试越来越依赖庞大的越狱提示和攻击策略库来评估目标模型及其防御设置的鲁棒性。然而，攻击效果高度依赖于具体条件：一种在某个目标-防御组合下成功的攻击，在另一组合下可能失败；而对每个设置穷尽评估完整攻击库会产生巨大的token和资金成本。这促使研究如何在有限尝试预算下对越狱攻击进行优先级排序，以实现高效的鲁棒性评估。本文将该问题形式化为固定攻击库下的预算化攻击调度，并在固定目标-防御条件下研究三种互补信号：(1) 静态历史攻击成功率（ASR）先验；(2) 来自LLMs的语义引导；(3) 早期查询的在线反馈。基于这些信号，我们设计了四种调度策略，并在GPT-5.2上对三个目标模型和三个防御设置进行了评估。大量实验清晰刻画了每种信号最有效的条件。历史ASR提供了强有力的初始化，但在防御引起的分布偏移下可靠性下降。语义引导在冷启动阶段始终优于或匹配基于静态先验的调度，而在线反馈在迁移先验过期时尤为宝贵。语义引导和在线反馈还能部分弥补缺失的历史先验。综上所述，这些发现将预算化红队测试描述为一个攻击调度问题，其中历史先验、语义引导和在线反馈发挥互补作用。

summary: Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. After a relevant skill has been selected, the model may need to apply its governing procedure together with retrieved task context. When the retrieved context is useful but contains cues that violate the skill, the model must retain compatible information while rejecting the conflicting cues. We study failures in which the model adopts such cues and produces a retrieval-supported but skill-invalid answer, which we call procedural hallucination. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.
title: When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models
title_translated: 当检索部分与技能冲突时：理解语言模型中的程序性幻觉
summary_translated: 语言模型越来越多地使用可复用的技能来提供任务执行的通用指令和流程。在选择相关技能后，模型可能需要将该技能的指导流程与检索到的任务上下文结合使用。当检索到的上下文虽有用但包含违反技能的线索时，模型必须保留兼容信息，同时拒绝冲突线索。我们研究了模型采纳此类线索并产生受检索支持但不符合技能的答案的失败情况，称之为程序性幻觉。我们引入SourceClash，一个包含1,271个数据包和6,355个提示的匹配基准，覆盖十个程序性领域。每个数据包固定任务、技能说明和答案空间，仅改变技能与检索之间的关系。在九个模型中，面对冲突检索时的有效答案率平均仅为25.7%，而两种支持性检索设置下分别为78.2%和72.8%。对开源权重模型的机制分析显示，答案偏好差异通常在生成开始后不久达到最大。残差替换使模型更接近有效答案，而注意力分解表明修复主要归因于值向量。在识别出的值路径上进行干预也提高了最终答案的有效性。这些结果刻画了部分冲突的检索如何改变技能引导的生成过程。

summary: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Existing approaches improve their capabilities through computationally costly post-training or human-in-the-loop feedback that is difficult to scale. To transfer professional fact-checking expertise to LLM agents efficiently, we distill publicly available guidelines published by Agence France-Presse (AFP) Fact Check into a reusable, modular Professional Fact-Checking Skill (PFC-Skill). We then present SkillCheck, the first AFC system that gives LLM agents dynamic access to PFC-Skill to guide evidence retrieval and claim verification at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2--4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5--6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. To conclude, our work shows that LLM agents can "stand on the shoulders of giants" by drawing on the best practices of professional fact-checkers, substantially enhancing AFC performance without extra training or continuous human supervision.
title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills
title_translated: 站在巨人的肩膀上：通过人类专家技能增强LLM智能体的自动化事实核查
summary_translated: 由大型语言模型（LLM）智能体驱动的自动化事实核查（AFC）系统在证据检索和声明验证方面仍面临挑战。现有方法通过计算成本高昂的后训练或人工介入反馈来提升能力，但难以扩展。为高效传递专业事实核查专家知识给LLM智能体，我们从法新社（AFP）事实核查发布的公开指南中提炼出可复用、模块化的专业事实核查技能（PFC-Skill）。随后，我们提出SkillCheck，这是首个让LLM智能体在推理时动态访问PFC-Skill以指导证据检索和声明验证的AFC系统。大量实验表明，SkillCheck在多个LLM骨干模型上均优于无技能基线DEFAME，准确率提升2.2–4.8个百分点，宏平均F1提升1.5–6.3个百分点，在AVerTeC基准测试中表现优异。值得注意的是，使用GPT-4o-Mini的SkillCheck在准确率上超过使用GPT-4o的DEFAME达3.4个百分点，同时推理成本降低约61%。性能提升也延伸至开放网络检索。消融实验显示，将技能融入证据检索阶段带来主要收益，而同时应用于两个阶段则获得最佳整体表现。案例研究显示，PFC-Skill使搜索更精准、对证据的审查更严格。综上所述，我们的工作表明，LLM智能体可通过借鉴专业核查员的最佳实践‘站在巨人的肩膀上’，在无需额外训练或持续人工监督的情况下显著提升AFC性能。

summary: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.
title: Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents
title_translated: 计算，而非记忆：LLM智能体中的思维链与状态追踪
summary_translated: 语言模型智能体通常在行动前进行推理，其推理的价值取决于与行为的相关性。我们探讨当正确操作依赖于变化状态时，智能体的行为如何依赖于其推理过程。在一个小型文件系统任务中，背景事件仅通知哪个文件的锁被切换，但未提供其新值。因此，智能体必须从历史中重建当前锁的状态才能安全移动文件。使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.5-9B，我们分离了推理的两种角色：每次行动前生成推理，以及在提示中保留早期推理。大多数减少锁冲突命令的效果来自行动时刻生成的推理。保留早期推理对规则遵循帮助甚微，尽管它有助于一个模型完成任务。该收益取决于推理内容本身。填充文本、为另一历史编写的推理以及准确的状态表均无法重现该效果。当我们向智能体提供针对不同锁值历史编写的推理时，即使违背自身历史，智能体仍会据此行动。若无推理，线性探测器从模型激活值中恢复状态的能力与文本分类器从对话记录中恢复状态的能力相当。然而，解码准确性并不能预测哪些干预会改变智能体行为。在此设定下，推理对规则遵循的益处主要来自每一步生成推理。无需推理即可解码的状态仅能有限地指导智能体行为。

summary: Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.
title: Whose Credential Is It? How Owner Attribution in Agent MemoryShapes Cross-User Account Misuse
title_translated: 凭证属于谁？代理记忆中的所有者归属如何影响跨用户账户滥用
summary_translated: 共享长期记忆使得服务于某用户的LLM智能体可能无意中检索到其他用户的凭证，但这种暴露何时导致实际危害尚不明确。我们引入三阶段审计，区分三个事件：外来凭证进入提示（暴露）、智能体使用该凭证行动（行为）、另一用户账户发生改变（状态）。在AppWorld（一个混合了所有用户763次历史登录记录的模拟应用商店）中，智能体在84.7%所需应用中检索到其他用户的凭证，但极少实际使用。在压力测试中，当记忆中缺乏用户自身凭证且仅呈现单一外来凭证作为用户记录时，七名智能体中有70%至94%的运行中使用该凭证，并在高达43%的情况下更改受害者账户，有时甚至通过官方验证。在每个凭证行之前或内部标注所有者名称可有效防止大部分滥用：在其他条件不变的情况下，滥用情况从305组配对运行中的92例降至1例；即使使用无名用户名，该措施也有效，但所有者绑定注释会使每个模型在干净记忆下损失3至5个成功任务。错误标注所有者几乎完全恢复滥用行为；尾随所有者标签和附加安全指令仅对部分模型有效。代理记忆应始终一致记录所存储凭证的所有者，评估也应关注行为而非仅暴露。

summary: Many scientific advances come from cross-pollination, carrying an idea from one field over to a problem in another. Yet retrieving papers across fields remains underexplored, with existing benchmarks confined to a narrow range of fields. We study cross-pollination retrieval, the problem of identifying transferable ideas across research fields, and introduce CPR-Dataset, a large-scale dataset constructed by mining cross-topic citations. Its evaluation split CPR-eval has 1,300 queries in 26 fields, and its training split CPR-train has 10,573 pairs. On CPR-eval, the best of eleven existing retrievers reaches a Recall@10 of only 0.26, whereas an LLM reranker reaches 0.81. Standard contrastive fine-tuning on CPR-train raises Recall@10 to as high as 0.70. The gain carries over to domains held out from training and to analogy and reasoning-intensive retrieval. On AnaloBench, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 33% over the untrained retriever, whereas training on three existing retrieval datasets lowers it. On BRIGHT, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 70%, more than twice the gain from those datasets. CPR-Dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset, and the code at https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval.
title: Cross-Pollination Retrieval: Finding Transferable Ideas Across Fields in Scientific Literature
title_translated: 交叉传播检索：在科学文献中发现跨领域的可迁移思想
summary_translated: 许多科学进步源于跨领域思想的传播，即将一个领域的想法迁移到另一个问题中。然而，跨领域论文检索仍研究不足，现有基准局限于狭窄领域范围。我们研究交叉传播检索——识别跨研究领域可迁移思想的问题，并引入CPR-Dataset，一个通过挖掘跨主题引用构建的大规模数据集。其评估集CPR-eval包含26个领域的1,300个查询，训练集CPR-train包含10,573对样本。在CPR-eval上，十一种现有检索器的最佳Recall@10仅为0.26，而LLM重排序器达到0.81。在CPR-train上进行标准对比学习微调后，Recall@10最高可达0.70。该提升在训练未覆盖的领域以及需要类比和推理的检索任务中依然有效。在AnaloBench上，相比未经训练的检索器，nDCG@10提升高达33%；而在三个现有检索数据集上训练反而降低性能。在BRIGHT上，nDCG@10提升高达70%，远超这些数据集带来的增益。CPR-Dataset可在https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset获取，代码见https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval。

summary: LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.
title: Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit
title_translated: 课程学习教会LLM进行长程隐式推理，但存在上限
summary_translated: LLM通过思维链（CoT）将中间步骤显式化为标记来“推理”，但即使是前沿推理模型在长程任务上也会遭遇性能骤降。隐式推理（单次前向传播内的推理）在CoT生成过程中非常有用，因为模型可以在不进行显式搜索的情况下“提前搜索”以决定正确的下一步。隐式推理能力弱的模型更容易误入歧途，必须通过回溯尝试纠正；而隐式推理能力强的模型能直接识别正确证明策略，从而缩短CoT长度。然而，先前研究表明LLM在浅层深度之外难以进行隐式推理，且规模扩大也无法缓解此问题。我们探究课程学习是否可通过逐步增加词汇量和前瞻步数（模型需提前搜索多少步以确定正确下一步）的示例微调来扩展这一深度。在相同算力下，课程训练模型实现了无课程训练失败的前瞻能力。Qwen3-0.6B在前瞻步数达256的问题上，课程训练下准确率达98%，而无课程训练仅为45%。然而，随着微调持续进行，进展逐渐放缓，符合饱和指数规律，暗示模型内在可学习的隐式推理前瞻上限。更大模型能达到更高的拟合上限，微调预训练模型远优于从零训练，而课程步长过大则会阻碍进展。最终，合成数据上获得的能力可迁移至自然语言推理，课程训练模型在匹配算力下优于无课程训练模型，在11个自然语言推理基准测试中表现更优。

summary: Audio LLMs deployed in settings such as crisis hotlines and customer support are only useful beyond speech-to-text pipelines if they use acoustic cues rather than the transcript alone. We test whether they prioritise transcript content over paralinguistic cues (emotion, speaker identity, sarcasm) and trace the mechanism when they do. Across six audio LLMs under LISTEN-style conflict conditions, the mean text-dominance rate on mismatched text+audio items is 0.78 (0.86 excluding sarcasm). In the most text-dominant screened model, probing shows speaker identity remains linearly decodable at ceiling at the language model's input, so the failure is not perceptual. Back-patching, reported to repair lexical text dominance, has no measurable effect here; but it also fails on its own source task in our replication (n=300), so we treat its null as uninformative rather than as evidence of non-transfer. Attention knockout partially restores audio-grounded output by blocking the claim from propagating through intermediate tokens during open-ended generation, whereas blocking the answer position's direct connection to the conflicting claim has no effect. The claim's influence therefore travels through an intermediate relay rather than a single severable edge. The effect appears only in free-form generation and not in closed-set multiple choice, suggesting that benchmarks relying on that format may be systematically blind to interventions of this kind. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp.
title: Text Dominance in Paralinguistic Conflict: Tracing Suppression Through Audio LLM Circuits
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. Accepted at the InterpScience Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 语音LLM中文本主导现象：通过音频LLM电路追踪抑制机制
summary_translated: 在危机热线和客户服务等场景中，音频大语言模型（Audio LLM）若仅依赖语音转文字流程，则无法发挥其价值。本文测试这些模型是否优先考虑文本内容而非副语言线索（如情绪、说话人身份、讽刺）。在六种音频LLM于LISTEN风格冲突条件下，不匹配文本+音频样本的平均文本主导率为0.78（排除讽刺后为0.86）。在最文本主导的模型中，探测显示说话人身份在语言模型输入端仍可线性解码至极限水平，说明失败并非感知问题。回补（back-patching）虽被报道能修复词汇级文本主导，但在本研究复现中（n=300）自身任务也失败，因此将其无效结果视为无信息量而非非迁移证据。注意力击穿（attention knockout）通过阻断开放生成过程中主张信息在中间token中的传播，部分恢复了基于音频的输出；而阻断答案位置与冲突主张之间的直接连接则无效果。这表明主张影响通过中间中继传递，而非单一可切断路径。该效应仅出现在自由生成中，而非封闭式多选题中，提示依赖后者格式的基准可能系统性忽略此类干预。代码与数据已公开于https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp。

summary: System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.
title: Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. A first training on real documents is summarized; full results on real data in production are left to a companion paper
title_translated: 窄决策模型：一种校准型、类型化决策的系统一架构
summary_translated: 系统一模型（System One models）由TypeSafe的Jev引入，以校准概率回答关于状态的类型化问题，而非生成文本：包括自然语言描述选项中的选择（Choice）、将状态置于有序量表上（Score），或判断是/否陈述（Noul）。Jev具有通用性：一套权重，通过API服务，仅通过请求即可适应特定领域。本文研究设计空间的另一端——窄决策模型（NDM）。NDM提供相同接口，但专为单一组织的决策训练，规模小到可在其自有基础设施运行，并具备可陈述和测试的开放架构。状态可以是任何用于决策的文本或结构化记录，本文以法院通信路由为例。架构将请求序列化为前缀树（状态，然后每个问题，再每个选项），并在块注意力掩码下使用逻辑位置的双向编码器，使每个答案在构造上对选项顺序不变且独立于其他问题。通过组织图进行路由是带有显式“以上都不是”选项的选择决策组合。我们描述了通过课程学习的正确评分规则训练、校准与弃权机制、由规则组成的决策，以及在未见数据开放前接受或拒绝机制的协议。在公共和虚构数据上的最小验证表明，训练模型中不变性在四舍五入下依然成立；小型实例在从未见过的组织图上路由表现远超词法检索；在同等算力下，块架构损失低于成对交叉编码器。首个在真实法律文档上训练的实例，在91%的保留文档上与生产环境LLM分类器一致。

summary: Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace. Stage 2, Token-Class Redaction, counterfactually tests whether the frozen LLM depends on the localized shortcut. We apply this audit to TCR-pMHC binding, where tool augmentation substantially outperforms a no-evidence baseline. At face value, this suggests that the LLM has learned to use scientific evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.
title: Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
title_translated: 智能体LLM工具调用痕迹审计：源定位与反事实依赖性测试
summary_translated: 智能体大语言模型（Agentic LLMs）越来越多地通过外部证据支持科学预测。在生物学中，它们承诺通过整合复杂实验与计算证据，实现准确且可解释的重要问题预测。然而，串行化的工具结果可能包含隐藏的标签捷径，如数据集标识符或模板特征，导致看似成功却无生物推理过程。为应对这一风险，我们提出两阶段审计：第一阶段，每工具TF-IDF分解（PT2D），将标签预测模式定位到单个工具结果，避免在拼接工具轨迹中信号稀释；第二阶段，标记类擦除（Token-Class Redaction），反事实测试冻结的LLM是否依赖定位到的捷径。我们将此审计应用于TCR-pMHC结合预测，发现工具增强显著优于无证据基线。表面看，这表明LLM已学会使用科学证据。但审计推翻了这一解释：PT2D将最强信号定位到某一工具结果中的标识符，擦除后性能降至随机水平。这些发现揭示了隐藏标签捷径如何伪装成科学推理或发现，强调在信任基准提升前必须进行源级审计。

summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.
title: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
title_translated: ATEST：自适应资源感知的测试时缩放用于LLM推理
summary_translated: 测试时缩放（TTS）通过采样多个答案来提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力，但固定采样预算忽略了查询难度以及GPU竞争下推理能耗的变化。我们测量到，随着GPU负载上升，同一四样本查询的能耗最高增加4.1倍。我们提出ATEST，一种资源感知的TTS框架，同时考虑额外样本的预期价值及其当前GPU成本。ATEST-Online作为默认模式，无需离线校准：它增量生成样本，估计多数答案的稳定性，监控实时GPU状况，并在线学习每步能耗以决定停止时机。ATEST-Calibrated则利用离线准确率与成本模型为每个查询选择预算，适用于负载稳定的部署。我们在Phi-3-mini（NVIDIA A100）上控制变化负载下评估两种模式，涵盖四个推理与问答数据集，并测试在NVIDIA L40S和Qwen2.5-3B上的迁移能力。在四个A100数据集上，ATEST-Online在不超能耗预算的前提下完成所有查询，同时达到最高或统计上持平的准确率，并随负载增加减少采样。在GSM8K高负载下，其准确率达60.0%，无延迟；而ATEST-Calibrated仅为44.0%准确率，且有42.4%延迟。消融实验表明，在线成本学习驱动了对负载的适应。结合离线分析，ATEST-Online在评估工作负载下比ATEST-Calibrated节省42倍GPU时间与48倍能耗。在线控制以牺牲短任务的尾延迟和吞吐量为代价，换取在变化负载下的鲁棒性；离线校准在稳定条件下仍具竞争力。

summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are asked to report what they see: to count objects, box them, parse a screen or pick a click target (GUI grounding). We argue that reporting is part of the visual task, not merely its formatting. In a dense scene with 173 shapes, GPT-6.1 lists 173 records that match every shape, yet the counts it states in the same response sum to 188. From Seeing to Reporting (FSR) is a theory of visual reporting and a set of inference-time procedures that improve the reports of frozen VLMs. It models reporting as a chain from responses to decoded records, constructed sets and task answers, linked by task-compatible matching. The chain gives exact relations for deleting records, averaging their coordinates and switching readouts, and it splits the error of one answer chosen among several calls into missing candidates, lost representatives and wrong choices. These relations guide procedures for counting, detection, document layout, screen parsing and GUI grounding that use the task specification and a shipped configuration, without requiring labels from the target task. On 50 dense synthetic scenes, a one-call reporting-and-decoding protocol cuts per-type count error by 85.2% for GPT-6.1 and 98.8% for Claude Sonnet 5.5. On 600 ScreenSpot-Pro items, a GUI-grounding tier that combines three models lowers the miss rate from 13.67% for GPT-6.1's two-stage zoom to 9.33%, against 12.67% for three such zooms combined by a cluster vote at about the same cost. A plain vote over the same three models misses 12.33%: the other models supply the candidates, and selecting among them turns those candidates into fewer misses. We release the protocols, the stored responses and the analysis code.
title: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
comment: 56 pages, 6 figures. Code, prompts, configuration and all 67,364 stored model responses: this https URL
title_translated: 从看见到报告：视觉-语言模型中可靠视觉集合生成的理论
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）被要求报告其所见内容：计数物体、框选它们、解析屏幕或选择点击目标（GUI定位）。我们认为，报告是视觉任务的一部分，而非仅仅是格式化。在一个包含173个形状的密集场景中，GPT-6.1列出了173条与每个形状匹配的记录，但其在同一响应中陈述的计数总和为188。从看见到报告（FSR）是一种视觉报告理论及一系列推理时程序，旨在改进冻结VLM的报告质量。该理论将报告建模为从响应到解码记录、构建集合再到任务答案的链路，通过任务兼容匹配连接。该链路提供了删除记录、平均坐标、切换读出的精确关系，并将多个调用中选择一个答案的误差拆分为遗漏候选、丢失代表和错误选择。这些关系指导了计数、检测、文档布局、屏幕解析和GUI定位的程序，仅需任务规范和预装配置，无需目标任务标签。在50个密集合成场景中，一次调用的报告与解码协议使GPT-6.1的每类计数误差降低85.2%，Claude Sonnet 5.5降低98.8%。在600个ScreenSpot-Pro项目中，结合三个模型的GUI定位层级将漏检率从GPT-6.1两阶段缩放的13.67%降至9.33%，接近三阶段缩放组合的集群投票（约相同成本）；而对同一三个模型的简单投票漏检12.33%：其他模型提供候选，选择过程将这些候选转化为更少漏检。我们发布了协议、存储响应及分析代码。

summary: Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.
title: A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help
title_translated: 想象力的失败：视觉语言模型无法利用视觉表示来处理文本，但自蒸馏可以提供帮助
summary_translated: 视觉-语言（VL）模型通常通过微调语言模型以关注视觉特征来实现视觉问答任务。我们探讨这种对齐是否改变了语言模型对文本的表征——尤其是在可视化有助于解答的任务中，例如用文字描述的几何问题。我们区分了弱多模态（模型能回答关于输入图像的问题）和强多模态（模型的文本表征本身变得与视觉对齐，从而提升具有潜在视觉结构的纯文本任务表现）。为测试强多模态性，我们构建了一个包含成对等价文本与图像描述的形状计数任务。当提供图像时该任务很简单，但仅以线段坐标形式给出文本描述时则需要进行可视化推理。我们在该文本变体任务上对比了指令微调的Qwen-2.5和Mistral模型与其视觉对齐版本的表现。结果发现，尽管在图像版本任务上表现优异，多模态模型在此设置下并无优势。探针实验也证实：视觉对齐的解码器嵌入并不比纯文本对应项携带更多视觉结构。最后，我们提出一种优化目标，将上下文中的视觉嵌入蒸馏到文本嵌入中。这种对齐在无需显式任务监督的情况下提升了文本变体任务的表现，甚至在复杂度超过对齐阶段样本的测试中也有效。这表明，VQA风格的对齐方式尚未充分利用跨模态迁移潜力。

summary: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.
title: System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache
title_translated: System X：一个从自身KV缓存中回复的大型语言模型决策模型
summary_translated: 决策模型会返回给定选项的概率分布，但部署中的智能体也可能需要以自然语言作答。本文提出System X，一种大型语言模型（LLM）决策模型，在LLM作为Jev读出的基础上增加了文本回复选项。当该选项胜出或置信度较低时，同一模型可继续从决策的键值（KV）缓存中生成，避免重复提示预填充。使用LoRA在Reason-9k和Bitext回复数据上微调的Qwen3-0.6B模型在JevBench上的准确率无显著变化（55.4%降至54.5%，p=0.87），但预期校准误差从0.292降至0.169。保留的Bitext路由准确率达到98.3%。在Apple M4 Pro上，缓存复用节省了15%-37%的延迟，FP32演示案例中生成的token完全一致。对提示缓存副本进行评分，其概率与全序列评分相差不超过1.4e-6。加入对话、行业及投诉数据（System X+）虽提升了支持任务表现，但使IFEval准确率从55.5%下降至45.0%。System X v4采用Qwen3-1.7B，重新平衡数据并由教师重写回复目标。相比基础LLM，JevBench准确率从55.0%提升至61.0%（p=0.04），IFEval无显著变化（p=0.71）。在未适配的Qwen3-1.7B上进行匹配延迟测试，节省17%-39%时间。一名LLM裁判更偏好v4回复而非未适配的1.7B模型的第二次调用（31对11，p=0.003）；另一名裁判偏好不显著。这些回复比较也存在提示和生成限制差异。状态冲突和不支持的回复细节仍是失败模式。建议进一步开展多种子、人工评估和真实支持数据研究。

summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional context. As these models reach real-world deployment, machine unlearning becomes essential. This process aims to remove the influence of a designated "forget set" without retraining from scratch, so that sensitive, copyrighted, or restricted content can no longer be elicited while preserving retained capabilities. Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU) is the first publicly available unlearning method customized for these models: it tunes the model $p_θ$ to match a frozen prompt-masked anchor $p_{\mathrm{anchor}}$ on the forget set by minimizing the anchor-last divergence $\mathrm{KL}(p_θ\Vert p_{\mathrm{anchor}})$. We identify two failure modes of MDU. First, random answer masking can leave key forget tokens visible to the anchor even when the question is fully masked. Second, at a memorized (near-one-hot) prediction, the anchor-last logit gradient vanishes while the anchor-first divergence $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{anchor}} \Vert p_θ)$ logit gradient does not. As a result, MDU training stalls on the tokens we most need to forget. Backed by theoretical and empirical analyses, we propose Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU): anchor-first KL divergence toward a frozen anchor whose entire answer span is masked. On TOFU and RWKU benchmarks using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, our EMDU matches or exceeds the forgetting of MDU and adapted AR baselines, while better preserving retain utility.
title: Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning
title_translated: 增强型掩码扩散去遗忘
summary_translated: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）通过迭代地利用双向上下文解掩码生成文本。随着这些模型进入实际部署，机器去遗忘变得至关重要。该过程旨在移除指定“遗忘集”的影响，而无需从头训练，从而使敏感、受版权保护或受限内容不再被触发，同时保留原有能力。掩码扩散去遗忘（MDU）是首个公开可用的专为这类模型设计的去遗忘方法：它通过最小化锚点-末尾KL散度 $\mathrm{KL}(p_θ\Vert p_{\mathrm{anchor}})$，使模型 $p_θ$ 在遗忘集上匹配冻结的提示-掩码锚点 $p_{\mathrm{anchor}}$。我们识别出MDU的两个失效模式：第一，随机答案掩码可能导致关键遗忘词即使在问题完全掩码的情况下仍对锚点可见；第二，在记忆化的（接近一热）预测处，锚点-末尾logit梯度消失，而锚点-首尾KL散度 $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{anchor}} \Vert p_θ)$ 的logit梯度仍存在。因此，MDU训练在最需遗忘的词上停滞。基于理论与实证分析，我们提出增强型掩码扩散去遗忘（EMDU）：采用整个答案跨度均被掩码的冻结锚点，计算锚点-首尾KL散度。在TOFU和RWKU基准上使用LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B进行测试，我们的EMDU在遗忘效果上达到或超过MDU和适配的AR基线，同时更好地保持了保留能力。

summary: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.
title: Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
title_translated: 面向智能体知识图谱问答的结果锚定信用再分配
summary_translated: 智能体知识图谱问答（KGQA）要求大型语言模型（LLMs）通过与知识图谱（KG）的多轮交互解决复杂问题。基于结果的强化学习从最终答案中获取可验证的结果奖励，但将每条轨迹的结果级优势均匀分配给所有策略生成的token，造成轨迹与操作之间的错配，因为KG中的不同操作对搜索过程和最终答案的影响各不相同。为解决此问题，我们提出结果锚定信用再分配（OACR），该方法使用仅用于训练的KG状态结果模型，估计相邻KG搜索状态间的结果奖励变化，并将其转化为操作信用，进而推导出逐token权重。这些乘法权重在保持每个生成token的结果级优势符号不变的前提下，重新分配了token级别的更新幅度。在三个基准测试中，OACR在整体性能上优于现有KGQA方法，同时减少了推理阶段的LLM调用次数和token消耗。

summary: Long-running agents rely on memory of their past interactions for task state, such as what has been completed and which conditions still hold. Such state is usually a derived state. No record states it, and it must be computed by rules from multiple records of an evolving history. Existing memory benchmarks score only the final answer, with no reference for the intermediate states behind it. A wrong answer therefore cannot be traced to the state that was missed, and a state that silently became outdated goes undetected. We present MemDerive, a diagnostic benchmark for agent memory over evolving data. It specifies each scenario symbolically, derives exact gold answers with Datalog, records the gold derivation DAG and the supporting events of every query, and renders the history in natural language with fictional entities and distractors. Its 10 scenarios contain 4,692 events and 1,503 queries whose difficulty varies along access, evolution, and composition. On this ground truth, MemDerive evaluates answer reliability, diagnoses failures by probing the nodes of the gold derivation DAG, and tracks whether answers stay correct as events arrive. Our evaluation of four memory systems reveals failures that final-answer benchmarks hide. On derived state, every memory system falls behind simple BM25 retrieval, although the same answer model reaches 96.01% when given the supporting events. Most failures are ungathered, as a system holds the missing intermediate state but does not retrieve it for the question that needs it. Memory systems also rarely propagate implicit changes, which no new record states. These results suggest three principles for memory design. Gather inputs along the derivation, store rules with their versions, and maintain derived states through recorded dependencies.
title: MemDerive: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agent Memory over Evolving Data
title_translated: MemDerive：面向动态数据的智能体记忆诊断基准
summary_translated: 长期运行的智能体依赖于过去交互的记忆来维持任务状态，例如已完成的内容和仍有效的条件。此类状态通常是派生状态，没有直接记录，必须通过多个演化历史记录的规则推导得出。现有的记忆基准仅评估最终答案，缺乏对背后中间状态的参考。因此，错误答案无法追溯到缺失的状态，而悄然过时的状态也无法被检测到。我们提出MemDerive，一个面向动态数据的智能体记忆诊断基准。它以符号方式定义每个场景，使用Datalog推导精确的黄金答案，记录黄金推导有向无环图（DAG）以及每个查询的支持事件，并用虚构实体和干扰项将历史渲染为自然语言。其10个场景包含4,692个事件和1,503个查询，难度沿访问、演化和组合维度变化。基于此真实情况，MemDerive评估答案可靠性，通过探测黄金推导DAG节点诊断失败原因，并追踪答案随事件到来是否保持正确。对四种记忆系统的评估揭示了最终答案基准所隐藏的失败。在派生状态上，所有记忆系统均落后于简单的BM25检索，尽管相同的答案模型在提供支持事件时可达96.01%准确率。大多数失败源于系统持有缺失的中间状态却未将其检索用于所需问题。记忆系统也极少传播隐含变化，而这些变化并无新记录体现。这些结果提出了三条记忆设计原则：沿推导路径收集输入，存储规则及其版本，通过记录依赖关系维护派生状态。

summary: We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. Supervised fine-tuning attaches a frozen text encoder through gated cross-attention, and direct preference optimization (DPO) uses the same moves under a mismatched description as the rejected sample. After DPO, style adherence rises on every prompt we test (for example, queens traded early 53% -> 67%, pawn moves 29% -> 32% of all moves, queenside castling 97.3% -> 99.7%), and strength without a prompt stays within noise of SFT (1792 vs. 1797 Elo). Design choices at every stage were made by fixed-budget automated search loops on top of standard architectures and training recipes. We document the full pipeline and the decisions behind it, report the ablations that failed, and evaluate the models across many style prompts and kinds of games, with 1,000 games per setting. The work is fully open source and reproducible: weights, datasets with all training labels, prompts, configurations, inference code and playable demos are public and free to build on.
title: CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts
title_translated: CHSM8：一种遵循自然语言风格提示的国际象棋Transformer
summary_translated: 我们提出CHSM8，一个拥有2.1亿参数的国际象棋Transformer模型，能够根据自由文本描述的棋风来下棋，例如“采用西西里防御”、“稳健、安全、无风险的棋风”或“你就是巅峰时期的马格努斯·卡尔森”。该模型在107亿条经过筛选的Lichess对局数据上进行预训练，使用因子化走法表示和合法走法掩码，无需搜索。其在与强度受限的Stockfish对战中达到1837 Elo，并在1000局比赛中击败了所有其他未经过偏好调优、奖励或搜索训练的公开模型，包括一个参数量为其13倍的模型。随后，我们在合成数据集上对其进行微调以响应文本：Gemma-4-31B描述了300万局对局的棋风，10亿参数的Gemma-3模型从其中240万条无矛盾的描述中提炼出标签，每局3000万精选对局获得五种描述。通过监督微调（SFT）将冻结的文本编码器通过门控交叉注意力连接，直接偏好优化（DPO）则使用不匹配描述下的相同走法作为拒绝样本。DPO后，所有测试提示下的风格一致性显著提升（例如，早期兑后比例从53%升至67%，兵步移动占比从29%升至32%，王翼易位从97.3%升至99.7%），且在无提示情况下的强度与SFT保持一致（1792 vs. 1797 Elo）。每个阶段的设计选择均基于标准架构和训练方法上的固定预算自动化搜索循环。我们完整记录了整个流程及决策过程，报告了失败的消融实验，并在多种风格提示和不同类型对局中评估模型，每种设置下均有1000局对局。本工作完全开源可复现：权重、带所有训练标签的数据集、提示、配置、推理代码和可玩演示均已公开，可供自由构建。

summary: Planning does not by itself imply the ability to recognise errors, but recognising errors can improve planning capacity. In this paper, we study this phenomenon in Transformer planning. To analyze the inner mechanism, we follow the approach of Wang et al. (2024) and abstract planning as path-finding in graphs. In this setting, we train the model to detect the error of invalid transitions, i.e., after the model generates a next node that is not adjacent with the current node, the model should then generate a special abort token x. For expressiveness, we construct a Transformer with feed-forward width $O(|V|)$ for any fixed graph with node set $V$. It can detect all possible invalid transitions, and select a valid next node if the prefix is valid. We then propose a worst-case lower bound on feed-forward width, which makes the detector's linear width near-optimal up to logarithmic factors. In trained models, we demonstrate that invalid-transition detection increases previous-node attention, and most of the valid--invalid separation locates in the feed-forward network's output. This accords with our theoretical insights. Finally, we use this error detection to improve the model's performance: at inference, generating the abort token x will directly cause an external procedure to discard the attempt and restart from the original prompt. Experiments show that error detection combined with retry improves model's planning reliability on graphs, Countdown, and mazes.
title: Learning When to Abort in Transformer Planning: A Mechanistic Study
title_translated: 学习Transformer规划中何时中止：一种机制性研究
summary_translated: 规划本身并不意味着具备错误识别能力，但错误识别可以增强规划能力。本文研究了Transformer规划中的这一现象。为分析内部机制，我们沿用Wang等（2024）的方法，将规划抽象为图中的路径寻找问题。在此设定下，我们训练模型检测无效转移错误，即当模型生成下一个节点与当前节点不相邻时，应生成特殊中止标记x。为保证表达力，我们构建了一个前馈宽度为$O(|V|)$的Transformer（针对任意固定节点集V的图）。该模型能检测所有可能的无效转移，并在前缀有效时选择一个有效下一节点。随后，我们提出了前馈宽度的最坏情况下界，使检测器的线性宽度接近最优（仅差对数因子）。在训练模型中，我们发现无效转移检测会增加对前一节点的关注度，而大多数有效-无效分离集中在前馈网络的输出中，这与我们的理论洞察一致。最后，我们利用此错误检测机制提升模型性能：在推理阶段，生成中止标记x将直接触发外部程序放弃当前尝试并从原始提示重新开始。实验表明，结合错误检测与重试机制可显著提高模型在图、倒计时和迷宫任务中的规划可靠性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on corpora that reflect Western, anglophone worldviews. This asymmetry is not neutral: when a model answers questions about territory, community authority, or the relationship with nature, it does so from assumptions that may be alien to the communities using the system. This paper presents a system for aligning language models with the ethical principles of Indigenous communities in Latin America. Drawing on interviews with five Indigenous leaders and defenders, we built an operational cultural constitution grounded in an Indigenous cosmovision, with 12 principles. On this basis, we implemented a Constitutional AI (CAI) pipeline in two phases: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO). The base models were Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. With only 24 preference pairs, improvements were modest but detectable in intergenerational transmission, linguistic caution, and consultation and consent. Qualitative analysis reveals that the SFT phase was responsible for the primary shift in alignment, while DPO refined specific categories. The system was deployed in a conversational interface with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that allows communities to feed the knowledge base, turning alignment into a participatory cycle. We argue the architecture is functional and will scale qualitatively once the corpus is expanded and computing constraints are resolved. The work constitutes a first iteration of an epistemic justice mechanism for value alignment in the Global South.
title: Aligning Language Models with Indigenous Community Cosmovision through Constitutional AI
comment: In preparation for the Dossier "Linguistics in AI and AI in Linguistics" of the journal TextoLivre
title_translated: 通过宪法AI实现语言模型与原住民社区世界观的对齐
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）主要基于反映西方、英语世界视角的语料库进行训练。这种不对称并非中立：当模型回答关于领土、社区权威或人与自然关系的问题时，其回答基于可能与使用者社区相异的假设。本文提出一种系统，用于将语言模型与拉丁美洲原住民社区的伦理原则对齐。基于对五位原住民领袖和捍卫者的访谈，我们构建了一个基于原住民宇宙观的操作性文化宪章，包含12项原则。在此基础上，我们实施了两阶段的宪法AI（CAI）流程：监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。基础模型为Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct。仅使用24组偏好对，改进效果虽有限但可检测，体现在代际传承、语言谨慎性以及协商与同意方面。定性分析显示，SFT阶段是实现对齐转变的主要原因，而DPO则细化了特定类别。该系统部署于带有检索增强生成（RAG）的对话界面中，允许社区向知识库输入内容，使对齐成为一个参与式循环。我们认为该架构具有功能性，一旦语料库扩大且计算约束解除，将实现质的提升。这项工作构成了全球南方价值对齐中认知正义机制的首次迭代。

summary: Theoretical literature warns that advanced generalist agentic systems might pursue instrumental goals that are misaligned with human preferences, thus posing risks of irreversible loss of human control. The EU's Code of Practice for General-Purpose AI lists loss of control as a systemic risk that must be assessed, yet no structured assessment of the quality of the empirical evidence for this risk exists. This study fills that gap. We evaluate 19 recent empirical studies across eight properties identified from threat models (such as strategic deception, situational awareness, and autonomous replication), assessing the quality of evidence across three dimensions: construct validity, content validity, and external validity. Our central finding is that the current body of evidence supports a judgment of loss of control as "weakly plausible." In our framework, 'plausibility' denotes the strength and direction of available evidence, not a probability estimate. Emerging evidence exists across multiple properties. No study clears the validity thresholds for a stronger judgment that a property is present; a single study clears them only for a negative-direction judgment (against situational awareness). Validity gaps, particularly in external validity, are widespread. Therefore, our findings highlight the need for more rigorous evaluations of agentic general-purpose AI systems. However, for the most dangerous properties, high external validity may be structurally unachievable under responsible research practices, reflecting a ceiling on feasible evidence rather than absence of the capability. Furthermore, as AI capabilities advance rapidly, empirical assessments may systematically lag behind the capability frontier. Our framework provides a structured baseline for ongoing monitoring as capabilities advance.
title: Assessing the Empirical Evidence for Loss of Control from Agentic General-Purpose AI
comment: 42 pages. Previously posted on SSRN on 28 May 2026
title_translated: 评估通用智能体AI失控风险的实证证据
summary_translated: 理论文献警告，先进的通用智能体系统可能追求与人类偏好不一致的工具性目标，从而导致不可逆的人类控制丧失。欧盟《通用人工智能行为准则》将失控列为必须评估的系统性风险，但目前尚无结构化评估该风险实证证据质量的方法。本研究填补了这一空白。我们评估了19项近期实证研究，涵盖从威胁模型中识别出的八个属性（如战略性欺骗、情境意识、自主复制等），从三个维度评估证据质量：构念效度、内容效度和外部效度。核心发现是，现有证据支持‘失控’这一判断为‘弱可成立’。在我们的框架中，‘可成立性’指可用证据的强度与方向，而非概率估计。多个属性存在初步证据。没有任何研究达到更强判断所需的效度阈值；仅有一项研究在负向判断（反对情境意识）上达标。效度缺口，尤其是外部效度方面的缺口，普遍存在。因此，我们的研究强调需要对通用智能体AI系统进行更严格的评估。然而，对于最危险的属性，高外部效度在负责任的研究实践中可能在结构上无法实现，这反映了可行证据的上限，而非能力缺失。此外，随着AI能力迅速发展，实证评估可能系统性地落后于能力前沿。我们的框架为持续监测能力演进提供了结构化基准。

summary: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.
title: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
title_translated: 基于用户搜索行为与知识图谱的对话推荐生成
summary_translated: 大规模对话推荐数据集通常需要人工构建或标注对话。我们提出SearCl，一种基于用户搜索与点击行为自动生成对话推荐对话的方法。SearCl将用户交互划分为查询会话，并从搜索查询后的选中内容中推导出每个推荐目标。一个可配置的概率状态机控制对话流程，同时两个LLM代理——作为探索者和推荐者——根据回合级约束生成话语。为支持推荐，推荐者被提供由每个对话中内容项元数据构建的知识图谱，捕捉其属性与关系。使用SearCl，我们从内容搜索与点击交互数据中生成了3,538个对话，覆盖1,731个唯一目标项目。在LLM作为裁判的协议下，生成的对话质量得分高于现有基准对话。这些结果表明，SearCl能够在无需人工标注的情况下实现可控且基于知识的数据集构建。

summary: Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.
title: Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents
title_translated: 记忆，了解你的PLACE：持久记忆智能体中生命周期状态与查询时可用性的治理
summary_translated: 持久记忆将以往的交互转化为智能体的持久状态，但现有系统对这些状态是否保持有效以及是否应影响后续查询的控制能力有限。我们认为，可靠的记忆需要对状态形成和查询时的影响进行双重治理。我们提出了PLACE，一种解耦的治理层，为记忆后端添加了写入端的状态认证和读取端的授权机制。在Mem0上使用Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-7B进行因子化评估，分离了各机制的贡献。结果表明，写入端治理显著提升了生命周期状态的正确性，而读取端治理在状态正确的设定下消除了来自无效记忆的因果泄漏。两者的结合实现了最强的联合性能，同时保留了与查询相关的支持信息。这些发现表明，可靠的持久记忆需要对维持的状态和查询时的信息影响进行显式控制。

summary: LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \methodfull (\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.
title: Indistinguishable Agents: Training Agent Privacy as Twin-World Indistinguishability
title_translated: 不可区分的智能体：通过双世界不可区分性训练智能体隐私
summary_translated: 大型语言模型智能体为用户搜索、购物和发送消息，每一项操作都会被某些方观察到。现有的隐私训练仅奖励智能体不提及受保护内容，但观察者仍可能从智能体的行为中推断出私密事实。由于观察者仅在视图随事实变化时才能学习到该事实，我们提出	extit{methodfull}（	extit{method}），其在仅在私密事实不同的双世界中进行训练。一个冻结的判别器根据真实世界的对数似然比评分每个观察者的视图，配对GRPO则在任务成功率减去该比值的目标上训练智能体。我们证明该目标可控制所有观察者在所有通道上的贝叶斯成功率。在购物和消息任务中，	extit{method} 消除了披露裁判和查询级奖励所遗漏的泄露，同时智能体仍能完成任务。

summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly suffer from hallucinations, which appear as fabricating non-existent objects or outputting incorrect attributes and spatial relationships in images. Previous works empirically indicate that CLIP-style vision encoders tend to focus on primary objects while ignoring image details, which is one of the causes of hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose plug-and-play fine-grained visual experts (PLANE) comprising two components: LoRA visual experts operating on CLIP for multi-aspect image encoding, and an instruction-aware gate network for adaptive image feature fusion. During training, we construct a fine-grained image-caption pairs dataset, where images are described from three aspects: objects, attributes, and relations between objects. Image-caption pairs from different aspects are used to train the three fine-grained LoRA experts respectively. Aiming at comprehensively evaluate our method's capabilities, we manually annotate a fine-grained hallucination evaluation benchmark for LVLMs which is GPT4-independent during evaluation phase (GIFT). We conduct experiments both on popular hallucination evaluation benchmarks and GIFT. The results show that our method effectively reduces hallucinations across models of different types and sizes while introducing minimal inference latency. Compared to advanced baselines, our model also demonstrates superior performance.
title: PLANE: Plug-and-Play Fine-Grained Visual Experts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
title_translated: PLANE：用于大视觉-语言模型幻觉缓解的即插即用细粒度视觉专家
summary_translated: 大视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）普遍存在幻觉问题，表现为虚构不存在的对象或输出图像中错误的属性和空间关系。先前研究指出，CLIP风格的视觉编码器倾向于关注主要对象而忽略图像细节，这是导致幻觉的原因之一。为解决此问题，我们提出即插即用的细粒度视觉专家（PLANE），包含两个组件：在CLIP上运行的LoRA视觉专家，用于多方面图像编码；以及一个指令感知门控网络，实现自适应图像特征融合。训练时，我们构建了一个细粒度图像-标题对数据集，其中图像从三个角度描述：对象、属性和对象间关系。不同角度的图像-标题对分别用于训练三个细粒度LoRA专家。为全面评估方法能力，我们手动标注了一个独立于GPT4的细粒度幻觉评估基准（GIFT）。我们在多个流行幻觉评估基准和GIFT上进行了实验。结果表明，我们的方法在不同类型和规模的模型中均有效减少幻觉，且引入的推理延迟极小。相比先进基线，我们的模型也展现出更优性能。

summary: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.
title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 可追踪技能库生命周期管理用于代理强化学习
summary_translated: 增强技能的代理强化学习已成为提升大语言模型智能体在长周期任务中表现的有效方法。尽管取得进展，随着策略演化，单个技能可能遵循不同轨迹：有些在模型内化其能力后变得冗余，有些仍作为外部支撑有价值，还有些可能变得有害。然而，现有技能库系统因共检索技能间的搭便车现象、跨任务混淆困难以及缺乏技能特定反事实证据，无法准确识别每项技能的真实贡献，从而阻碍了可靠的技能生命周期管理。我们提出TrackRL，一种以技能追踪驱动技能库全生命周期管理的代理强化学习框架。具体而言，在每个GRPO组内，我们将分组采样转化为在线随机对照实验。通过独立随机注入和组内对比，可在同一任务上隔离每项技能的真实贡献，可靠性加权聚合则在多组间累积证据。随着证据积累，我们持续追踪技能效用（衡量技能作为外部支撑的因果贡献）和模型掌握度（反映对应能力的内化程度）。基于此，我们将技能生命周期管理建模为一个证据门控的状态转移过程，管理技能从生成、准入、受保护孵化到保留、退休或移除，并通过软容量约束控制库的增长。实验表明，TrackRL在有技能辅助和无技能评估中均优于近期技能增强型RL基线，进一步分析揭示了技能价值在策略学习过程中的动态变化，以及证据驱动的状态转移如何塑造技能库演化。代码已公开于https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL。

summary: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.
title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
title_translated: CoEvo-RSI：当 harness 进化时，哪些模型应随之演进？
summary_translated: 模型与 harness 的协同进化已成为递归自我改进（RSI）智能体的主流范式，共同演化其执行架构和内在能力。我们研究了该范式中长期存在却常被忽视的“大脑-身体”不匹配问题，即不断演化的 harness（身体）要求模型（大脑）尚未学会的行为，或限制其已具备的能力。我们提出 CoEvo-RSI，一种通过代理驱动、双向历史继承推进模型-harness 协同进化的 RSI 框架。基于共享的进化档案和执行反馈，元智能体协调 harness 的开发，结合历史设计、模型检查点选择或合并，以及在选定 harness 下的后续适应，使继承能力与不断演化的执行需求对齐，从而减少大脑-身体不匹配。仅使用自身拒绝采样轨迹的监督微调（SFT），CoEvo-RSI 使 Qwen3.5-9B 在多样垂直应用中达到与更大模型相当的表现，包括多智能体故障归因、角色感知文本到SQL、智能家居指令执行。其在 TraceElephant 上超越 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（+14.16% 智能体准确率），在 HomeBench VM 上超越 GLM-5.3（+4.90% 成功率），凸显了大脑-身体对齐的重要性，以及双向历史继承在推动智能体协同进化方面的潜力。

summary: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.
title: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, Sydney. 20 pages, 5 figures
title_translated: 策略并非能力：一些安全基准测试衡量的是你训练时采用的‘不安全’定义
summary_translated: 一种护栏分类器被当作文本本身具有‘不安全’属性来报告，但实际上这是策略的属性，而策略通过标签进入模型。我们利用工业部署中的一个偶然情况，即约5.3万个提示在两种操作定义下（‘这是否是有害内容请求？’和‘管理员是否会屏蔽此内容？’）被标注两次，并用于训练十个共享架构、代码库和优化器族的护栏分支，涵盖两个模型规模。首先，护栏自身的训练语料库已包含这些基准测试：JailbreakBench-benign有88%、OR-Bench-hard有82%的内容存在于训练池中，还有两个过度拒绝的基准测试，这类测试正是护栏用来论证其不会过度屏蔽的依据。所有后续分析均基于去污染数据。其次，安全基准测试得分在很大程度上由标签定义决定而非模型表现：在固定架构和优化器的情况下，十个分支之间的得分差异范围为HarmBench-copyright的0.99和WildGuard-benign的0.043，相差23倍。第三，仅通过调整0.03%的参数即可使基准得分横跨整个范围：在这些分支中，HarmBench-copyright得分为0-100，OR-Bench-hard过度拒绝率为3.4%-56.4%，而最后监督信号携带特定策略的四个分支恰好占据两端极端（精确秩检验p=0.005，最差情况下为0.04-0.14），且检测能力保持不变。对于精炼后的学生模型，即使每个硬标签都代表另一策略，教师的软标签仍能实现这一效果，因此教师来源成为任何发布检查点中的未记录混杂因素。第四，在唯一评估所有二十个分支的验证集上，准确率与标注者策略的一致性相关（rho=+0.74），而非检测能力（rho=+0.34）。我们主张护栏评估应将污染程度、种子基线以及所依据的定义作为第一类变量进行报告。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher's corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD's final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD
title: Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 超越教师：理解并保留代理型在线蒸馏中的过冲现象
summary_translated: 在线蒸馏（OPD）使用更强教师模型的监督信号，对代理自身轨迹进行训练。我们在多轮代理任务中发现了一个反直觉现象：初始较弱的小型学生模型在训练过程中可显著优于其教师，但随着蒸馏继续，性能又会回落。我们称此现象为蒸馏过冲。通过决策层和任务层分析，我们发现OPD存在两种相互竞争的影响：修复学生薄弱决策，同时侵蚀教师不认可的成功学生选择。训练初期，修复效应超过侵蚀效应，使学生能够结合教师修正与自身优势，超越教师；但随着训练深入，侵蚀效应占主导，导致先前优势消失。受此启发，我们提出成功保留型在线蒸馏（SPOD），该方法选择性地屏蔽在成功学生选择上的冲突教师监督，并引入软概率下限以对抗其侵蚀，同时在其他地方保留教师指导。SPOD仅需二值化回合成功信号和训练期间已有的模型概率。在两个模型族和三个代理基准上，SPOD始终优于普通OPD及其变体，最终成功率提升最高达15.2个百分点，甚至超过教师最高达20.0分。此外，在全部六个设置中，SPOD的最终检查点性能也优于普通OPD的最佳中间检查点，证明超越教师的性能不仅能被保留，还能进一步扩展。代码见：https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

summary: Prompt injection is the dominant security risk for large-language-model (LLM) applications and agents, yet the field still lacks a coherent map of how these attacks are constructed. More than twenty public datasets describe prompt injection using incompatible vocabularies, often organized around delivery vector, attacker goal, or generation method. In this Systematization of Knowledge, we present PIAtlas, a taxonomy organized instead around how the injected instruction is constructed to subvert the underlying model. Its six classes, one per subversion mechanism, form the roots of a hierarchy of techniques and sub-techniques that researchers can use to describe attacks consistently and design more systematic evaluations. We derive the taxonomy from how LLMs are trained, prompted, and influenced by human-like framing, and compare it with historical attack data. To ground this comparison, we release PICorpus, to our knowledge the largest license-clean collection of public prompt-injection datasets, and map thousands of its records to PIAtlas under a human-verified protocol. The mapping shows that attacks usually combine several techniques drawn from only a few mechanisms. It also reveals gaps that existing labels obscure: widely used agent benchmarks test only part of the attack space, and adaptive attackers favor mechanisms that curated benchmarks underrepresent. PIAtlas thus provides a common foundation for understanding this attack space, improving benchmark coverage, and guiding red teaming and defenses.
title: SoK: PIAtlas: Decomposing the Unbounded Prompt Injection Attack Space

title_translated: 综述：PIAtlas——分解无限提示注入攻击空间
summary_translated: 提示注入是大语言模型（LLM）应用和代理的主要安全风险，但该领域仍缺乏对攻击构造方式的系统性地图。目前超过二十个公开数据集以不兼容的术语描述提示注入，通常按传递载体、攻击目标或生成方法组织。在本知识体系化研究中，我们提出PIAtlas，一个围绕注入指令如何构建以颠覆底层模型的分类体系。其六个类别对应六种子版本机制，构成技术与子技术的层级结构，供研究人员一致描述攻击并设计更系统的评估。该分类体系基于LLM的训练、提示方式及人类式框架的影响推导而来，并与历史攻击数据对比。为支持该对比，我们发布了PICorpus，据我们所知，这是最大且许可证清洁的公共提示注入数据集集合，并通过人工验证协议将数千条记录映射至PIAtlas。映射结果显示，攻击通常结合来自少数机制的多种技术。同时揭示了现有标签掩盖的空白：广泛使用的代理基准仅覆盖攻击空间的一部分，而自适应攻击者偏好那些被精选基准低估的机制。因此，PIAtlas为理解该攻击空间提供了共同基础，提升了基准覆盖率，并指导红队测试与防御策略。

summary: Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. Lowering the threshold along a geometric grid gives nested samples, a Horvitz--Thompson estimate of the output at every level, and confidence bounds that hold simultaneously over all levels, so each head stops at the first level whose certificate meets the target error $\varepsilon$. With fresh perturbations at every decoding step, each certificate fails with probability at most $δ$ during generation. At a suitable threshold, the estimator reads $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$ values regardless of the context length, and no adaptive method reads fewer, up to constants. A 4-bit scan with deterministic bounds, shared across a grouped-query-attention group, generates the candidates exactly but reads every key. On three LLMs and ten settings at 16K--128K tokens, no certificate is violated, and at equal keys read our 90th-percentile error is 4.6--7.9$\times$ lower than that of the best of 15 baseline families. At equal bytes, the best baselines have 0.6--1.6 times our 90th-percentile error and at least 4.9 times our largest. End to end, our method stays within one point of dense attention on tasks and within 0.1\% in PG-19 perplexity, and the strongest baselines at equal bytes score as well. On CPU, decoding steps at 32K--128K tokens run 1.1--1.4$\times$ faster than dense attention on the same 16-bit cache.
title: Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval
