title_translated: 通过扰动检索实现认证稀疏注意力
summary_translated: 稀疏注意力通过仅读取KV缓存中的少量键来加速长上下文解码，但现有方法无法控制查询的误差，且在真实KV缓存上其误差分布具有重尾特征。我们发现，对每个键的得分独立添加Exp(1)扰动后，阈值检索可转化为按注意力权重比例采样键。沿几何网格降低阈值可获得嵌套采样，每一层提供输出的Horvitz-Thompson估计，并在所有层级上同时保持置信区间，使得每个头可在首个满足目标误差ε的层级停止。每次解码步骤使用新扰动，生成过程中每个证书失败的概率不超过δ。在合适阈值下，估计器读取的数值为O(ε⁻² log(1/δ))，无论上下文长度如何，且无自适应方法能读取更少（常数范围内）。4位扫描使用确定性边界，适用于分组查询注意力组，可精确生成候选但需读取所有键。在三个LLM和十种设置（16K–128K token）中，无证书被违反；在相同读取键数下，我们的90百分位误差比15个基线家族中最优者低4.6–7.9倍。在相同字节数下，最优基线的90百分位误差为我们的0.6–1.6倍，最大误差至少为我们的4.9倍。端到端来看，我们的方法在任务表现上与密集注意力相差不到1分，在PG-19困惑度上仅差0.1%，且在相同字节下最强基线表现相当。在CPU上，32K–128K token的解码步骤速度比同16位缓存的密集注意力快1.1–1.4倍。

summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.
title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
title_translated: CoworkEnv：为长时程协作代理合成训练环境
summary_translated: AI同事必须协调工具使用、跨轮次沟通，并在工作空间状态变化时执行任务，同时遵守工作流约束。构建此类能力的训练经验需要连贯的请求、服务记录、工具接口和评分校验。我们提出CoworkEnv，一种面向能力引导的框架，用于合成可执行的AI同事训练环境。工作流需求指导任务构建，程序化验证与反馈修复检查生成规范和评分行为。教师执行产生用于监督微调（SFT）的精选示范，而学生交互则提供轨迹和强化学习（RL）所需的奖励。利用这些资源，我们训练出紧凑的PocketWorker模型。对于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，SFT使Claw-Eval平均得分从46.6提升至64.1，其中多轮任务提升达31.9分。SFT-only扩展至ClawMark展示了其在不同同事基准上的适用性。我们还比较了不同奖励处理和信用分配配置下的RL训练动态。改进训练奖励提供了初步证据，表明所构建环境支持策略优化。

summary: Language model benchmarks assign each question a single outcome from one fixed wording, even though the same underlying request can be expressed in many equivalent ways. We argue that the quantity of interest should therefore not be correctness on one wording, but the accessibility of an inquiry, which we define as the probability that a model succeeds across meaning-preserving formulations. The distribution of accessibility across inquiries reveals a structure that accuracy and existing best-, worst-, or average-case prompt scores collapse: how broadly a model's capabilities extend across inquiries and how dependably those capabilities can be elicited. Two models can have the same average performance while one succeeds across more inquiries unreliably and the other succeeds across fewer inquiries but more consistently, leading to opposite preferences depending on whether the task allows multiple retries until one success or when repeated consistent success is required. Across six benchmarks and more than twenty models, this tradeoff is common: for about half of the model pairs with nearly equal mean accessibility, which model looks better depends on whether one success across five formulations is enough or all five must succeed, quantities we call Access@5 and Reliable@5, respectively. For some pairs the two measures diverge significantly, by up to 10 points in opposite directions. Accessibility also reveals that scaling, reasoning, and prompt optimization can redistribute capability across inquiries in ways aggregate accuracy obscures, sometimes broadening the set of inquiries a model can succeed on while making success on them less repeatable. Accessibility turns formulation sensitivity from a nuisance into a measurable property of capability, distinguishing what a model can sometimes succeed on from what users can actually depend on.
title: Revealing what benchmark scores hide: Jointly measuring the breadth and reliability of LLM capabilities using accessibility profiles

title_translated: 揭示基准分数隐藏的信息：通过可访问性画像联合衡量大语言模型能力的广度与可靠性
summary_translated: 语言模型基准测试对每个问题仅赋予单一固定表述下的结果，尽管相同语义请求可通过多种等价方式表达。我们认为真正值得关注的不应是某一表述下的正确率，而是查询的可访问性，即模型在保持语义不变的各种表述中成功完成任务的概率。不同查询的可访问性分布揭示了准确率及现有最优、最差或平均情况提示分数所掩盖的结构：模型能力覆盖查询的广度以及这些能力被可靠激发的程度。两个模型可能具有相同的平均表现，但一个在更多查询中成功但不可靠，另一个在较少查询中成功但更一致，这导致在允许多次重试直至成功或要求重复稳定成功时产生相反偏好。在六个基准和二十多个模型中，这种权衡普遍存在：约一半模型对在平均可访问性相近的情况下，哪个模型表现更好取决于是否只需在五种表述中有一成功（我们称之为Access@5）还是全部五种都必须成功（Reliable@5）。某些模型对的两个指标差异显著，甚至方向相反达10个百分点。可访问性还揭示了缩放、推理和提示优化可在查询间重新分配能力，而整体准确率会掩盖这一现象，有时会扩大模型能成功的查询范围，但降低其重复成功率。可访问性将表述敏感性从干扰因素转变为可度量的能力属性，区分了模型偶尔能成功的内容与用户实际可依赖的内容。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to improve the clinical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but current pipelines often rely on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic-data generation. Meanwhile, the medical literature offers a wealth of high-quality unlabeled documents, including clinical case reports that trace the full clinical course from initial presentation to final treatment decisions. We study whether document-grounded self-play can convert these reports into effective RL training signals. We identify two challenges that limit existing self-play methods in this setting: knowledge-point fixation}, where the proposer repeatedly asks about a narrow set of salient clues in a source report, and difficulty-quality mismatch, where appropriately difficult questions may still be poorly formed or shallow, limiting their value for reasoner training. To address these challenges, we propose CasePlay, a self-play framework with two key components: (a) a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer, which anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points so that questions draw on a broader range of evidence from the source report; and (b) a Rubric-Judge Reasoner, which augments answer-accuracy feedback with rubric-based quality feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality, guiding the proposer toward reasoning-intensive questions that better support reasoner training. Extensive experiments across seven medically related benchmarks demonstrate that CasePlay outperforms existing self-play baselines and improves the SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average, highlighted by a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin. This approach offers an effective path toward continually improving medical reasoning ability through self-play RL.
title: CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning
title_translated: CasePlay：基于病例报告的自博弈强化学习用于医学推理
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）是提升大语言模型（LLM）临床推理能力的有前景方法，但当前流程常依赖专家标注的问题或高成本的合成数据生成。与此同时，医学文献提供了大量高质量的未标注文档，包括完整记录从初诊到最终治疗决策全过程的临床病例报告。我们研究了基于文档的自博弈能否将这些报告转化为有效的RL训练信号。我们识别出现有自博弈方法在此场景中的两大挑战：知识点固化，即提问者反复针对源报告中的少数关键线索提问；难度-质量不匹配，即适当难度的问题仍可能表述不佳或浅显，限制其对推理者训练的价值。为解决这些问题，我们提出CasePlay，一种包含两个核心组件的自博弈框架：(a) 知识条件化提问者，将问题生成锚定于病例特定的知识点，使问题能利用源报告中更广泛的信息；(b) 评分标准裁判推理者，除了提供答案准确性反馈外，还引入基于评分标准的质量反馈，涵盖线索整合、推理深度和选项质量，引导提问者生成更具推理强度的问题，从而更好地支持推理者训练。在七个医学相关基准上的大量实验表明，CasePlay优于现有自博弈基线，并使SFT预热模型平均提升3.1分，尤其在LiveClin上实现6.3分提升。该方法为通过自博弈强化学习持续提升医学推理能力提供了有效路径。

summary: We present Stable Signer V3, an interactive high-resolution sign language avatar system built on 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting. It addresses three limitations of existing avatars: restricted facial expression, inaccurate identity-specific body deformation, and loss of fine appearance details. Shared Face Primitive Splatting adds transferable superquadric primitives for richer expression control; Test-Time Body Primitive Splatting learns an identity-specific virtual muscle layer for more faithful motion; and Test-Time Tunneling Super-Resolution uses TunnelingNet to recover identity-specific high-resolution details. Both test-time modules are optimized once per signer identity; inference then runs entirely from the stored identity parameters. Together, they reduce facial geometry error by 71.4%, body-boundary error by 35.1% across ten identities, and high-resolution RGB reconstruction error by 24.2% on held-out evaluations, while retaining interactive streaming.
title: Stable Signer V3: 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting Is All You Need for Sign Language Production
comment: 12 figures, 10 tables. Project Page at: this https URL
title_translated: Stable Signer V3：4D可变形基本体点云表示足以实现手语生成
summary_translated: 我们提出Stable Signer V3，一个基于4D可变形基本体点云表示的交互式高分辨率手语虚拟人系统。它解决了现有虚拟人系统的三个局限：面部表情受限、身份特异性身体形变不准确以及精细外观细节丢失。共享面部基本体点云表示引入可迁移的超二次曲面基本体，实现更丰富的表情控制；测试时身体基本体点云表示通过学习身份特异性的虚拟肌肉层，实现更真实的运动表现；测试时隧道超分辨率则使用TunnelingNet恢复身份特异性的高分辨率细节。这两个测试时模块仅需为每位使用者优化一次；推理阶段完全基于存储的身份参数运行。三者共同作用下，在十位身份的评估中，面部几何误差降低71.4%，身体边界误差降低35.1%，高分辨率RGB重建误差降低24.2%，同时保持实时流式交互性能。

summary: Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible at scale. We present CARTA, a self-supervised encoder that learns a compact 16-dim embedding from raw transactions without labels; the frozen embedding is then reused for label-efficient fraud probing and exploratory unsupervised risk stratification without retraining the encoder. CARTA uses type-specific projections with learned embedding tables for high-cardinality identifiers, trained with token excision and InfoNCE contrastive loss. On IEEE-CIS, its linear probe at 1% of labels exceeds a raw-feature probe at 100%; on IBM TabFormer (2M rows), its frozen embedding reaches GBDT AUPRC 0.508, above frequency encoding (0.411) and the merchant-dropping baseline (0.022), though fully-supervised CatBoost is stronger. CARTA is a label-free, reusable representation that complements task-specific supervised models.
title: CARTA: Self-Supervised Reusable Transaction Embeddings via Heterogeneous Tokenization and Cross-Attention
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ICAIF '26 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance), Milan, Italy, November 14-17, 2026
title_translated: CARTA：通过异构分词与交叉注意力实现自监督可复用交易嵌入
summary_translated: 获取支付交易的欺诈标签成本高昂且任务间不一致，而高基数标识符如商户名称使得传统的独热特征管道在大规模场景下不可行。我们提出CARTA，一种无需标签的自监督编码器，能够从原始交易数据中学习紧凑的16维嵌入；该冻结嵌入可复用于标签高效的欺诈探测和探索性无监督风险分层，无需重新训练编码器。CARTA采用类型特定投影与学习嵌入表处理高基数标识符，通过令牌删除和InfoNCE对比损失进行训练。在IEEE-CIS数据集上，其线性探测器在仅1%标签下超越了100%标签的原始特征探测器；在IBM TabFormer（200万行）上，其冻结嵌入达到GBDT AUPRC 0.508，高于频率编码（0.411）和商户剔除基线（0.022），尽管全监督CatBoost仍更强。CARTA是一种无标签、可复用的表示，可作为任务特定监督模型的补充。

summary: Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.
title: Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design
title_translated: Arctic-SWE：通过建模-系统协同设计重新审视长时程智能体训练
summary_translated: 长时程智能体训练（包括软件工程领域）正快速发展，但构建强强化学习基线所需的配方与基础设施仍难以复现，导致新算法或数据带来的提升难以与基线调优改进区分开来。我们提出Arctic-SWE，一个完全异步的强化学习框架，通过建模-系统协同设计建立此类基线，以小任务池上的过拟合作为测试平台。该测试平台暴露了早期奖励增长所掩盖的失败，并指导成熟组件的集成：门控奖励、重要性权重控制、对齐的训练与推理引擎，以及策略更新间的一致状态。虽然各组件本身并非全新，但它们共同构成了缺失的基础。在原始R2E-Gym数据上，无需新算法或数据工作，Arctic-SWE将Qwen3.5-4B训练至SWE-bench Verified的pass@1达62.0%。这与同期FrogNano（61.5%）相当，但训练滚动次数仅为后者的约六分之一。在此基础上，我们进一步筛选并优化R2E-Gym、SWE-rebench V2和Scale-SWE。使用此精选子集后，4B模型在SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2上的表现分别从47.4%/25.0%/37.9%提升至65.0%/38.3%/59.7%；该配方也使Qwen3.5-9B从56.2%/31.9%/48.8%提升至65.7%/39.6%/70.2%。受控比较显示，数据筛选与测试强化均提升了保留测试集的表现，尽管更强的测试降低了训练任务掌握的表观水平。Arctic-SWE为研究更优的算法、数据与环境提供了可文档化的异步智能体强化学习起点。

summary: Prompt engineering has become a central mechanism for guiding the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a wide range of reasoning and language understanding tasks [1], [2]. However, existing studies frequently evaluate prompting techniques using different LLMs, datasets, or task settings, making direct comparisons across methods and domains difficult [3]. Consequently, in this paper we present a controlled cross-domain evaluation of Zero-Shot prompting, Few-Shot prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automatic prompt optimization based on a PE2-inspired optimization pipeline [4]-[6]. All experiments were conducted with the same LLM and evaluated on six benchmark datasets covering arithmetic reasoning, logical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and factual verification. The results show that no prompting strategy consistently outperforms the others across all domains, and pairwise statistical comparisons of the highest-performing configurations revealed no significant differences. RAG achieves the highest overall average accuracy of 78.33% when 300 examples are available for retrieval, while Few-Shot Prompting achieves comparatively high accuracies across several structured reasoning tasks. Zero-Shot Prompting remains competitive on tasks with self-contained inputs, whereas the PE2-inspired optimization approach produces stable but not systematically superior results compared to the other evaluated prompting techniques. Furthermore, increasing the number of task-specific examples does not consistently improve performance across prompting techniques, indicating strong domain and task dependency. These findings suggest that prompting techniques should be selected adaptively based on task characteristics rather than treated as universally applicable optimization strategies.
title: A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models
comment: Published in the IEEE Proceedings of the 3rd International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM 2026), Barcelona, Spain, November 17-20, 2026
title_translated: 大语言模型提示技术的跨领域评估
summary_translated: 提示工程已成为引导大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛推理和语言理解任务中行为的核心机制。然而，现有研究常使用不同的LLM、数据集或任务设置来评估提示技术，导致方法与领域间难以直接比较。为此，本文提出一个受控的跨领域评估，基于PE2启发的优化流程，对比零样本提示、少样本提示、检索增强生成（RAG）以及自动提示优化。所有实验均使用同一LLM，并在涵盖算术推理、逻辑推理、常识推理和事实验证的六个基准数据集上进行评估。结果表明，没有一种提示策略在所有领域中始终优于其他策略；对表现最佳配置的成对统计比较也未发现显著差异。当可检索示例达到300个时，RAG取得78.33%的最高平均准确率，而少样本提示在多个结构化推理任务中表现出较高准确率。零样本提示在输入自包含的任务中仍具竞争力，而PE2启发的优化方法虽稳定但未系统优于其他提示技术。此外，增加特定任务示例数量并未一致提升各类提示技术的性能，表明其具有强烈的领域和任务依赖性。这些发现表明，应根据任务特征自适应选择提示技术，而非将其视为普适的优化策略。

summary: While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. To build it, we synthesize cross-source bridge trajectories by starting with validated single-source tasks-such as existing text-to-SQL or web search queries-and fabricating the missing source around a bridge entity drawn from the seed's own output. We retain a sample only when strict construction gates confirm that neither side alone suffices, ensuring the data requires true cross-source interdependence. Finally, we train on this curated dataset using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Evaluated on the existing HybridDeepResearch benchmark, HybridResearcher improves over our base model, Qwen3.5-4B, by 30.0 points pass@8 and surpasses the far larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points, while also improving over its base model on established, held-out single-source benchmarks (BrowseComp and BrowseComp-Plus), demonstrating that this complex cross-source reasoning can be taught directly to small models without triggering catastrophic forgetting.
title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
title_translated: HybridResearcher：弥合结构化与非结构化边界以实现深度研究智能体
summary_translated: 尽管大语言模型代理在从单一同质源（如结构化表格或非结构化数据）中收集和整合证据方面能力日益增强，但现实中的分析问题往往跨越异构来源。例如，回答一个企业问题可能需要同时利用内部数据库的计算结果和网络上的证据。近期在HybridDeepResearch等基准上的评估显示，即使前沿代理在证据需跨越这一边界时仍面临困难。虽然这些基准揭示了局限性，但明确教授跨源推理的方法仍属空白。为此，我们提出HybridResearcher——一个40亿参数的智能体，旨在弥合结构化与非结构化数据之间的证据鸿沟。构建该智能体的方法是：从已验证的单源任务（如现有的文本转SQL或网络搜索查询）出发，围绕种子输出中的桥接实体构造缺失的另一源数据。仅当严格构建条件确认任一来源单独不足以完成任务时才保留样本，确保数据真正需要跨源相互依赖。最终，我们使用监督微调结合强化学习在此精选数据集上进行训练。在现有HybridDeepResearch基准上的评估显示，HybridResearcher相较于基础模型Qwen3.5-4B提升了30.0分pass@8，且超过更大规模的Qwen3.5-397B-A17B达8.3分，同时在已有的独立单源基准（BrowseComp和BrowseComp-Plus）上也优于其基础模型，证明这种复杂的跨源推理可直接教授给小型模型，且不会引发灾难性遗忘。

summary: LLM code agents increasingly ship code with little oversight, yet defenders trained on static vulnerability datasets fall behind adapting adversaries. We co-train attacker and defender instead, and let execution decide every reward: an attacker (Red) edits a real repository and earns nothing unless its patch applies, builds, passes the tests, completes its development task and reproduces a real exploit in an isolated container, whose path also labels the entry point, the critical operation and the trace between them.   Peer-Relative Policy Optimization (PRPO) makes both sides populations of LoRA adapters over one frozen base and credits each against same-role peers that faced an identical condition, placing the population inside the policy-gradient baseline rather than the opponent pool, with a tournament preserving diversity. Matching cancels the condition's difficulty: at equal coverage it is worth 2.3 points of balanced accuracy over a baseline computed on other conditions, and it matches a within-policy control at half the verifier spend.   PRPO's 7B diff reviewer reaches 64.8% balanced accuracy on four unseen applications in three untrained languages, 5.5 points above supervised security fine-tuning and 4.4 above a frozen frontier reviewer (Claude Opus 4.8), which it leads by 15.8 on the application it trains on. Its 9B repository agent recovers 23 of 172 held-out VulnGym advisories, against 10 after supervised fine-tuning and 7 for the same backbone untrained under the same scaffold, and locates 17 of 43 reachable entry points against 13 for mini-swe-agent with GLM-5.2. Run unchanged on jailbreak defense, the same algorithm matches or exceeds WildGuard's static F1 at equal corpus and model size. Under a judge distinct from its training oracle it cuts attack success from 36.0% to 4.6%, against WildGuard's 8.9%.
title: Peer Pressure: Execution-Verified Co-Evolution of Attacker and Defender Populations for Code Security
title_translated: 同伴压力：执行验证的攻击者与防御者种群协同进化用于代码安全
summary_translated: 大语言模型代码代理在缺乏充分监督的情况下越来越多地发布代码，而基于静态漏洞数据集训练的防御者则难以跟上不断演变的攻击者。我们采用协同训练攻击者与防御者的方式，并让执行结果决定每项奖励：攻击者（红方）修改真实仓库，只有在其补丁能成功应用、编译通过、测试通过、完成开发任务并复现真实漏洞于隔离容器中时才能获得奖励，且其路径还标注了入口点、关键操作及二者间的追踪路径。同伴相对策略优化（PRPO）使双方均为同一冻结基座上的LoRA适配器群体，每个个体根据相同角色且面对相同条件的同伴进行评分，将群体置于策略梯度基线而非对手池中，并通过锦标赛机制保持多样性。匹配机制抵消了条件难度：在同等覆盖率下，其平衡准确率比基于其他条件计算的基线高出2.3分，且仅需一半验证成本即可达到与组内控制相当的效果。70亿参数的diff审查器在三个未训练语言的四个未见应用上达到64.8%的平衡准确率，较监督安全微调高5.5分，较冻结前沿审查器（Claude Opus 4.8）高4.4分，且在训练应用上领先15.8分。90亿参数的仓库代理恢复了172个保留漏洞中的23个，而监督微调后仅恢复10个，相同主干模型在相同框架下未训练时仅恢复7个；同时定位到43个可达入口点中的17个，而mini-swe-agent与GLM-5.2相比仅定位13个。在不更改算法的前提下应用于对抗破解防御，该方法在相同语料库和模型规模下达到或超过WildGuard的静态F1值。在不同于训练oracle的裁判评估下，将攻击成功率从36.0%降至4.6%，优于WildGuard的8.9%。

summary: Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.
title: The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents
title_translated: 推理的一像素：一个真实关系足以误导大语言模型智能体
summary_translated: 一句句子能否通过针对连接证据与结论的一个隐含前提来操纵智能体的信念？本文提出一种新型认知攻击——单关系攻击（ORA），聚焦于这一推断关系。ORA定位关键隐含前提，并使用一句源自真实来源的句子进行干预，对该前提进行限定并引导智能体形成错误信念。在十八个模型上的生物医学推理与漏洞检测任务中，最佳的十次攻击平均使专有模型正确答案被推翻率达54.9%，开源模型高达80.0%。攻击还可无需目标反馈即发生迁移，成对对照实验支持了攻击目标与限定作用的重要性。此外，成功的攻击句子可通过来源支持检查并逃避识别，多智能体辩论在我们的平衡压力测试中使团队错误率从50.0%上升至59.5%。这些发现确立了隐含前提作为操纵智能体信念的认知攻击面。

summary: Jailbreak papers report an attack success rate, the share of responses that deliver the harmful request, and read it as a property of the target model. We hold the target model, the prompts and the responses fixed and change only the grader. Three dense graders of 8B and 9B parameters, from three model families, move compliant responses to the neighbouring class, evasion, instead of scattering them across classes. One of them assigns the compliance label zero times in 900 responses. This class collapse also appears on new harmful requests, on a target model from a third family, and in a held-out 7B grader from a fourth family. Per-class label counts expose it at no cost and without human labels. The collapse decides how the rate behaves under a change of grader. On two corpora of 900 responses and eight graders, the compliance rate differs by a factor of 22 to 25, while the non-refusal rate differs by 18 to 23 percentage points. Without the three collapsing graders, compliance differs by a factor of 1.7 to 2.8 on all four corpora, and non-refusal still differs by 10 to 22 points. These results do not change when every grader is called once. We propose a reporting minimum that keeps the compliance rate and adds its per-class label counts and the named grader. Beside it goes the non-refusal rate, whose disagreement across graders is additive.
title: The Missing Compliance Class: LLM Graders That Collapse Jailbreak Success, and a Free Check

title_translated: 缺失的合规类别：崩溃的LLM评分器与免费检查方案
summary_translated: 关于对抗破解的研究报告通常将攻击成功率定义为目标模型响应中有害请求的比例，并将其视为目标模型的属性。我们固定目标模型、提示和响应，仅改变评分器。三个来自不同模型家族的80亿和90亿参数密集型评分器，将原本合规的响应归入邻近的‘规避’类别，而非分散在多个类别中。其中一个评分器在900个响应中从未分配过合规标签。这种类别坍塌现象在新有害请求、第三家族的目标模型以及第四家族的70亿参数保留评分器中同样出现。按类别标签计数可无成本、无需人工标注地暴露此类坍塌。类别坍塌决定了评分器变更时成功率的表现。在两组各900个响应、八种评分器的实验中，合规率差异达22至25倍，非拒绝率差异达18至23个百分点。若剔除三个坍塌评分器，合规率差异仅为1.7至2.8倍，非拒绝率差异仍达10至22个百分点。即使每个评分器仅调用一次，结果亦不变。我们建议报告最低标准：保留合规率，并附加每类标签计数及评分器名称。此外，非拒绝率在不同评分器间的分歧具有累加性。
